Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 18: Kol hakkarbanot kullan ben karbenot behema veof ben karbenot menachot mitzvat ase lehakerivan bevet habbechira shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 14)</small> "vesham taase kol asher anochi metzavvekka". vechen mitzvat ase lihyot kol adam metappel umevi karbenot behema shennitchayyev lehakerivan michutza laaretz levet habbechira shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 26)</small> "kadashecha asher yihyu lecha unedarecha tissa" vegomer. mippi hashshemua lamdu sheeno medabber ella bekadshe chutza laaretz shehu metappel bahem ad sheyyeviem levet habbechira:

Hammakriv karban chutz laazara bittel mitzvat ase veavar al lo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 13)</small> "hishshamer lecha pen taale olotecha bechol makom asher tire". veim hikriv bemezid chayyav karet shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 8)</small> "asher yaale ola o zavach" <small>(Vayikra 17 9)</small> "veel petach ohel moed lo hevio" "venichrat meammav". beshogeg mevi chattat kevua:

Vechen hashshochet kadashim chutz laazara af al pi shello heelam im haya mezid chayyav karet shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 3)</small> "asher yishchat shor o chesev o ez" vegomer <small>(Vayikra 17 4)</small> "dam yechashev laish hahu dam shafach venichrat". veim shachat beshogeg mevi chattat kevua:

Vehechan hizhir al hashshechita bachutz. behekkesh. neemar <small>(Devarim 12 14)</small> "sham taale olotecha" veneemar <small>(Devarim 12 14)</small> "vesham taase kol asher anochi metzavvekka". ma haaliyya bachutz sheanash aleha hizhir aleha beferush shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 13)</small> "hishshamer lecha pen taale olotecha". af asiyya shebbichlal hashshechita sheanash aleha beferush hare hu muzhar aleha. shello anash hakkatuv ella im ken hizhir:

Hashshochet kadashim veheelam bachutz chayyav shetayim. achat al hashshechita veachat al haaliyya. shachat bifnim veheela bachutz chayyav al haaliyya. vechen im shachat bachutz veheela bifnim chayyav al hashshechita:

Eno chayyav ella al shechitat kadashim haruyin likkarev legabbe mizbeach. aval hashshochet bachutz echad meissure mizbeach o mechattaot hammetot hare ze patur shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 4)</small> "lifne mishkan Adonai" vechol sheeno rauy lavo el mishkan Adonai en chayyavin alav:
Shachat bachutz mechussar zeman begufo o babbealim hoil veeno rauy atta lavo bifnim patur:
E zehu mechussar zeman begufo. behema betoch shivat yeme halleda. vetorin shello higgia zemannan. veoto veet beno shennishchat echad mehem hayyom sheen hashsheni rauy ad lemachar:

Vee zehu mechussar zeman babbealim. karban sheadayin lo higgia zeman bealav lehakerivo. ketzad. hazzav vehazzava vehayyoledet sheshshachatu chattatam bachutz [betoch] yeme sefira peturin. vechen metzora sheshshachat chattato vaashamo bachutz betoch yeme hassefira patur. sheadayin lo niru baale hakkarbanot haellu lechappara. aval im shachatu olotehen bachutz betoch yeme hassefira chayyavin. shehaola doron hi vehachattat vehaasham hi ikkar hakkappara. vechen nazir sheshshachat chattato bachutz betoch yeme neziruto patur. hikriv olato o shelamav bachutz chayyav shehachattat hi hammeakkavto vehi ikkar hannezirut:

Asham taluy vechattat haof habbaa al hassafek shehikrivan bachutz patur shehare lo nikba haissur. asham metzora sheshshechato bachutz shello lishmo chayyav hoil veshello lishmo rauy bifnim vechasher kemo sheyyitbaer. vechol karban shehu patur al shechitato bachutz kach hu patur al haalaato:

Shene seire yom hakkippurim sheshshechatam bachutz. im ad shello hitvadda alehem chayyav karet al shenehen hoil ureuyin lavo lifne hashshem levidduy. veim achar shehitvadda patur al hammishtalleach shehare eno rauy lavo lifne hashshem:

Hashshochet shelamim bachutz kodem sheyyippatchu daltot hahechol patur. shehare hen mechussarim maase veachar kach yihyu reuyin likkarev lifne hashshem kemo shebbearnu. vehashshochet et happesach bachutz afillu bishar yemot hashshana ben lishmo ben shello lishmo chayyav. shehappesach bishar yemot hashshana shelamim hu:
Behemat chullin sheubbarah kadshe mizbeach asur leshochotah bachutz. veim shechatah eno loke mippene sheenah reuya lavo lifne hashshem:
Ganav vehikdish veachar kach shachat bachutz chayyav. umeematay heemiduha birshuto kede lechayyevo aleha karet. mishshaa shehikdishah. vehu sheshshechatah achar yeush aval lifne yeush enah kedosha:

Hayta habbehema kullah bachutz vetzavvarah bifnim veshachat chayyav shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 3)</small> "asher yishchat shor o keves o ez bammachane o asher yishchat michutz lammachane". echad hashshochet bammikdash vetzavvarah bifnim ushear guf habbehema bachutz o shehaya gufah bifnim vetzavvarah bachutz chayyav ad shettihye habbehema kullah bammikdash shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 9)</small> "veel petach ohel moed lo yeviennu". aval hashshochet begaggo shel hechol af al pi sheeno rauy lizvicha kelal hare ze patur:

Shenayim sheachazu bassakkin veshachatu bachutz peturin shenneemar asher yishchat <small>(Vayikra 17 3)</small> "o asher yishchat" echad velo shenayim. veechad sheshshachat bachutz af al pi shello nitkavven lishchot kadashim ellu laAdonai hare ze chayyav shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 4)</small> "dam yechashev laish hahu dam shafach". af al pi shezze haddam bemachashavto kaddam hannishpach lo kakkarban hare ze chayyav:

Hashshochet bachutz ballayla chayyav hoil vehashshechita ballayla keshera bachutz. vechen im heela ballayla mizze sheshshachat bachutz ballayla chayyav al haalaa. aval im shachat bifnim ballayla veheela bachutz patur. lefi shello heela ella davar pasul sheen lecha shechita keshera ballayla bammikdash. vechen im kibbel bichli chol bifnim vezarak bachutz patur:

Vechen hammolek et haof bachutz patur. veim heelahu patur. malak bifnim veheela bachutz chayyav al haalaa. shachat bifnim veheelahu bachutz patur shello heela ella davar sheeno rauy likkarev. shachat et haof bachutz veheelahu bachutz chayyav shetayim shehashshechita bachutz keshera vahare hi kimlika bifnim:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 19:
En hammaale bachutz chayyav ad sheyyaale lerosh hammizbeach sheyyaase bachutz. aval im heela al hassela o al haeven patur. sheen karuy karban ella al hammizbeach veaf al pi shehu bachutz shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 8 20)</small> "vayyiven noach mizbeach". veeno chayyav ad sheyyaale lashshem shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 9)</small> "laasot oto laAdonai" ad sheyyitkavven lashshem:
Eno chayyav ella al haalaat davar harauy laishshim velammizbeach kegon haola shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 8)</small> "asher yaale ola o zavach" ma ola sheruya laishshim af kol sherauy laishshim hu shechayyavin al haalaato bachutz:
Mikkan amru hazzorek et haddam o hammaktir evre ola o emurin o kometz o levona o ketoret o minchat kohanim o minchat nesachim o hamenassech shelosha login yayin o mayim bachutz chayyav shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 9)</small> "lo yeviennu laasot oto" kol hammitkabbel bifnim chayyavin alav bachutz:
Aval hazzorek sheyare haddam bachutz afillu sheyare damim happenimim patur. shezzerikat sheyare haddam sheyare mitzva hem veenan meakkevin. vechen hamenassech yayin o mayim pachot mishshelosha login bachutz patur ben bechag ben bishar yemot hashshana. hoil vechaser hashshiur hare enan reuyin lehitkabbel bifnim. vechen hammaale mibbesar chattat mibbesar asham mibbesar shelamim ben shel yachid ben shel tzibbur mishsheyare menachot mishshete hallechem millechem happanim bachutz patur. shekkol ellu reuyin laachila lo laishshim:
Hammaale et habbehema kullah bachutz chayyav mippene haemurin. veaf al pi shello hifrishan en besar hazzevach chotzetz. ucheillu hiktir haemurim bifne atzman. aval hammaale mincha shello nikmetza patur. sheen hakkometz barur umuvdal. kematzah vechazar kumtzah letochah vehikriv kullah bachutz chayyav:
Hayyotzek vehabbolel vehappotet vehammoleach vehammenif vehammaggish vehamesadder et hashshulchan vehammetiv et hannerot vehakkometz vehamekabbel damim bachutz patur. lefi shekkol echad meellu eno gemar avoda veneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 8)</small> "asher yaale ola o zavach". ma haalaa shehi gemar avoda af kol shehu gemar avoda chayyavin alav:
Para adumma shesserafah chutz mimmekom serefatah. vechen sair hammishtalleach shehikrivo bachutz achar shehitvadda alav patur. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 9)</small> "veel petach ohel moed lo yeviennu" kol sheeno rauy lavo el petach ohel moed en chayyavin alav. aval kadashim pesulin shehaya pissulan bakkodesh im heela mehen bachutz chayyav. ketzad. kegon hallan vehayyotze vehattame veshennifsal bemachshevet haoved shekkullan nisrafin kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot pesule hammukdashin. im avar veheela mehem bachutz chayyav shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 9)</small> "laasot oto laAdonai" kol hannaase laAdonai chayyavin alav veellu naasu lashshem:
Kol davar shechayyavin al haalaato bachutz kevan sheheela mimmennu kezayit bachutz chayyav. ben sheheela bifnim techilla veshiyyer mimmennu kezayit veheelahu bachutz. ben shehinniach hakkol bifnim velakach mimmennu kezayit veheelahu bachutz. aval im chisser oto davar hakkarev kol shehu bifnim veheela sheerito bachutz patur:
Ketzad. hakkometz o hallevona vehaemurin vehaola umincha hannisrefet vehannesachin shechasru miktzatam bifnim vehikriv sheeritan bachutz patur. shehare neemar <small>(Vayikra 17 9)</small> "laasot oto" al hashshalem hu chayyav veeno chayyav al hechaser. hotzio shalem vechasar bachutz veheelahu hare ze safek lefichach eno loke:
Heela evar sheen bo kezayit basar vehaya haetzem mashlimo lichzayit chayyav. mippene shehu mechubbar. haya melach mashlimo lichzayit hare ze safek lefichach eno loke. veola veemureha mitztarfin lichzayit:
Heela vechazar veheela chayyav al kol evar veevar. zarak haddam veheela haevarim chayyav shetayim. shehare chalak hakkatuv ben maale leose. shehare neemar <small>(Vayikra 17 8)</small> "asher yaale la" veneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 9)</small> "laasot oto". heela evar chaser patur shenneemar laasot oto al hashshalem hu chayyav:
Shenayim sheshshachatu peturim. shenayim sheachazu beevar veheeluhu bachutz chayyavin. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 8)</small> "ish ish" <small>(Vayikra 17 8)</small> "asher yaale la" afillu ish veish sheheelu chayyavin:
Hazzorek miktzat mattanot bachutz chayyav. hamekabbel dam chattat bechos echad natan mimmennu bachutz vechazar venatan bifnim chayyav al hanayatan bachutz. shehare kullo rauy likkarev bifnim. veim natan mimmennu bifnim vechazar venatan bachutz patur mippene shehen sheyarim. aval im kibbel bishne kosot. ben shennatan shenehen bachutz. o echad bachutz veechad bifnim. o echad bifnim veechad bachutz. hare ze chayyav:
Hakkometz vehallevona shel mincha shehikriv echad mehen bachutz o hikriv haechad bifnim vehashsheni bachutz chayyav. vechen shene beziche levona shel lechem happanim shehikriv echad mehen bachutz o echad bifnim vehashsheni bachutz chayyav:
Mi sheshshachat kadashim bazzeman hazze veheelam chutz laazara chayyav. mippene shehu rauy likkarev bifnim. shehare muttar lehakeriv af al pi sheen bayit mippene shekkedushsha rishona kadsha lishatah vekadsha leatid lavo:
Hashshochet kadshe nachrim bachutz chayyav. vechen hammaale otan bachutz. vehannachrim muttarin lehakeriv olot lashshem bechol makom. vehu sheyyakrivu bevama sheyyivnu. veasur lesayyean velaasot shelichutan shehare neesar alenu lehakeriv bachutz. umuttar lehorot lahem ulelammedam heach yakrivu leshem hael baruch hu:
Mishneh Torah, Daily Offerings and Addit:
Mitzvat ase lehakeriv shene kevasim olot bechol yom vehem hannikraim temidin. echad babboker veechad ben haarbayim shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 28 3)</small> "shenayim layyom ola tamid" vegomer:
Veematay zeman shechitatan. shel boker shochatin oto kodem shettaale hachamma mishsheyyeor pene kol mizrach. vpaam achat dachaka hashshaa et hatztzibbur bevayit sheni vehikrivu tamid shel shachar bearba shaot bayyom:
Tamid shel ben haarbayim shochatin oto mishsheyyaarich hatztzel veyerae lakkol sheheerich. vehu mishshesh umechetza vamala ad sof hayyom. velo hayu shochatin oto bechol yom ella bishmone shaot umechetza vekarev betesha umechetza. velamma meacharin oto shete shaot achar techillat zeman shechitato. mippene hakkarbanot shel yechidim o shel tzibbur. lefi sheasur lehakeriv karban kelal kodem tamid shel shachar. velo shochatin karban achar tamid shel ben haarbayim chutz mikkarban pesach levaddo. shei efshar sheyyakrivu kol yisrael pischehen bishte shaot:
En shochatin et happesach ella achar tamid shel ben haarbayim. vechen mechussere kippurim makrivin kapparatan achar tamid shel ben haarbayim beyom arbaa asar kede sheyyihyu tehorin leechol pischehen laerev:
Arve pesachim ben bechol ben beshabbat haya hattamid nishchat besheva umechetza vekarev bishmone umechetza. kede sheyyihye lahem penay lishchot pischehem. veim chal erev pesach lihyot erev shabbat hayu shochatin oto beshesh umechetza bitchillat zemanno. vekarev besheva umechetza kede sheyyihye lahem revach litzlot kodem sheyyikkanes shabbat:
Af al pi sheen shochatin achar tamid shel ben haarbayim. maktirin kol davar harauy lehaketara kol hayyom. umaktirin evre olot vehaemurin ad chatzi hallayla kemo shebbearnu bemaase hakkarbanot. veevarin veemurin shello nitakkelu ben min hattamid ben mishshear hakkarbanot mehappechin bahen kol hallayla ad habboker shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 2)</small> "kol hallayla ad habboker": 
Evarim shel tamid dochin et hattuma veen dochin et hashshabbat. ella beerev shabbat bilvad maktirin evre tamid shel erev shabbat. shehattamid techillato doche shabbat vesofo eno doche. chelve shabbat kerevin belele yom tov im chal yom tov lihyot bemotzae shabbat. aval en kerevin belele yom hakkippurim shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 28 10)</small> "lat shabbat beshabbatto" velo olat shabbat zo beshabbat acheret. velo olat chol beyom tov:
Arbaa asar shechal lihyot beshabbat. maktirin chelve happesachim belele yom tov mippene shehem kechelve shabbat:
En pochatin mishshishsha telaim hamevukkarin belishkat hattelaim shebbammikdash. veyihyu muchanim kodem yom hakerava bearbaa yamim. veaf al pi shehayu mevakkerin oto mittechilla lo hayu shochatin et hattamid ad shemmevakkerin oto sheniyya kodem shechita leor haavukot. umashkin oto mayim bechos shel zahav kede sheyyihye noach lehefshet:
Kemaase tamid shel shachar kach maase tamid shel ben haarbayim. vehakkol kemaase haola shekkatavnu bemaase hakkarbanot. velo hayu koftin et hattale shello yechakku et hamminin ella ochazin yadav veraglav bidehen. vechach hayta akedato rosho laddarom ufanav lammaarav:
Tamid shel shachar haya nishchat al keren tzefonit maaravit shel bet hammitbachayim al tabbaat sheniyya. veshel ben haarbayim al keren tzefonit mizrachit mimmenna al tabbaat sheniyya kede sheyyihye keneged hashshemesh. divre kabbala hen sheyyihyu nishchatin keneged hashshemesh:
Tau o shaggu afillu hezidu velo hikrivu tamid shel shachar yakrivu tamid shel ben haarbayim. bamme devarim amurim beshennitchannech hammizbeach. aval haya mizbeach chadash sheadayin lo karev alav kelum lo yakrivu alav techilla ben haarbayim. sheen mechannechin mizbach haola ella betamid shel shachar:

Mitzvat ase lihyot esh yekuda al hammizbeach tamid shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 6)</small> "esh tamid tukad al hammizbeach". af al pi shehaesh yarda min hashshamayim mitzva lehavi esh min hahedyot shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1 7)</small> "venatnu bene aharon hakkohanim esh al hammizbeach":
Babboker orchin etzim veorchin berosh hammizbeach maaracha gedola shel esh shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 5)</small> "uvier aleha hakkohen etzim babboker babboker". vechen mitzva lehaalot shene gezarim shel etz im tamid shel shachar yoter al atze hammaaracha shenneemar uvier aleha hakkohen etzim babboker. vechen mosifin shene gezarim im tamid shel ben haarbayim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1 7)</small> "vearchu etzim al haesh". mippi hashshemua lamdu shebbetamid shel ben haarbayim hakkatuv medabber: 
Shene gezarim shel ben haarbayim maalin otan shene kohanim. kol echad veechad beetz yechidi beyado shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1 7)</small> "vearchu" hare kan shenayim. aval shel shachar bechohen echad:
Shalosh maarachot shel esh osin berosh hammizbeach bechol yom. rishona maaracha gedola shealeha makrivin hattamid im shear hakkarbanot. sheniyya betziddah ketanna shemmimmenna lokchin esh bemachta lehaketir ketoret bechol yom. shelishit en aleha kelum ella lekayyem mitzvat haesh shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 6)</small> "esh tamid tukad":
Mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 2)</small> "al mokda al hammizbeach" zo maaracha gedola. <small>(Vayikra 6 2)</small> "veesh hammizbeach tukad bo" zo maaracha sheniyya shel ketoret. <small>(Vayikra 6 5)</small> "vehaesh al hammizbeach tukad bo" zo maaracha shelishit shel kiyyum haesh. aval evarim ufedarim shello nitakkelu mibbaerev notnin otan betzidde maaracha gedola:
Hamechabbe esh hammizbeach loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 5 6)</small> "lo tichbe". afillu gachelet achat vaafillu horidah meal hammizbeach vechibba loke. aval esh machta veesh menora shehechinah bammizbeach lehadelik mimmenna af al pi shekkibba otan berosh hammizbeach patur shehare nittekah lemitzva acheret veen ani kore bahen esh hammizbeach:
Keshemmesadder atze maaracha gedola mesadderah bemizrach hammizbeach. veyihye mare shehitchil lesadder min hammizrach. verevach haya ben haggezarim. verashe haggezarim happenimiyyim hayu nogin baddeshen shebbeemtza hammizbeach vehu hannikra tappuach:
Veachar shemmesadder maaracha gedola chozer uvorer atze teena yafim umesadder maaracha sheniyya shel ketoret mikkeneged keren maaravit deromit meshucha min hakkeren kelappe tzafon arba ammot uvah kemo chamesh sein gechalim. uveshabbat osin bah kemo shemone sein gechalim mippene shealeha maktirin bechol shabbat shene beziche levona shel lechem happanim:
Maaracha shelishit shel kiyyum haesh ose otah bechol makom sheyyirtze min hammizbeach. umatztzit bah et haesh. velo yatztzit haesh lematta veyaale otah lammizbeach ella bammizbeach atzmo matztzitin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 2)</small> "veesh hammizbeach tukad bo". mikkan lehatztzata shello tihye ella berosho shel mizbeach:
Haramat haddeshen meal hammizbeach bechol yom mitzvat ase shenneemar veherim et haddeshen. vehi avoda meavodot kehunna. uvigde kehunna shettorem bahen haddeshen yihyu pechutin min habbegadim shemmeshammesh bahem bishar avodot shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 4)</small> "ufashat et begadav velavash begadim acherim veherim et haddeshen". eno omer acherim sheyyihyu bigde chol ella sheyyihyu pechutin min harishonim. lefi sheeno derech eretz sheyyimzog kos lerabbo bivgadim shebbishshel bahem kedera lerabbo: 
Ematay tormin haddeshen bechol yom. mishsheyyaale ammud hashshachar. uvargalim mittechillat shelish emtzai shel layla. uveyom hakkippurim mechatzot hallayla:
Ketzad tormin. mi shezzacha litrom tovel velovesh bigde harama. umekaddesh yadav veraglav veomrim lo hizzaher shemma tigga bichli ad shettekaddesh yadecha veraglecha. veachar kach lokeach hammachta veshel kesef hayta. vehi hayta netuna bemiktzoa ben kevesh lammizbeach bemaaravo shel kevesh. venotel et hammachta veole lerosh hammizbeach umefanne et haggechalim elach veelach vechote min haggechalim shennitakkelu belev haesh veyored lematta laaretz. vehofech panav letzafon umehallech baaretz lemizrach hakkevesh kemo eser ammot kelappe hatztzafon. vetzover et haggechalim shechata al gabbe haritzpa rachok min hakkevesh shelosha tefachim. bemakom shennotnim murat haof vedishun hammizbeach happenimi vehammenora. vachatiyya zo shechote bammachta umorid laritzpa etzel hammizbeach hi hammitzva shel kol yom:
Achar sheyyarad ze shettaram ratzim echav hakkohanim umekaddeshin yedehem veraglehem bimhera. venotlin et hammaggerefot veet hatztzinnorot veolin lerosh hammizbeach. vechol evre haolot veemure hakkarbanot shello nitakkelu kol hallayla machazirin otam letzidde hammizbeach. im en hatztzedadin machazikin sodrim otam bakkevesh keneged hassovev. veachar kach gorfin et haddeshen bemagrefot mikkol tzidde hammizbeach. umaalin oto arema al gabbe hattappuach. vegorfin otah haarema bifsachter. vehu keli gadol shemmachzik letech. umoridin oto lematta. uvargalim lo hayu moridin oto ella mannichin haarema gevoha beemtza hammizbeach mippene shehu noy lammizbeach:
Kol mi sheyyirtze min hakkohanim memalle min haddeshen shehoridu lematta umotzi chutz lair leshefech haddeshen. veen lehotzaat haddeshen lachutz piyyus ella kol harotze. umeolam lo nitatztzel kohen millehotzi et haddeshen:
Veaf al pi sheen hotzaato lachutz avoda. en baale mumin motziin oto. ucheshemmotziin oto lechutz lair mannichin oto bemakom sheen haruchot menashshevot bo bechazka. velo chazirim gorfim oto. velo yefazzerennu sham shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 3)</small> "vesamo". sheyyannichennu benachat. veasur lehanot bo:

Mitzvat ase lehaketir hakketoret al mizbach hazzahav shebbahechol paamayim bechol yom babboker uven haarbayim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 30 7)</small> "vehiktir alav aharon ketoret sammim". lo hiktiru babboker yaktiru ben haarbayim afillu hayu mezidin. veen mechannechin mizbach hazzahav ella biktoret shel ben haarbayim:
Kamma maktirin mimmenna bechol yom. mishkal mea dinarin. chamishshim babboker vachamishshim ben haarbayim. mizbeach shenneekar maktirin hakketoret bimkomo. uketoret sheppaka meal hammizbeach afillu keratin shebbah en machazirin otan:
Beet shemmaktirin hakketoret bahechol bechol yom porshin kol haam min hahechol umibben haulam velammizbeach lo yihye sham adam ad sheyyetze ze shehiktir hakketoret. vechen beshaa sheyyikkanes bedam chattaot hannaasot bifnim porshim hakkol mibben haulam velammizbeach ad sheyyetze shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 17)</small> "vechol adam lo yihye beohel moed bevoo lechapper bakkodesh" vegomer binyan av lechol kappara shebbakkodesh shello yehe sham adam:
Ketzad seder haketarat hakketoret bechol yom. mi shezzacha bedishshun hammizbeach happenimi nichnas bichli kodesh veteni haya shemo veshel zahav haya umachazik kabbayim vachetzi. manniach hatteni baaretz lefanav vechofen beyadav haefer vehappecham shebbetoch hammizbeach venoten letoch hatteni. uvaacharona mechabbed et hashshear letocho umannicho sham bahechol veyotze. umi shezzacha bakketoret notel keli male ketoret gadush. vechissuy haya lo uvazach haya shemo venoten habbazach betoch keli acher vechaf haya shemo. umechasse et hakkaf beveged katan veochez hakkaf beyado venichnas immo echad bammachta shel esh beyado:
Vechetzad chote. ze shezzacha bemachta lokeach machta shel kesef veole lerosh hammizbeach umefanne et haggechalim elach veelach. venotel min haggechalim shennitakkelu bemaaracha sheniyya. veyored umearan letoch machta shel zahav. im nitpazzeru min haggechalim kemo kav o pachot mechabbedan laamma. uveshabbat kofe alehen happesachter. veim nitpazzer yeter al kav chozer vechote:
Shelosha devarim haya happesachter meshammesh. kofin oto al haggechalim. veal hashsheretz beshabbat. umoridin bo et haddeshen meal hammizbeach:
Umakdim lifnehem ze sheddishshen hammizbeach happenimi venotel hatteni shebbo dishun hammizbeach umishtachave veyotze. veze shebbeyado hammachta tzover et haggechalim al gabbe hammizbeach happenimi umeraddedan beshule hammachta umishtachave veyotze. veze shebbeyado hakkaf notel et habbazach mittoch hakkaf venotno leohavo o likrovo veroe im nitpazzer min hakketoret meat bechaf ohavo o kerovo noten lo letoch chafnav ze shennitpazzer im hakketoret shebbabbazach umishtachave veyotze:
Veomrin laze hammaktir hizzaher shello tatchil millefanecha shello tikkave. umatchil umashlich hakketoret al haesh benachat kemi shemmerakked solet ad shettitradded al kol haesh:
Veen hammaktir maktir ad shehamemunne omer lo haketer. veim kohen gadol hu omer lo hamemunne ishi kohen gadol haketer. veachar sheomer yifreshu kol haam veyaktir hammaktir veyishtachave veyetze:
Dishun hammenora vahatavat hannerot babboker uven haarbayim mitzvat ase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 27 21)</small> "yaaroch oto aharon uvanav". vehadelakat hannerot docha et hashshabbat veet hattuma kekarbanot shekkavua lahen zeman shenneemar <small>(Shemot 27 20)</small> <small>(Vayikra 24 2)</small> "lehaalot ner tamid": 
Vechamma shemen hu noten lechol ner. chatzi log shemen shenneemar <small>(Shemot 27 21)</small> <small>(Vayikra 24 3)</small> "meerev ad boker" ten lo kammidda sheyyihye dolek meerev ad boker. veen mechannechin et hammenora ella behadelakat shiva neroteha ben haarbayim: 
Mahu dishun hammenora. kol ner shekkava mesir happetila vechol hashshemen shebbanner umekannecho venoten bo petila acheret veshemen acher bemidda vehu chatzi log. veze shehesir mashlicho bimkom haddeshen etzel hammizbeach im dishun hammizbeach happenimi vehachitzon umadlik ner shekkava. vehadelakat hannerot hi hatavatam. vener shemmetzao shello kava metakkeno:
Ner maaravi shekkava en madlikin oto achar dishshuno ella mimmizbach hachitzon. aval shear hannerot kol ner shekkava mehen madliko minner chavero:
Vechetzad madliko. moshech happetila ad shemmadlikah umachazirah. lefi shehannerot kevuim bammenora veeno yachol lehadelik bener acher mishshum bizzayon:
Kol happetilot sheasur lehadelik bahen beshabbat asur lehadelik bahen bammikdash bammenora shenneemar <small>(Shemot 27 20)</small> <small>(Vayikra 24 2)</small> "lehaalot ner tamid" shettehe shalhevet ola meeleha: 
Lo haya metiv kol hannerot befaam achat ella metiv chamishsha nerot umafsik veosin avoda acheret veachar kach nichnas umetiv hashshenayim. kede leharegish et kol haazara:
Kol ner shekkava madlikin oto minner acher mehen kemo shebbearnu. vechetzad seder hahatava. ze shezzacha bedishun hammenora nichnas ucheli beyado vechuz shemo veshel zahav haya dome lekiton gadol. medashshen bo et happetilot shekkavu veet hashshemen hannishar banner vemetiv chamishsha nerot umanniach hakkuz sham lifne hammenora al maala sheniyya mishshalosh maalot shellefaneha veyotze. veachar kach nichnas umetiv shene hannerot venotel hakkuz beyado umishtachave veyotze:
Chavite kohen gadol mitzvat ase lehakerivan bechol yom mechetza babboker im tamid shel shachar umechetza ben haarbayim im tamid shel ben haarbayim. velishatan vaafiyyatan dochin et hashshabbat veet hattuma kechol karban shekkavua lo zeman shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 14)</small> "tufine" shettehe naa velo teafe mibbaerev. veod im teafe mibbaerev tippasel belina shehammarcheshet mikkele hakkodesh hi kemo shebbearnu:
Techinat saltan veherkedan bachutz veenan dochin et hashshabbat:
Kohen shehikriv mechetza beshacharit umet o nitma o nolad lo mum uminnu kohen acher tachtav lo yavi chatzi issaron mibbeto velo chatzi issaron shel rishon. ella mevi issaron shalem vechotzehu umakriv mechetza umechetza aved:
Nimtzeu shene chatzaim kerevin ushene chatzain ovdin. veellu shene hachatzain haovdim mannichin otan ad shetteubbar tzuratan veyotzin levet hasserefa. vechen im avad o nitma hachetzi shel ben haarbayim. vehechan sorfin otan, baazara:
Met kohen gadol beshacharit achar shehikriv chatzi haissaron velo minnu kohen acher meviin hayyorshin issaron shalem avur kapparato veosin oto chavitin ushelema hayta kereva. met kohen gadol kodem sheyyakrivo babboker velo minnu kohen acher makrivin oto issaron shalem babboker veissaron shalem ben haarbayim. veen koflin shamnah ulevonatah af al pi shennichpela hassolet. ella mafrishin lahem shelosha loge shemen vekometz levona. log umechetza shemen vachatzi kometz levona leissaron shel boker velog umechetza shemen vachatzi kometz levona leissaron shel ben haarbayim:

Kol haavodot haellu sheosin bechol yom befayis hayu osin otan. vechetzad hayu osin. kol kohane batte avot shel yom nichnasin lelishkat haggazit achar sheyyaale ammud hashshachar umelubbashin hen bevigde kehunna. vehamemunne sheal happeyasot immahen vehen omdin behakkafa vehamemunne notel mitznefet meal rosho shel echad mehen umachazirah vehu haish shemmatchilin limnot mimmennu umefisin kemo sheyyitbaer:

Veyotzin laavoda anashim sheovdin bo. ushear hakkohanim mosrin otan lechazzanin umafshitin otan et bigde hakkodesh velo hayu mannichin alehen ella hammichnasayim bilvad ad shellovshin bigde chol vechozrin ufoshtin et hammichnasayim shel kodesh umachzirim hachazzanim et hakkelim lachallonot:

Ketzad mefisin. omdin behekkef umaskimin al minyan shemonim mea o elef o kol minyan sheyyaskimu alav. vehamemunne omer lahem hatzebiu vehen motziin etzbeotehen achat o shetayim. veim hotzi shalosh monin lo shalosh. veen motziin gudal bammikdash mippene harammaim shehaggudal katzar venoach lehotzio velichpoto. vehammotzi gudal en monin oto lo. umatchil hamemunne limnot min haish hayyadua shehesir mitznafto techilla. umone al etzbeotehen vechozer chalila ad sheyyashlim hamminyan shehiskimu alav vehaish sheshshalem hamminyan etzel etzbao hu sheyyetze befayis rishon laavoda:

Velamma mone hamminyan shehiskimu alav al haetzbaot shehotziu velo haya mone al haanashim atzman lefi sheasur limnot yisrael ella al yede davar acher shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 15 4)</small> "vayyifkedem battelaim":

Arbaa peyasot hayu mefisin bechol yom beshacharit. happayis harishon mi torem et hammizbeach. hefisu vezacha mi shezzacha litrom. vehu mesadder et hammaaracha. vehu maale shene gizre etzim lammizbeach. vehu machnis machta melea esh min hammizbeach hachitzon lemizbach hazzahav lehaketir aleha ketoret:

Happayis hashsheni zochin bo shelosha asar al seder amidatan. ketzad. hamemunne omer lahem hatzebiu umone kederech shebbearnu. veze sheyyatza befayis rishon hu shochet tamid shel shachar. vehashsheni sheomed betziddo hu mekabbel et dam hattamid vehu zorko. vehashshelishi hassamuch lashsheni medashshen hammizbeach happenimi shehu mizbach hakketoret. veharvii shebbetziddo medashshen et hammenora umetiv et hannerot. vehachamishi maale rosh hattamid veraglo lakkevesh. vehashshishshi maale shete hayyadayim. vehashshevii maale haoketz veharegel. vehashshemini maale hechaze vehaggera. vehatteshii maale shete haddefanot. vehaasiri maale hakkeravayim. vehaachad asar maale solet hannesachim. vehashshenem asar maale hachavitin. vehashshelosha asar maale hayyayin shel nesachim:

Happayis hashshelishi omer lahen hamemunne lechol anshe bet av shel oto hayyom mi shello hiktir ketoret miyyamav yavo veyafis. veyitkabbetzu etzel hamemunne veyafisu umi sheyyetze befayis ze rishon hu sheyyizke lehaketir ketoret:

Happayis harvii mitkabbetzin kullan umefisin leda mi maale evarim min hakkevesh lammizbeach. hefisu vezacha mi shezzacha. tamid shel ben haarbayim en mefisin lo payis acher. ella kol kohen shezzacha baavoda min haavodot shacharit yizke ben haarbayim. chutz min hakketoret shehen mefisin lah payis acher ben haarbayim veyavo kol mi shello hiktir ketoret meolam meanshe oto bet av veyafisu aleha. veim kevar hiktiru kullan mimehen mefisin lahen kullan beshacharit befayis shelishi veze shezzacha bah shacharit maktirah ben haarbayim:

Beshabbat sheyyesh sham temidin umusafin ushene beziche levona ketzad hem ovdin. mefisin beshachar anshe oto bet av shel mishmar hayyotze umakrivin tamid shel shachar ushene kivse ola shel musafin. vechol shezzacha baavoda meavodat hattamid shel shachar hu zoche bah bishne kivse musaf. vehammishmar haacher shennichnas beshabbat mefisin peyasot acherot letamid shel ben haarbayim. veellu veellu cholkin belechem happanim:
Veen ochlin et hallechem ad sheyyaktiru shene beziche levona al haesh. vehallevona teuna melach kishar hakkarbanot:
Veachar karban hammusafin maktirin shene habbezichin. ushene kohanim makrivin et shene habbezichin:

Ketzad cholkin lechem happanim bechol shabbetot hashshana. mishmar hannichnas notel shesh challot. umishmar hayyotze notel shesh. hannichnasin cholkin benehem batztzafon shehare hen muchanim laavoda. vehayyotzin cholkin baddarom. uvizman sheyyihye yom tov shel echad mishshelosha regalim beshabbat vechen beshabbat shebbetoch hechag cholkin kol hammishmarot beshave belechem happanim. vechen im chal yom tov harishon shel chag beshabbat cholkin kol hammishmarot beshave meerev yom tov shehu shabbat belechem happanim mippene shehikdimu laavoda. vechen im chal yom tov haacharon lihyot beerev shabbat cholkin kol hammishmarot beshave belechem happanim beotah shabbat shehi motzae hechag. vedavar ze takkana kede sheyyitacharu hakkohanim bishvil chilluk lechem happanim veim nitacher echad mibbaale mishmar velo ba yimmatze acher:

Chal yom echad lehafesik ben hashshabbat uven yom tov kegon shehaya yom tov harishon shel chag besheni o yom tov haacharon bachamishi o yom shel atzeret shechal lihyot besheni o bachamishi. mishmar shezzemanno kavua beotah shabbat notel eser challot veze hannichnas notel shetayim. shehare lo nishar lahem laavoda hem levaddam ella yom echad shehu erev shabbat o echad beshabbat umitatztzelin veen bain mehen ella meat:

Kohen gadol leolam notel mikkol mishmar chatzi hachallot shezzacha bahen shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 24 9)</small> "vehayta leaharon ulevanav" mechetza leaharon umechetza levanav. veen kohen gadol notel peras sheen ze kevodo:
Mitzvat ase lesadder lechem happanim bechol yom shabbat al hashshulchan lifne Adonai bahechol shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 24 8)</small> "beyom hashshabbat beyom hashshabbat yaarchennu" vegomer:

Vedavar barur battora shehu shetem esre challot kol challa shene esronim. veorchin oto shene sedarim. shesh challot bechol seder. challa al gabbe challa uven kol shete challot shelosha kanim shel zahav kede shettihye haruach menashshevet bo. vesomech kol maaracha bishte kesavot. venotnin betzad kol maaracha keli sheyyesh bo kometz levona shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 24 7)</small> "venatatta al hammaarechet levona zakka". ucheli ze hu hannikra bazach. nimtzeu shene kumtze levona bishne habbezichin. veshulayim hayu labbezichin kede sheyyannichum al hashshulchan:

Shene hassedarim meakkevin ze et ze. ushene habbezichin meakkevin ze et ze. vehassedarin vehabbezichin meakkevin ze et ze. veen mechannechin et hashshulchan ella belechem happanim beshabbat. miyyom hashshabbat leyom hashshabbat motziin et hallechem shehu sham al hashshulchan mishshabbat sheavra umesadderin lechem acher. veze shemmotziin hu shecholkin shete hammishmarot hannichneset vehayyotzet im kohen gadol veochlin oto:

Vechetzad mesadderin et hallechem. arbaa kohanim nichnasim. shenayim beyadan shene sedarin. ushenayim beyadam shene bezichin. vearbaa makdimin lifnehem shenayim littol shene sedarim ushenayim littol shene bezichin shehayu sham al hashshulchan. hannichnasin omdin batztzafon ufenehem laddarom. vehayyotzin omdim baddarom ufenehem latztzafon. ellu moshchin veellu mannichin vetifcho shel ze betoch tifcho shel ze shenneemar <small>(Shemot 25 30)</small> "lefanay tamid":

Yatzu venatnu et hallechem shehotziu al shulchan zahav achar shehaya baulam vehiktiru habbezichin. veachar kach mechallekin hachallot. veim chal yom hakkippurim lihyot beshabbat hachallot mitchallekot laerev:

Ketzad maase lechem happanim. mevi arba veesrim seim chittim haruyin limnachot. veshafin otam uvoatin bahen kishar chitte menachot. vetochanin otan umenappin mehen beachat esre nafa arbaa veesrim issaron solet. veosin mehem shetem esre challot matztzot. lo nippa otam beachat esre nafa o shello hotzian meesrim vearba seim hoil venaasu solet mikkol makom kesherot. lo neemru hashshiurin haellu ella lemitzva:
Lishatan vaarichatan bachutz vaafiyyatan bifnim baazara kishar hammenachot. velashin otan achat achat. veofin otan shetayim shetayim:
Ushelosha defusin shel zahav hayu lahem. echad shennotnin bo hachalla vehi batzek. vehashsheni sheofin otah bo. vehashshelishi shennotnin otah bo kesherode otah min hattannur kede shello titkalkel:

Kol challa mehen merubbaat shenneemar <small>(Shemot 25 30)</small> "lechem happanim" sheyyihyu lo panim rabbim. orech kol challa mehen asara tefachim. verachbah chamishsha tefachim. verumah sheva etzbaot. vehashshulchan arko shenem asar tefach verachbo shishsha tefachim. noten orech hachalla al rochav hashshulchan nimtzet hachalla yotzet shene tefachim mikkan ushene tefachim mikkan. vechofel et hayyotze mikkan umikkan veyishshaer ben shene hakketzavot revach baemtza. vechen manniach challa al gabbe challa ad sheorech shesh challot. vechen ose betzad hammaaracha sheniyya shesh challot:

En afiyyat lechem happanim docha et hashshabbat velo et yom tov. ella beerev shabbat ofin otan veorchin otan lemachar. veim chalu shene yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana lihyot bachamishi uveerev shabbat ofin otan miyyom revii:
Lo siddur hakkanim velo netilatan doche et hashshabbat. ella meerev shabbat nichnas veshomtan venotnan leorech hashshulchan. uveechad beshabbat nichnas umachnis et hakkanim ben hachallot:

Sidder hallechem beshabbat kemitzvato velo hinniach immo beziche levona ad lemachar uleshabbat habbaa hiktir habbezichin nifsal hallechem veeno kadosh. vechen im sidder hallechem vehabbezichin beechad beshabbat vehiktir habbezichin leachar shabbat habbaa hallechem eno kadosh venifsal. aval im hiktir habbezichin beshabbat [lo] nifsal hallechem:

Ketzad yaase belechem uvezichin shessidderan leachar hashshabbat. yannichem sham al hashshulchan ad sheyyaavor alehen yom hashshabbat vehen mesuddarin. veachar kach yaktir habbezichin leshabbat habbaa achar hashshabbat sheavra alehen vehen mesuddarin. sheafillu nishar hallechem im habbezichin al hashshulchan kamma shabbatot en bechach kelum:

Sidder et hallechem veet habbezichin beshabbat kemitzvatan vehiktir et habbezichin leachar hashshabbat ben leachar shabbat zo ben leachar shabbat acheret habbaa nifsal hallechem. vahare hu kekadashim shennifselu shechayyavin alehen mishshum piggul venotar vetame kemo sheyyitbaer:

Nifresa challa achat min hallechem. im ad shello hesir hallechem meal hashshulchan nifresa hallechem pasul veeno maktir alav et habbezichin. veim achar shehesir hallechem nifresa hallechem pasul umaktir alav et habbezichin:

Higgia zeman hallechem lahasiro hare ze kemi shehesiro. veim nifras hallechem maktir habbezichin veaf al pi shello perek hammaaracha. nitma echad min hassedarin ben lifne haketara ben leachar haketara o shennitma echad min habbezichin. hattame betumato vehattahor betohorato:

Seder avodot hattemidot bechol yom kach hu. samuch laalot hashshachar yavo hamemunne sheal happeyasot veyakkish al haazara ufotchin lo. umevalleshin et kol haazara. umaamidin ose chavitin laasot hachavitin. vechol hakkohanim sheshsham kevar tavlu kodem sheyyavo hamemunne velavshu bigde kehunna. veyavou veyaamdu belishkat haggazit. veyafisu payis rishon vesheni veyizke kol echad bimlachto kemo shebbearnu. umatchil ze shezzacha bitrumat haddeshen vetorem al hasseder sheamarnu. veachar kach mesadder maaracha gedola. veachar kach mesadder maaracha sheniyya. veachar kach maale shene gizre etzim umannichan al maaracha gedola leharebot haesh. veachar kach nichnasin lelishkat hakkelim umotziin kol kele hashsharet hatztzerichin lahen kol hayyom. umashkin et hattamid mayim veze shezzacha bishchitato moshcho levet hammitbachayim. veholchin acharav hakkohanim shezzachu lehaalot haevarim veshohin sham ad sheppotchin shaar hahechol haggadol. uvishat petichat hashshaar shochatin et hattamid. veachar kach nichnasin lahechol shene kohanim. haechad shezzacha bedishshun hammizbeach happenimi vehashsheni shezzacha bedishshun hammenora:
Vehamedashshen et hammizbeach medashsheno beshaa shehashshochet shochet et hattamid. veachar kach zorek haddam ze shekkibbelo:

Veachar shezzorkin et haddam metiv ze shebbahechol chamesh nerot veyotzin shenehen min hahechol. veellu shebbevet hammitbachayim mafshitin umenattechin vechol echad veechad maale evar shezzacha bo lakkevesh. venotnin haevarim mechatzi kevesh ulematta bemaaravo. veshel musafin hayu notnin otan mechatzi kevesh ulematta bemizracho. veshel rashe chodashim notnin al hammizbeach millemala ben keren lekeren bimkom hilluch ragle hakkohanim kede lefarsemo shehu rosh chodesh. umolchin sham et haevarim vezorkin melach al gabbe hakkevesh afillu beshabbat. kede shello yachlik veyippelu hakkohanim sham beet halichatan baetzim lammaaracha. veaf al pi shehammelach chotzetz ben raglehem uven hakkevesh hoil veen haholacha hazzot avoda enan choshshin:

Veachar shemmaalin haevarim lakkevesh mitkannesin kullan lelishkat haggazit. vehamemunne omer lahem barchu beracha achat. vehen potchin vekorin ahavat olam vaaseret haddibberot ushema vehaya im shamoa vayyomer veemet veyatztziv uretze vesim shalom. uveshabbat mosifin beracha achat vehi sheyyomru anshe mishmar hayyotze leanshe mishmar hannichnas. mi sheshshikken et shemo babbayit hazze yashkin benechem ahava achva shalom vereut. veachar kach mefisin payis shelishi urevii vezoche bakketoret mi shezzacha venichnas umaktir. veachar kach nichnas ze shezzacha bedishshun hammenora umetiv shete hannerot veyotze ze shehiktir im medashshen hammenora. veomed al maalot haulam hu veechav hakkohanim:

Kesheyyaggia ben haulam velammizbeach. natal echad hammagrefa uzerakah ben haulam lammizbeach. vehaya lah kol gadol. ushelosha devarim hayta meshammeshet bahen. hashshomea et kolah haya yodea sheechav hakkohanim nichnasin lehishtachavot vehu ratz uva. uven levi hashshomea et kolah haya yodea sheechav haleviyyim nichnasin ledabber beshir vehu ratz uva. verosh hammaamad keshehaya shomea et kolah haya maamid et hattemeim al shaar hammizrach mippene hachashad. sheyyedu hakkol sheadayin lo heviu kapparatan. veachar kach maale ze shezzacha baevarim et haevarim min hakkevesh lammizbeach. veachar shemmaalin et haevarim. matchilin ellu sheal maalot haulam umevarchin birkat kohanim beracha achat bashshem hameforash kemo shebbearnu bimkomah. veachar kach maalin solet hannesachim. veachar hassolet maktir hachavitin. veachar hachavitin maalin et hayyayin lenissuch. uvishat hannissuch omrin haleviyyim hashshir. umakkin hameshorrin bemine niggun shebbammikdash vetokin tesha tekiot al pirke hashshir:

Keshehayu notnin hayyayin lamnassech. hayu shene kohanim omdin al shulchan hachalavim ushete chatzotzrot beyadan. vehassegan omed al keren hammizbeach vehassudarin beyado. vetaku veheriu vetaku. uvau veamdu etzel ze hamemunne al hatztziltzal. echad mimino veechad missemolo:

Shacha hamenassech lenassech. menif hassegan besudarin. hikkish ze batztziltzal vetaku ellu bachatzotzrot vedibberu haleviyyim beshir. higgiu leferek taku vehishtachavu kol haam shebbaazara. al kol perek tekia veal kol tekia hishtachavaya. vechol hattekiot sheal hattamid tesha kemo shebbearnu:

En omrin shira ella al olot hatztzibbur vezivche shalmehem haamurin battora. aval olot nedava shemmakrivin mimmotar terumat hallishka af al pi shehen shel tzibbur en omrin shira alehen. vechen nesachim habbain bifne atzman en omrin alehen shira:

Hashshir shehayu haleviyyim omrin. bayyom harishon hayu omrin <small>(Tehillim 24 1)</small> "laAdonai haaretz umeloah". bashsheni hayu omrin <small>(Tehillim 48 2)</small> "gadol Adonai umehullal meod beir elohenu har kadsho" vegomer. bashshelishi hayu omrin <small>(Tehillim 82 1)</small> "elohim nitztzav baadat el bekerev elohim yishpot". birvii hayu omrin <small>(Tehillim 94 1)</small> "el nekamot Adonai el nekamot hofia". bachamishi hayu omrin <small>(Tehillim 81 2)</small> "hareninu lelohim uzzenu hariu lelohe yaakov". bashshishshi hayu omrin <small>(Tehillim 93 1)</small> "Adonai malach geut lavesh lavesh Adonai oz hitazzar" vegomer. beshabbat hayu omrin <small>(Tehillim 92 1)</small> "mizmor shir leyom hashshabbat". bemusefe shabbat omrim shirat <small>(Devarim 32 1)</small> "haazinu" vecholkin otah leshishsha perakim hazziv lach kederech shekkorin otah shishsha bevet hakkeneset. veomrin perek bechol shabbat. gamru hashshira beshishsha shabbatot chozrin larosh. bemincha shel shabbat omer <small>(Shemot 15 1)</small> "az yashir mshe" u<small>(Shemot 15 11)</small> "mi chamocha" vegomer. bemusaf shel rosh hashshana hayu omrin hareninu lelohim uzzenu. veim chal lihyot bachamishi omer <small>(Tehillim 81 7)</small> "hasiroti missevel shichmo" vegomer. bemincha shel rosh hashshana hayu omrim <small>(Tehillim 29 8)</small> "kol Adonai yachil midbar" vegomer:
Rosh chodesh shechal lihyot beshabbat shira shel rosh chodesh doche et shira shel shabbat kede lefarsem shehayyom rosh chodesh:

Beshabbat maktirin et shene beziche levona im hammusafin. kodem nissuch hayyayin shel musafin. vechasseder sheosin bechol yom babboker kach osin ben haarbayim. chutz meharamat haddeshen mimmizbeach hachitzon vesiddur hammaarachot vehappeyasot. sheen osin devarim ellu ella bechol yom bashshachar levad kemo shebbearnu:

Verashe chodashim makrivin musaf rosh chodesh achar tamid shel shachar. vechamma hu musaf rosh chodesh. parim shenayim veayil echad veshiva kevasim hakkol olot. useir izzim chattat:
Maase kol haolot echad hu kemaase hattamid. umaase hachattaot shel rashe chodashim veshel moadot kemaase hachattat hanneechelet shebbearnu:
Befesach makrivin karban musaf bechol yom. miyyom harishon ad yom hashshevii kemusaf rashe chodashim. parim shenayim veayil echad veshiva kevasim hakkol olot useir chattat hanneechelet. beyom sheni shel pesach shehu yom shishsha asar benisan makrivin yeter al musaf shel kol yom keves leola im omer hattenufa. vehi mincha shel tzibbur kemo shebbearnu:
Uzemanno kavua ulefichach doche et hashshabbat veet hattuma:
En meviin mincha zo ella meeretz yisrael shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 10)</small> "vahavetem et omer reshit ketzirchem el hakkohen". mitzvato lavo min hakkarov. lo ba min hakkarov meviin otah mikkol makom meeretz yisrael:
Mitzvato lehikkatzer ballayla belel shishsha asar. ben bechol ben beshabbat:
Vechol hallayla kasher liktzirat haomer. veim ketzaruhu bayyom kasher:
Mitzvato lavo min hakkama. lo matzu yaviu min hoomarim:
Mitzvato lavo min hallach. lo matzu yaviu min hayyavesh:
Darkan haya lehavi missadot shebbaddarom. haya nar chatzi hassade vezorea chetzyah beshana zo uveshana acheret nar chatzi hassade shezzara vezorea hachetzi shennar umevi mimmennu:
Omer ze min hasseorim haya ba. vedavar ze halacha mimmoshe rabbenu. vechetzad haya naase. meerev yom tov yotzin sheluche bet din veosin oto kerichot bimchubbar lakkarka kede sheyyihye noach liktzor. kol haayarot hassemuchot lesham mitkannesot kede sheyyihye niktzar beesek gadol. vekotzrin shalosh sein seorin bishlosha anashim. uveshalosh kuppot. uvishlosha maggalot. kevan shechashcha omer lahem hakkotzer lechol haomdim sham. ba hashshemesh omrin lo hin. ba hashshemesh omrim lo hin. ba hashshemesh omrin lo hin. maggal ze omrin lo hin. maggal ze omrin lo hin. maggal ze omrin lo hin. kuppa zo omrin lo hin. kuppa zo omrin lo hin. kuppa zo omrin lo hin. veim haya shabbat omer lahen shabbat hayyom omrim lo hin. shabbat hayyom omrin lo hin. shabbat hayyom omrin lo hin. veachar kach omer lahen ektzor vehen omrin lo ketzor. ektzor vehem omrim lo ketzor. ektzor vehem omrim lo ketzor. shalosh peamim al kol davar vedavar. vechol kach lamma mippene ellu hattoim sheyyatzu mikkelal yisrael bevayit sheni. shehen omrin shezze shenneemar battora <small>(Vayikra 23 11)</small> <small>(Vayikra 23 15 16)</small> "mimmochorat hashshabbat" hu shabbat bereshit. umippi hashshemua lamdu sheenah shabbat ella yom tov vechen rau tamid hanneviim vehassanhedrin bechol dor vedor shehayu menifin et haomer beshishsha asar benisan ben bechol ben beshabbat. vahare neemar battora <small>(Vayikra 23 14)</small> "velechem vekali vecharmel lo tochlu ad etzem hayyom hazze". veneemar <small>(Yehoshua 5 11)</small> "vayyochlu meavur haaretz mimmochorat happesach matztzot vekaluy". veim tomar sheoto happesach beshabbat era kemo sheddimmu hattippeshim. heach tala hakkatuv hetter achilatam lechadash bedavar sheeno haikkar velo hassibba ella nikra nikre. ella meachar shettala haddavar bemochorat happesach haddavar barur shemmochorat happesach hi hailla hammatteret et hechadash veen mashgichin al e ze yom hu mime hashshavua: 
Ketzaruhu unetanuhu bekuppot veheviuhu laazara vachavatuhu. vezorin uvorrin. velokchin et hasseorin umehavhavin oto baur. beabbuv menukkav. kede sheyyihye haesh sholet bechullan shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 2 14)</small> "aviv kaluy baesh geres karmel". mippi hashshemua lamdu sheeno medabber ella beminchat haomer bilvad. veachar shekkolin oto shotchin oto baazara veharuach menashshevet bo. venotnin oto lerechayim shel garosot vetochanin et hashshalosh sein umotziin min hakkol issaron shehu menuppe bishlosh esre nafa. vehashshear nifde veneechol lechol adam. vechayyav bechalla ufatur min hammaasrot kemo shebbearnu. velokchin ze haissaron shel solet hasseorim uvollin oto belog shemen beshishsha asar benisan venotnin alav kometz levona kishar hammenachot. umenifo bammizrach molich umevi maale umorid umaggisho keneged chuddah shel keren maaravit deromit kishar hammenachot. vekometz umaktir. vehashshear neechol lakkohanim kishyare kol hammenachot. vematay komtzin oto. leachar shemmakrivin musaf hayyom vecheves haola kodem tamid shel ben haarbayim:
Asur liktzor beeretz yisrael min mechameshet mine tevua kodem liktzirat haomer shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 10)</small> "reshit ketzirchem" sheyyihye techilla lechol hanniktzarim. bamme devarim amurim bekatzir sherauy lehavi mimmennu omer. aval bet hashshelachin shebbaamakim hoil veeno rauy lehavi mimmennu kotzrin oto millifne haomer. aval lo yigdosh:
Tevua shehishrisha kodem haomer haomer mattirah. veim lav asur lekatzrah kederech sheasur leachlah ad sheyyavo haomer habba:
Tevua shello hevia shelish muttar liktzor mimmenna lehaachil livhema. vekotzrin mippene hannetiot shello yippasdu. vekotzrin lefannot makom levet haavel o levet hammidrash. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 10)</small> "ketzirchem" velo ketzir mitzva:
Veaf al pi shemmuttar liktzor lo yaase otan kerichot kederech hakkotzrin. ella yannichem tzevatim tzevatim:
Kevar bearnu sheen meviin menachot velo minchat nesachim velo bikkurim min hechadash kodem havaat haomer. veim hevi pasul. velo yavi kodem lahavaat shete hallechem. veim hevi kasher:
Vechol hammakriv mincha min hechadash techilla mevarech shehecheyaynu:
Tevua shezzeraah achar shekkarav haomer uketzarah achar shekkarav haomer shel shana habbaa hare zo safek im meviin mimmenna menachot lechattechilla terem havaat shete hallechem hoil utevua zo avar aleha havaat shete hallechem uketzirat haomer. o en meviin ad sheyyaviu shete hallechem achar havaat haomer shel shana acheret:
Vechen tevua shehayta bakkarka vechantu aleha o henetztzu alim shellah kesheheviu shete hallechem hare ze safek im hanatzat healin o chanatatan kemo hushresha vehuttera lehavi mimmenna menachot o enah chashuva hasherasha. lefichach lo yavi veim hevi hurtza:
Vehakkotzer kodem ketzirat haomer eno loke vehakkatzir kasher:
Mitzvat ase lispor sheva shabbatot temimot miyyom havaat haomer shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 15)</small> "usefartem lachem mimmochorat hashshabbat" "sheva shabbatot". umitzva limnot hayyamim im hashshavuot shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 16)</small> "tisperu chamishshim yom". umittechillat hayyom monin lefichach mone ballayla millel shishsha asar benisan: 
Shachach velo mana ballayla mone bayyom veen monin ella meummad. veim mana meyushshav yatza:
Mitzva zo al kol ish miyyisrael uvechol makom uvechol zeman. venashim vaavadim peturin mimmenna:
Vetzarich levarech bechol layla baruch atta Adonai elokenu melech haolam asher kidshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al sefirat haomer kodem sheyyispor. mana velo berech yatza veeno chozer umevarech:

Beyom chamishshim missefirat haomer. hu chag hashshavuot. vehu atzeret. uvayyom hazze makrivin musaf kemo musaf rosh chodesh shene parim veayil veshiva kevasim kullam olot useir chattat. veellu hen hakkarbanot haamurot bechummash happekudim vehem musaf hayyom. veod meviin yeter al hammusaf bayyom hazze mincha chadasha shete hallechem umakrivin im hallechem par ushene elim veshiva kevasim. hakkol olot. useir chattat. ushene kevasim zevach shelamim. veellu hen hakkarbanot haamurot bechummash vayyikra. nimtza hakkarev beyom ze yeter al shene hattemidin shelosha parim ushelosha elim vearbaa asar kevasim. hakkol esrim behema olot. ushene seire chattaot neechalim. ushene kevasim shelamim neechalim:
Shete hallechem enan bain ella min haaretz umin hechadash shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 17)</small> "mimmoshvotechem taviu lechem tenufa" vegomer. lo matzu chadash yaviu min haaliyya:

Chittim sheyyardu beavim yesh bahem safek im ani kore bahem <small>(Vayikra 23 17)</small> "mimmoshvotechem" o enam mimmoshvotechem lefichach lo yavi veim hevi kasher. vechetzad hayu osin. meviin shalosh sein chittin chadashot veshafin otan uvoatin bahem kederech kol hammenachot vetochanin otan solet umenappin mehen shene esronot menuppe bishtem esre nafa vehashshear nifde veneechol lechol adam. vechayyav bechalla ufatur min hammaasrot kemo shebbearnu:

Shete hallechem shehen min hechadash tzerichin lavo issaron mikkol sea umechetza umenappin otan bishtem esre nafa. velechem happanim shehu ba min hayyashan day lo beachat esre nafa vehu ba issaron mikkol sea. aval haomer shehu ba min hasseorim chadashot eno ba min hammuvchar ella mishshalosh sein uvishlosh asara nafa:
Vechullam im ribba bemiddat hassein shebbain mehen o miet kasher:
Velokchin shene haesronot velashin otan achat achat veofin otan achat achat:
Velishatan vaarichatan bachutz vaafiyyatan bifnim kechol hammenachot:
Veen asiyyatan docha yom tov veen tzarich lomar shabbat ella ofin otan meerev yom tov shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 16)</small> "hu levaddo yease lachem" lachem velo legavoah:

Haya erev yom tov shabbat ofin otan meerev shabbat veneechalot bashshelishi laafiyyatan shehu yom tov. vahare meforash battora shehem chametz. vechetzad ose. mevi seor mimmakom acher venotno letoch haissaron umemalle haissaron solet umechammetzo beoto hasseor:
Umerubbaot hen. orech kol challa shiva tefachim verachbah arbaa tefachim vegavhah arba etzbaot:

Ketzad hanafat hallechem im shene kivse hashshelamim. mevi shene hakkevasim umenifam beodan chayyim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 14 12)</small> "vehenif otam tenufa". veim henif ze bifne atzmo veze bifne atzmo yatza. veachar kach shochatin otan umafshit. velokeach chaze veshok mikkol echad mishshenehem umannichan betzad shete hallechem umeniach shete yadav millemattan umenif hakkol keechad bammizrach bimkom kol hattenufot. molich umevi. maale umorid. veim henifan echad echad yatza. veachar kach maktir emure shene hakkevasim ushear habbasar neechol lakkohanim. vechen shete hachallot notel kohen gadol achat mehen. vehashsheniyya mitchalleket lechol hammishmarot. ushetehen neechalot oto hayyom vachatzi hallayla kivsar kadshe kadashim:

Shachat shene kevasim al arba challot. im amar yikkadshu shetayim mittoch arba moshech shetayim mehen umenifan. vehashshear podin otan bifnim veneechalin bachutz kishar hachullin. veim lo hitna lo kadash hallechem:
Shachat arbaa kevasim al shete challot. moshech shenayim mehem vezorek daman shello lishman. umenif hashshenayim hannisharim hakkesherim im shete hallechem:
Shete hachallot meakkevot zo et zo. ushene hakkevasim meakkevin ze et ze. met echad mishshenehem o barach o naasa terefa. yikkach zug lesheni. shachat echad lishmo. yikkach lo zug:

Shete hallechem meakkevim et hakkevasim. ushene hakkevasim enan meakkevim et hallechem. veim hunefu im hakkevasim meakkevin ze et ze. veim avad hallechem yovdu hakkevasim veim avdu hakkevasim yovdu hallechem veyaviu lechem acher uchevasim acherim:

Shete hallechem habbaot bifne atzman belo kevasim ketzad osin bahen. yunefu uteubbar tzuratan veyetzu levet hasserefa gezera shemma yimtzeu kevasim leshana habbaa veyaviu lechem belo kevasim. happar ushene haelim veshivat hakkevasim vehassair habbaim beyom ze biglal hallechem enan meakkevin et hallechem velo hallechem meakkevan:
Shene parim shel musaf hayyom ufar habba biglal hallechem enan meakkevin ze et ze:
Ayil shel musaf hayyom ushene elim habbain biglal hallechem enan meakkevin (ze et ze):
Shiva kevasim shel musaf hayyom veshiva kevasim habbaim biglal hallechem enan meakkevin ze et ze. veim nishchatu kullan meakkevin ze et ze:

Hattemidin enam meakkevin et hammusafin velo hammusafin meakkevin et hattemidin velo hammusafin meakkevin ze et ze velo minyan haolot kullan meakkev. ketzad. hare shello matzu ella shishsha kevasim makrivin shishsha afillu lo matzu ella echad makrivin oto ben berashe chodashim ben bime hammoadot vehashshabbatot. veenan chayyavin lehakeriv hashshear lemachar o lemoed acher ella kol karban tzibbur sheavar zemanno batel karbano. lo matzu ella shene kevasim im yakrivu otan lemusaf hayyom en lahen temidin lemachar. hare haddavar shakul im hikrivum lemusaf hayyom hikrivu veim ratzu lehannicham lemachar litmidin yannichu:

Beechad betishre makrivin musaf hayyom par veayil veshiva kevasim hakkol olot useir chattat hanneechelet. veze musaf hayyom yeter al musaf rosh chodesh hakkarev bechol rosh chodesh. lefichach im chal lihyot beshabbat hayu sham shelosha musafin musaf shabbat umusaf rosh chodesh umusaf hayyom:

Vechetzad siddur hakeravatan. musaf shabbat techilla veacharav musaf hachodesh veacharav musaf yom tov. shekkol hattadir mechavero kodem et chavero vechen kol hamekuddash mechavero kodem et chavero. haya lefanav tadir umekuddash yakdim eze mehem sheyyirtze:
Avar o shachach veshachat et sheeno tadir o happachut bikdushsha techilla makrivo veachar kach shochet et hattadir o et hamekuddash:
Veim nishchatu shenehem keechad yihye ze memares baddam ad sheyyizrok dam hattadir o dam hamekuddash:

Dam hachattat kodem ledam haola mippene sheddam hachattat mechapper. evre ola kodmin leemure chattat mippene shehaola kullah laishshim. dam chattat veevre ola e ze sheyyirtze yakdim. vechen dam ola veemure chattat o dam ola vedam asham e ze sheyyirtze yakdim:

Chattat kodemet leola afillu chattat haof kodemet leolat behema shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 8)</small> "et asher lachattat rishona" binyan av lechol chattat shehi kodemet leola habba immah. vechen bishat haferasha mafrish hachattat techilla veachar kach haola:

Bekarbenot hechag eno chen ella kerevin al seder hakkatuv shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 29 6)</small> <small>(Bamidbar 29 33)</small> "kemishpatam". ketzad. battechilla parim. veacharehem elim. veacharehem kevasim. veacharehem seirim. af al pi shehasseirim chattat vechol ellu shekkadmu otan olot. vechen beshiggat tzibbur baavoda zara shehen meviin par ola vesair chattat. happar kodem shenneemar bo <small>(Bamidbar 15 24)</small> "kammishpat". ufar kohen mashiach kodem lefar helem davar shel tzibbur. ufar helem kodem lefar avoda zara. ufar avoda zara kodem lesair shellah. af al pi shehappar ola vehassair chattat. shekkach hu seder hakkatuv battora. seir avoda zara kodem lisir nasi shehannasi yachid. useir nasi kodem lisirat yachid. useirat yachid kodemet lechavsa. af al pi sheshshenehem chattat. shehasseira reuya lavo al hakkeretot shemmeviin alehem chattat. vehakkavsa enah baa al shiggat avoda zara:

Afillu chattat haof shel yoledet kodemet lechavsa. chattat kodemet leasham mippene sheddamah nittan al arba keranot veal hayesod. vechol chattaot shebbattora kodmin lechol haashamot. chutz measham metzora mippene shehu ba al yede hechsher. haasham kodem letoda uleel nazir mippene shehu kadshe kadashim. toda veel nazir kodmin lishlamim mippene shehen neechalin leyom echad uteunin lechem. vehattoda kodemet leel nazir mippene sheyyesh bah arbaa mine mincha. shelamim kodmin livchor mippene shehen teunin mattan shetayim shehen kearba uteunin semicha utenufa unesachim. habbechor kodem lemasar behema mippene shekkedushshato merechem veneechol lakkohanim bilvad. hammaaser kodmin leofot mippene shehu zevach veyesh bo kadshe kadashim damo veemurav. vehaofot kodmin limnachot mippene shehen mine damim. hare shehayu lefanav chattat haof umaaser. hammaaser kodem mippene shehu zevach. hayu sham chattat haof umaaser veolat behema hoil veola kodemet lemaaser vechattat haof kodemet leolat behema makriv chattat haof techilla veachar kach haola veachar kach hammaaser:

Hare shehayu mine behema harebe mimmin karban echad ketzad hen kerevin. happarim kodmin leelim shekken nitrabbu binsachim. veelim kodmin lichvasim shekken nitrabbu binsachim. uchevasim kodmin lisirim shekken nitrabbu beemurim. shebbichlal emure kevasim haalya veen bisirim alya. haomer kodem lakkeves habba immo. ushete hallechem kodmin lishne kevasim. ze hakkelal davar habba biglal hayyom kodem ledavar habba biglal hallechem:

Minchat haish kodemet leminchat haishsha. minchat chittim kodemet leminchat seorim. minchat chote kodemet leminchat nedava mippene shehi baa al chet. minchat nedava uminchat sota e zo sheyyirtze mehem yakdim:

Menachot kodmin layyayin. vehayyayin kodem lashshemen. vehashshemen kodem lallevona. ulevona kodemet lammelach. umelach kodem laetzim. ematay bizman shebbau kullan keechad. aval habba rishon karev rishon vehabba acharon karev acharon:
Kol hakkodem behakerava kodem baachila:

Hayu lefanav shelamim shel emesh ushelamim shel yom. shel emesh kodmin shehare karav zemannan. shelamim shel emesh vechattat o asham shel yom. chattat veasham kodmin mippene shehen kadshe kadashim kemo shebbearnu:

Beyom hakkippurim makrivin musaf kemusaf rosh hashshana par veayil. veayil ze nikra el haam. veshiva kevasim kullan olot. useir chattat vehu neechol laerev:
Veod makrivin hatztzibbur seir chattat vehu nisraf shebben zugo sair hammishtalleach:
Bayyom harishon shel chag hassukkot makrivin musaf hayyom shelosha asar parim ushene elim vearbaa asar kevasim kullan olot useir chattat neechelet. vechen kol yom veyom mishshivat yeme hechag makrivin shene elim vearbaa asar kevasim useir chattat:
Aval happarim pochatin echad echad bechol yom. bashsheni makrivin shenem asar. bashshelishi achad asar. ad sheyyimmatze karban yom shevii parim shiva elim shenayim kevasim arbaa asar hakkol olot useir chattat:
Bayyom hashshemini atzeret makrivin musaf hayyom par veayil veshiva kevasim kullan olot useir chattat. veze musaf bifne atzmo:
Kol shivat yeme hechag menassechin et hammayim al gabbe hammizbeach. vedavar ze halacha lemoshe missinay. veim nissuch hayyayin shel tamid shel shachar haya menassech hammayim levaddo:
Veim era hammayim letoch hayyayin o hayyayin letoch hammayim venissech shenehem mikkeli echad yatza. veim hikdim nissuch hammayim lazevach afillu nissechan ballayla yatza. uvekeren deromit maaravit haya menassech lemala mechatzi hammizbeach vehakkol yored lashshitin kemo shebbearnu. ketzad hayu osin. tzelochit shel zahav machzeket shelosha login haya memalle otah min hashshiloach. higgiu leshaar hammayim taku veheriu vetaku. ala lakkevesh ufana lismolo venoten hammayim min hatztzelochit letoch hassefel shehaya sham. ushene sefalim shel kesef hayu sham. maaravi haya bo hammayim. umizrachi haya bo hayyayin shel nesech. vehayu menukkavin kemin shene chotamin dakkin. veshel mayim haya nekev shello dak mishshel yayin kede sheyyichle hammayim im hayyayin keechad:
Ze shemmenassech hammayim hayu omrin lo hagebeah yadcha. sheppaam achat nissech echad al raglav uregamuhu kol haam beetrogehen sheamru tzedoki hu shehen omrin en menassechin mayim:
Kemaasehu bechol kach maasehu beshabbat. ella shehaya memalle meerev shabbat chavit shel zahav veenah mikkele hashsharet umannichah ballishka ulemachar memalle mimmenna:
Im nishpecha o nitgalleta memalle min hakkiyyor umenassech:
Bechol yom veyom mime hechag hayu omrim shira bifne atzmah al musaf hayyom. barishon mime chullo shel moed hayu omrin <small>(Tehillim 29 1)</small> "havu laAdonai bene elim". bashsheni <small>(Tehillim 50 16)</small> "velarasha amar elohim" vegomer. bashshelishi <small>(Tehillim 94 16)</small> "mi yakum li im mereim". barvii <small>(Tehillim 94 8)</small> "binu boarim baam" vegomer. bachamishi <small>(Tehillim 81 7)</small> "hasiroti missevel shichmo". bashshishshi <small>(Tehillim 82 5)</small> "yimmotu kol mosde aretz" vegomer. veim chal shabbat lihyot beechad mehen yimmotu yiddache: 
Kevar bearnu shekkol mishmerot kehunna esrim vearbaa. vechullan ovdin beshave bargalim. uvechag hassukkot haya kol mishmar makriv par echad o ayil echad o seir hachattat. aval hakkevasim yesh mishmar shemmakriv mehen shene kevasim. veyesh mishmar shemmakriv keves echad. ketzad. beyom tov harishon shel chag hayu sham shelosha asar parim ushene elim vesair. kol mishmar makriv behema achat mehem. nisharu sham arbaa asar kevasim lishmone mishmarot. shishsha mishmarot makrivin shenayim shenayim ushene mishmarot makrivin echad echad. bashsheni hayu sham shenem asar parim ushene elim vesair. kol mishmar makriv echad. nisharu sham arbaa asar kevasim letisha mishmarot. chamishsha makrivin shenayim shenayim. vearbaa makrivin echad echad. bashshelishi hayu sham achad asar parim ushene elim vesair. kol mishmar makriv echad. nisharu arbaa asar kevasim laasara mishmarot. arbaa makrivin shenayim shenayim veshishsha makrivin echad echad. barvii hayu sham asara parim ushene elim vesair. kol mishmar makriv echad. nisharu sham arbaa asar kevasim leachad asar mishmar. shelosha makrivin shenayim shenayim ushemona makrivin echad echad. bachamishi hayu sham tisha parim ushene elim vesair. kol mishmar makriv echad. nisharu sham arbaa asar kevasim lishnem asar mishmar. shene mishmarot makrivin shenayim shenayim vaasara makrivin echad echad. bashshishshi hayu shemona parim ushene elim vesair. kol mishmar makriv echad. nisharu sham arbaa asar kevasim lishlosha asar mishmar. mishmar echad mehen makriv shene kevasim ushenem asar mishmar makrivin echad echad. bashshevii hayu sham shiva parim ushene elim vesair. vearbaa asar kevasim keminyan hammishmarot. nimtza kol mishmar makriv behema achat:
Vechol mi shehaya makriv par hayyom lo haya makriv par lemachar ella chozrin chalila. bashshemini chozrin lefayis kullan keechad kishar hargalim kemo shebbearnu:
Beyom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihyot beshabbat haya sham minchat nesachim shel musafin veshel temidin shishshim veechad issaron velo hayu mearvin oto:
Uleolam en mearvin nesachim. ella niske happarim levaddam veniske haelim levaddam veniske kevasim levaddam. ben bekarbenot tzibbur ben bekarbenot yachid:
Vechol hachalavim shel karbanot ben karbenot tzibbur ben karbenot yachid en mearvin otan ze baze ella maktirin emure kol karban vekarban bifne atzmo. veim nitarvu maktir hakkol keechad:
Menachot shel nesachim shennitarvu zo bazo achar shennivlal kol min umin bifne atzmo kesherot:
Vechevan shennivlelu hammenachot venitarev shamnan vesaltan hare ze muttar learev yayin shellahen lechattechilla. vechen im hiktir menachot shel nesachim kol achat veachat bifne atzmah hare ze muttar learev hayyayin shellahen:
Keshemmearvin hayyayin shel nesachim yesh lo learev yen nesachim shel emesh beshel yom veshel yachid beshel tzibbur. ucheshemmearev mearev yen niske parim beyen niske elim yen niske kevasim beyen niske kevasim. aval en mearvin yen niske kevasim beyen niske parim veelim:
Uleolam en mearvin hayyayin lechattechilla ella achar shennitarva hassolet o achar shehiktiru kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrifices Rendered Unfit:
Kol happesulin laavoda muttarin lishchot kadashim lechattechilla vaafillu kadshe kadashim. chutz min hattame sheeno shochet lechattechilla. veaf al pi shehu chutz laazara ufashat yadav veshachat baazara gezera shemma yigga babbasar:
Veim avar veshachat hazzevach kasher. vechen par kohen gadol shel yom hakkippurim af al pi shenneemar bo <small>(Vayikra 16 11)</small> "veshachat aharon" im shechato zar kasher. af para adumma sheshshachat hazzar keshera sheen lecha shechita pesula bezar:
Hashshochet et hakkadashim velo nitkavven lishchita ella kemitassek. hare ellu pesulin ad sheyyitkavven lishchita:
Velo yishchot shene rashim keechad bekadashim veim shachat hare ellu kesherim:
Aval shenayim shochatin behema achat bekadashim kechullin:
Hakkatan eno shochet kadashim af al pi shehaggadol omed al gabbav. shehakkadashim tzerichin machashava vekatan en lo machashava. afillu hayta machshavto nikkeret mittoch maasav enah machashava lehakel ella lehachemir. ketzad. hayta ola omedet baddarom umeshachah hakkatan veheviah latztzafon ushechatah shehare mimmaasav nikkar shemmachshavto lishchitat kadashim hare zo pesula:
Kadshe kadashim shennishchatu baddarom o shennitkabbel damam baddarom pesulin:
Haya omed baddarom vehoshit yado latztzafon veshachat shechitato keshera:
Haya omed baddarom vehoshit yado vekibbel haddam batztzafon. kabbalato pesula:
Hichnis rosho verubbo latztzafon hare hu keomed batztzafon:
Shechatah batztzafon ufirkesa veyatzat laddarom. afillu hotziah laddarom keshera. pirkesa veyatzat laddarom vechazra latztzafon veachar kach kibbel damah batztzafon keshera. vechen kadashim kallim shehayu bifnim veamad chutz laazara vehichnis yado lefanim veshachat shechitato keshera:
Hichnis yado vekibbel kabbalato pesula afillu hichnis rosho verubbo. afillu haya haoved kullo bifnim vetzitzato bachutz avodato pesula. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 10 9)</small> "bevoachem el ohel moed" ad sheyyavou kullan:
Pirkesa habbehema veyatzat lachutz achar kabbalat damah keshera. sheafillu yatzu haemurin vehabbasar kodem zerika bekadashim kallim hazzevach kasher kemo sheyyitbaer:
Hayta habbehema kullah bifnim veragleha bachutz ushechatah hazzevach pasul. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 5)</small> "vehevium laAdonai" ad shettihye kullah bifnim:
Shechatah vehi kullah bifnim. veachar kach hotzia raglah lachutz. chotech habbasar ad shehu maggia laetzem veachar kach mekabbel haddam. veim kibbel veachar kach chatach pasul mippene shamnunit habbasar shebbachutz. uvekadashim kallim en tzarich lachtoch ella machzir raglah lefanim umekabbel. shebbesar kadashim [kallim] sheyyatza kodem zerika kasher:
Tala habbehema ushechatah baavir haazara pesula. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1 11)</small> "al yerech hammizbeach" ad sheyyishchot baaretz:
Hayta habbehema baaretz venitla veshachat vehu taluy baavir. bekadshe kadashim pasul. bekadashim kallim kasher:
Shachat miut simanim bachutz ugemaran bifnim. o sheshshachat miutan baddarom ugemaran batztzafon pesulin. sheyyeshna lashshechita mittechillatah vead sof:
Nitla vekibbel haddam mitztzavvar behema hammunnachat bakkarka pasul. sheen derech sherut bechach:
Haya omed baazara vetala hammizrak beyado vekibbel haddam baavir. o shehigbiah habbehema vekibbel haddam baavir kasher. sheavir hammakom kammakom:
Natan mizrak letoch mizrak vekibbel kasher. min bemino eno chotzetz. hinniach siv betoch hammizrak vekibbel kasher. mippene shehassiv chalul vahare haddam yored letoch hammizrak veen kan chatzitza. aval im asa ken bikmitzat hammincha vekamatz mittoch hassiv pesula:
Kabbalat haddam veholachato lammizbeach uzerikato vechen holachat evarim lakkevesh kol achat meellu enah keshera ella bechohen hakkasher laavoda kemo shebbearnu bikmitzat hammincha uvimlikat haof:
Veholacha shello baregel enah holacha. lefichach kohen gadol shekkibbel et haddam veamad bimkomo uzerako lammizbeach nifsal hazzevach:
Kibbel bimino venatan lismolo yachzir limino. kibbel bichli chol nifsal hazzevach. kibbel bichli kodesh venatan lichli chol yachzir lichli kodesh:
Nishpach min hakkeli al haritzpa vaasafo kasher. aval im nishpach mitztzavvar habbehema al haritzpa vaasafo unetano lichli hashsharet nifsal hazzevach:
Nishpach miktzat haddam mitztzavvar behema al haaretz velo asafo vekibbel miktzato mitztzavvar behema. hare ze kasher uvilvad sheyyihye ze haddam shennitkabbel dam hannefesh. lo dam hattamtzit velo dam haor:
Kol hazzevachim shekkibbel damam echad min happesulin laavoda. o sheholich et haddam lammizbeach. o shezzerako lammizbeach kehilchato. nifsal hazzevach. kibbel hakkasher venatan lefasul velo hillech bo happasul ella amad bimkomo yachzir lakkasher. aval dam sheholicho happasul laavoda vehecheziro lakkasher veholicho. o sheholicho hakkohen techilla vehecheziro unetano lappasul veholicho. hoil veholicho happasul ben battechilla ben bassof nifsal hazzevach. shehare i efshar letakken davar ze:
Kibbel happasul. im nishar dam hannefesh chozer hakkasher umekabbel umolich vezorek. sheen happesulin laavoda osin haddam hannishar sheyarim. chutz min hattame hoil vehu rauy laavoda bekarban habba betuma kemo shebbearnu. ose sheyarim ketzad. kibbel hattame. af al pi shekkibbel acharav hakkasher dam hannefesh uzerako nifsal hazzevach. shezze shekkibbel hakkasher baacharona sheyarim hu veeno kelum:
Behema shechasar meevareha kol shehu achar shechita kodem kabbalat haddam nifsela. afillu tzaram beaznah kodem kabbala hare ze lo yekabbel shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 14)</small> <small>(Vayikra 16 18)</small> "velakach middam happar" sheyyihye shalem kullo bishat hakkabbala. veim kibbel min hachasera vezarak hare ze pasul: 
Aval im chasra achar kabbala kodem zerika. afillu avad habbasar kodem zerikat haddam o nisraf. im nishtayyer kezayit min habbasar o kezayit min haemurin zorek et haddam. veim lav eno zorek. uveola afillu kachatzi zayit min habbasar vachatzi zayit min haemurin. mippene shekkullah laishshim:
Nishar pachot mikkezayit lo yizrok. veim zarak lo hurtza. nifsal habbasar kodem zerika o sheyyatza chutz laazara lo yizrok haddam. veim zarak hurtza:
Besar kadashim kallim sheyyatza chutz laazara kodem zerikat damim. af al pi shennizrak haddam vehabbasar bachutz hazzevach kasher mippene shessof habbasar latzet. vehazzerika moelet layyotze lesarfo aval lo leachlo:
Vechen emure kadashim kallim sheyyatzu lifne zerikat damim venizrak haddam vehem bachutz lo nifsal hazzevach. veim hechziran maktirin otan. veaf al pi shello hechziran chayyavin alehen mishshum piggul venotar vetame:
Kol hazzevachim shel yachid. ben shennitma basar vehachelev kayyam ben shennitma chelev vehabbasar kayyam. zorek et haddam. nitmeu shenehen lo yizrok. veim zarak hurtza. shehatztzitz meratztze al hattuma. vechen emurin o evre ola shennitmeu vehiktiran hatztzitz meratztze kemo shebbearnu. vechol karbenot hatztzibbur shennitma habbasar vehachelev kullo hare ze zorek et haddam:
Dam kadashim sheyyatza chutz laazara nifsal hazzevach. veaf al pi shechazar vehichniso uzerako al hammizbeach lo nirtza:
Vechol dam hakkadashim eno mekabbel tuma kelal shenneemar baddam <small>(Devarim 12 16)</small> <small>(Devarim 12 24)</small> "al haaretz tishpechennu kammayim". dam shennishpach kemayim hu hannechshav kemayim umekabbel tuma aval dam kadashim sheeno nishpach kemayim eno mekabbel tuma: 
Vedam sheshshaka alav chamma velo nizrak nifsal hazzevach. veim zerako lo hurtza:

Kol haddamim hannittanin al mizbeach hachitzon. im natan mattana achat bilvad kipper. vaafillu bechattat mattana achat hi haikkar ushear haarba mattanot lemitzva. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 27)</small> "vedam zevachecha yishshafech al mizbach Adonai elohecha". shefichat haddam al hammizbeach hi haikkar:
Vechol hannittanin bizrika shennetanan bishficha yatza. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 27)</small> "vedam zevachecha yishshafech":

Kol haddamim hannittanin al mizbeach happenimi. im chisser achat mehen lo kipper. ella kullan hen ikkar hakkappara. shehare hakkatuv hikpid al minyanan shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 6)</small> <small>(Vayikra 4 17)</small> "sheva peamim":
Chattat shennatan mimmennu mattana achat umetu habbealim. yashlim arba mattanot leachar hammita:
Aval im natan haachat bayyom lo yitten hashshalosh ballayla:
Veim natan achat bifnim vehishliman bachutz chayyav mishshum maale bachutz:
Haya mazze veniktea yado shel mazze kodem sheyyaggia dam laavir hammizbeach. lo alta lo hazzaya:
Shinna mattan karbanot bechattat. ben bechattat hannaaset bifnim ben bechattat hannaaset bachutz nifsal. aval bishar kadashim kesherin:
Natan haddam min hakkeren velifnim. ben bechattat ben bishar kadashim. ben bammizbeach happenimi ben bammizbeach hachitzon. pasul:

Dam shemmitzvato litten oto lemala mechatzi hammizbeach shennetano lematta. o shemmitzvato litteno lematta unetano lemala. o shemmitzvato litteno bifnim bahechol unetano al mizbeach hachitzon. o hannittanin al mizbeach hachitzon shennetanan lifnim bahechol. o shennatan dam hannittanin bachutz al hakkevesh shello keneged hayesod. hare besar hazzevach pasul. veaf al pi chen nitkapperu habbealim bo kevan shehiggia dam lammizbeach. af al pi shehiggia shello limkomo hare hu kemo shehiggia limkomo lechapper. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya ze hazzorek kasher laavoda. aval im kibbel hakkasher venatan lappasul venatan happasul et hannittanin lemala lematta. veet hannittanin bifnim bachutz. veet hannittanin bachutz bifnim. o shennatan al hakkevesh shello keneged hayesod. lo nifsal besar hazzevach im nishar dam hannefesh. ella yachzor hakkasher vikabbel shear dam hannefesh veyizrok haddam bimkomo:

Deme kadashim shennitarvu. ben dam bedam. ben kosot bechosot. im nitarvu hannittanin mattana achat bannittanin mattana achat. yitten hakkol mattana achat. vechen hannittanin mattan arba bannittanin mattan arba. yitten hakkol mattan arba. nitarvu hannittanin mattana achat bannittanin mattan shetayim shehen arba. yitten hakkol mattana achat. nitarvu hannittanin lemala bannittanin lematta. yishshafech hakkol laamma vehazzevachim pesulin. afillu nitarvu sheyare hachattat im dam haola shemmekom hakkol lematta yishshafech hakkol laamma:
Veim lo shaal ella natan min hattaarovot lemala ulematta hare ze kasher. natan lemala veshaal yitten lematta veellu veellu alu lo:

Nitarvu hannittanin bifnim bannittanin bachutz. yishpoch hakkol laamma. veim lo shaal velakach dam hattaarovet venatan mimmennu bifnim uvachutz. ben shennatan bifnim vechazar venatan bachutz o bachutz vechazar venatan bifnim hakkol kasher. bamme devarim amurim bishar damim hannittanim bachutz chutz min hachattat. aval dam chattat hannaaset bachutz shennitarev bedam chattat hannaaset bifnim. im natan bachutz vechazar venatan bifnim kasher. natan bifnim vechazar venatan bachutz pesula. sheddam chattat shennichnas lahechol afillu chattat yachid hanneechelet asura. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 23)</small> "vechol chattat asher yuva middamah" vegomer. vehu sheyyavo derech shaar hahechol. shenneemar yuva derech bia. aval im hichniso befishpash o derech challon o gag. eno nifsal:

Par helem vesair avoda zara sheddamam nichnas lahechol. im hichniso lekodesh hakkadashim nifsal shebbemakom ze penima shel mekoman hu. vechen par vesair shel yom hakkippurim sheddamam nichnas lekodesh hakkadashim im hichnis damam lekodesh hakkadashim vehizza mimmennu vehotzio lahechol vechazar vehichniso lekodesh hakkadashim nifsal veeno gomer mimmennu hazzayot shebbekodesh hakkadashim kevan sheyyatza yatza. vechen im gamar hazzayot shebbekodesh hakkadashim vehotzian lahechol. vehizza miktzat hazzayot vehotzian chutz lahechol vechazar vehichnisan lahechol. eno gomer hazzayot shebbahechol. shekkevan sheyyatza haddam chutz limkomo nifsal:

Chattat shekkibbel damah bishne kosot veyatza echad mehem lachutz. happenimi kasher veyazze mimmennu. nichnas echad mehem lahechol vehizza mimmennu sham. af hachitzon pasul. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 23)</small> "asher yuva middamah" afillu miktzat damah im nichnas lechapper bakkodesh nifsela:

Dam chattat shehichniso lechapper bo bifnim. velo kipper ella hotzio velo hizza mimmennu bifnim kelum. im hichniso beshogeg hare ze kasher umazze mimmennu bachutz shehare lo kipper bakkodesh. veim hichniso bemezid pasul:
Hichnis hachattat atzmah lahechol keshera shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 23)</small> "asher yuva middamah" velo besarah:
Chattat haof sheppirkesa venichnesa lahechol keshera:
Hichnis dam chattat haof lahechol betzavvarah hare ze safek im hatztzavvar chashuv kichli:
Nishpach dam chattat haof vaasafo. hare ze safek im hakkeli posel bedamah o eno posel. lefichach tissaref kechol chattat haof shehu safek:

Chattat shekkibbel damah bearbaa kosot. venatan mattana achat mikkol kos vechos. sheyare arbatan nishpach al hayesod shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 30)</small> <small>(Vayikra 4 34)</small> "veet kol damah yishpoch". natan arba hammattanot mikkos echad. sheyare oto hakkos nishpach al hayesod ushear hakkosot nishpachin laamma:

Dam shennafal letoch hammayim o letoch dame chullin lo yazze mimmennu veim hizza pasul. nafal mayim letoch haddam shebbammizrak. im yesh bo mare dam kasher. nafal letocho yayin o dam chullin. omdin oto illu hayu mayim. im reuyin levattel dam shebbammizrak ad shello yihyu marav mare dam hare ze lo yazze mimmennu. veim enam reuyin levattel marav yazze mimmennu:
