Dam hakkadashim shennitarev bedam pesule hammizbeach o bedam hakkadashim shennifselu bishchita. yishshafech hakkol laamma. vaafillu karvu kol hakkosot chutz meechad yishshafech laamma vechol otan hazzevachim pesulim. nitarev bedam hattamtzit yishshafech laamma. veim lo shaal venatan kasher:

Haemurin veevre haolot vehakkematzim vehallevona umenachot hannisrafot achar shennitkaddeshu bichli sharet. im zarak echad mikkol ellu al gabbe haishshim ben beyad ben bichli ben beyamin ben bismol hare ellu kesherim:
Hayyayin vehammayim shennischan ben bikara ben behin ben bishar kele hashsharet kesherim. nissechan bichli chol o beyado pesulin:

Evarim shessidderan vechen kometz shessiddero vesidder haetzim shel maaracha lemala mehem. o shessidderan mitztzidde haetzim. hare ze safek im derech haketara bechach o en derech haketara bechach. lefichach lo yaase chen lechattechilla veim asa hurtza:

Kadshe kadashim sheshshechatan berosh hammizbeach keillu shechatan batztzafon shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 21)</small> "vezavachta alav et olotecha veet shelamecha". melammed shekkol hammizbeach rauy lishchitat haola ushechitat hashshelamim:

Ola sheshshechatah berosh hammizbeach. o sheshshechatah lematta veheela otah lerosh hammizbeach. yafshit otah vinattechenna bimkomah. umorid hakkeravayim umedichan lematta. vechozer umaale otan umorid haor venotno lakkohanim:

Vechen zevachim shechutim shealu legabbe hammizbeach. mafshitan umenattechan bimkoman umorid hakkeravayim umedichan bemayim vechozer umaale otan umorid et haor veet habbasar venotno labbealim vechozer umaktir et hashshear. umippene ma lo yorid hakkol ella yafshit vinatteach berosh hammizbeach. shekkol harauy laishshim im ala lerosh hammizbeach lo yered. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 29 37)</small> "kol hannogea bammizbeach yikdash". yachol af al pi sheeno rauy. talmud lomar <small>(Vayikra 6 2)</small> "hi haola al mokda". ma ola shehi reuya laishshim im alta lo tered af kol harauy laishshim im ala lo yered:
Ola sheheelah chayya lerosh hammizbeach tered sheadayin enah reuya:
Vechen kometz hammincha shello nitkaddesh bichli sharet. vechol issure hammizbeach shealu yerdu lefi sheenan reuyin mittechillatan:
Vechen behemat kadashim shennishchata ballayla o nishpach damah o sheyyatzat chutz laazara im alta tered:

Aval kadashim shellanu o shellan haddam o habbasar o haemurim. vezevach sheyyatza chutz laazara. o shennitma o nifsal bemachshevet hazzeman o bemachshevet makom o bemachshevet shinnuy. o shekkibbelu hattemeim vezarku et damo hoil ureuyin baavodat karban habba betuma. veshennatan damo chutz limkomo o kadshe kadashim shennishchatu baddarom o shennitkabbel damam baddarom. af al pi shekkol ellu pesulim im alu lerosh hammizbeach lo yerdu:
Kol sheppissulo bakkodesh hakkodesh mekabbelo. ucheshem sheim alu lo yerdu kach im yardu lo yaalu sheniyya shehare pesulin hem:
Veim mashla bahem haur af al pi sheyyardu yaalu sheniyya veyashlim haketaratan:
Kometz shennitpaggel umiktzato baaretz umiktzato mashla bo haur yaale kullo:
Evarim vachalavim ukematzim shellanu berosho shel mizbeach keillu lanu baazara veim yardu lo yaalu. aval im lo yardu maktirin otan leolam:
Vaavir mizbeach kemizbeach. veemure kadashim kallim sheheelan kodem zerikat damim lo yerdu. shehare naasa lachmo shel mizbeach:
Hifrish shene ashamot leacharayut veshachat et shenehem vekadam veheela emurim shel echad mehem kodem zerika hare ellu yerdu:

Hazzevach happasul vehannesachim happesulim shealu lammizbeach. hazzevach lo yered kemo shebbearnu mippene shehu rauy laishshim. vehannesachim yerdu. vechen nesachim habbaim bifne atzman shennifselu vealu yerdu:
Of shemmelako zar veala lo yered. vekometz hammincha shekkematzo veala yered. af al pi shezze pasul veze pasul ze keillu lo nitkaddesh kelal. veechad hazzar veechad shear happesulim:

Veellu im yaalu yerdu. kol sheeno rauy laishshim. besar kadshe kadashim uvesar kadashim kallim. motar haomer usheyare menachot ushete hallechem velechem happanim vehakketoret. vetzemer shebberashe kevasim vesear shebbizkan hatteyashim vehaatzamot vehaggidim. vehakkarnayim vehattelafayim bizman sheenan mechubbarim im alu yerdu:
Kometz shemmitztza shamno al haetzem veyarad haetzem yachaziro. shehaddavar safek shemma chibbure olin keolin hem chashuvin:

Mizbeach happenimi mekaddesh pesulim ben reuyin lo ben sheenan reuyin lo. aval mizbeach hachitzon eno mekaddesh ella pesulin haruyin lo kemo shebbearnu. ketzad. mizbeach hachitzon shealu lo zevachim shennifselu lo yerdu. alta lo ketoret zara tered sheen hakketoret zara reuya lammizbeach hachitzon. aval mizbeach happenimi sheala lo kometz mincha ben kasher ben pasul lo yered. vechen kol kayyotze baze. keshem shehammizbeach mekaddesh et harauy lo kach hakkevesh ushear kele hashsharet mekaddeshin et harauy lahem shehare neemar bakkelim <small>(Shemot 30 29)</small> "kol hannogea bahem yikdash". mishsheyyaggia lakkevesh davar harauy lo lo yered veaf al pi shennifsal. vechen kesheyyaggia lichli sharet kol davar harauy lo mitkaddesh velo yippade leolam veaf al pi shennifsal kemo shebbearnu beissure hammizbeach:

En kele hallach mekaddeshot et hayyavesh. velo kele hayyavesh mekaddeshot et hallach. bamme devarim amurim bemiddot hallach vehayyavesh shehayu bammikdash kemo shebbearnu behilchot kele hammikdash. aval hammizrakot mekaddeshot hallach vehayyavesh. uchele sharet mekaddeshin dam happasul likkarev:

Kol kele hashsharet en mekaddeshin ella bammikdash veen mekaddeshin ella middaat veen mekaddeshin ella mittochan veen mekaddeshin ella shelemim. nikkevu im osin meen melachtan shehayu osin vehem shelemim mekaddeshin veim lav en mekaddeshin. veen mekaddeshin ella melein. aval hammiddot en mekaddeshot chaserot ella im dato lemalleotan. veim en dato lemalleotan mekaddeshot lehippasel aval lo likkarev:

Kele sharet mekaddeshin shello bizmannan lehippasel aval lo lehikkarev. ketzad. davar shemmitzvato bayyom shennitkaddesh bichli sharet ballayla nifsal veyissaref. aval eno karev. kegon shekkamatz mincha ballayla venatan kumtzah lichli sharet hare zo nisrefet:

Mizbeach shennifgam nifselu kol hakkadashim shehayu sham shechutin bammikdash sheadayin lo nizrak damam. shehare en sham mizbeach lizrok alav veneemar <small>(Shemot 20 21)</small> "vezavachta alav et olotecha veet shelamecha" kelomar tizbach vehu omed betikkuno lo pagum:
Aval kadashim chayyim shehayu sham baazara keshennifgam lo nifselu. ella kesheyyibbane hammizbeach yikkarvu sheen baale chayyim nidchin:
Hikdish behemot ad shello nivna hammizbeach. kesheyyibbane makrivin otan shehaddachuy meikkaro eno dachuy:

Vechen en ochlin kadashim vehammizbeach pagum. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 10 12)</small> "veichluha matztzot etzel hammizbeach". vehu haddin lekadashim kallim sheen ochlin otan birushalayim vehammizbeach pagum ad sheyyibbane:

Velad chattat utemurat chattat vechattat shemmetu bealeha vechattat sheavda venimtzet achar shekkipperu habbealim hare ellu yamutu. nimtzet achar shennishchata hachattat hashsheniyya shehifrish kodem sheyyizzarek damah. hare zo safek im tamut im tire ad sheyyippol bah mum. lefichach tamut. vechetzad hen metot. lo sheyyahargem bichli o beyado ella yachnisem levayit venoel alehem ad sheyyamutu. udevarim ellu kullam mippi moshe rabbenu nishmeu. en kol haddevarim amurim ella bechattat yachid bilvad. aval chattat tzibbur sheavda venimtzet achar kappara ben reuya ben enah reuya tire ad sheyyippol bah mum vetimmacher veyippelu dameha lindava. veen atta yachol lomar bechattat tzibbur valad o temura o shemmetu bealeha. shekkol karbenot hatztzibbur zecharim veen hatztzibbur osin temura kemo sheyyitbaer veen kol yisrael metim:
Par vesair shel yom hakkippurim sheavdu vehifrish acherim tachtehen. vechen seire avoda zara sheavdu vehifrish acherim tachtehen. yiru ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyimmachru veyippelu demehen lindava. sheen chattat hatztzibbur meta. velamma lo yikrevu atzman nedava shehare zecharim hem. gezera leachar kappara mishshum lifne kappara:
Hammafrish chattato veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha venimtzet harishona vahare shetehem omdot. mashach achat mishshetehen venitkapper bah haacheret tamut. ba lehimmalech omrin lo sheyyitkapper bazo shehifrish barishona vehashsheniyya tire ad sheyyippol bah mum veyippelu dameha lindava. hayta achat mehen temima veachat baalat mum. temima tikkarev uvaalat mum tippade. nishchata baalat mum kodem sheyyizzarek dam hattemima hare zo asura bahanaa. hayu shetehen baale mumin yimmachru shetehen veyavi middemehem chattat vehashshear yippol lindava:
Hifrish chattato veavda. vehifrish acheret tachteha veavda. vehifrish acheret venimtzeu haovdot vahare shelashtan omdot venitkapper barishona. sheniyya meta ushelishit roa. nitkapper bashshelishit sheniyya meta verishona roa. nitkapper baemtzait shetehem metot:
Hammafrish shete chattaot leacharayut. mitkapper bee zo sheyyirtze vehashsheniyya tire ad sheyyippol bah mum veyippelu dameha lindava:
Hifrish chattat meubberet veyalda. hare hi uveladah kishte chattaot shennitparshu leacharayut:
Hammafrish chattato veavra shenatah. tire ad sheyyippol bah mum vetimmacher veyavi bedameha acheret. vechen im hifrish chattato venafal bah mum yavi bedameha acheret:
Kol chattat sheavda venimtzet kodem kappara. (af al pi shennimtzet baalat mum o shennimtzet achar sheavra shenatah) enah meta ella tire ad sheyyippol bah mum veyippelu dameha lindava. nimtzet achar kappara af al pi shennimtzet baalat mum o avra shenatah hoil vehayta avuda bishat kappara hare zo tamut:
Hayta genuva o gezula bishat kappara veachar kach chazra. enah meta ella tire. lo shamu mimmoshe rabbenu ella avuda. hayta ikkar avedatah ballayla af al pi shehayta avuda bishat kappara. enah meta ella tire:
Avda mimmennu velo min haroe. o sheavda min haroe veenah avuda mibbealeha. enah meta ella roa:
Vechol ellu sheroot root ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyippelu demehen lindava:
Hayta avuda mimmennu umin haroe veacher makkira. afillu besof haolam. hare zo safek lefichach tamut:
Hayta nechbet achore haddelet o beseter hammadrega hare zo avuda. shehare en adam roe otah bishat kappara. hayta bassade o baagam hare zo safek avuda shemma yesh sham adam roe otah bishat kappara. lefichach tamut missafek:
Hashsholeach chattato mimmedinat hayyam. makrivin otah bechezkat shehu kayyam. bamme devarim amurim bechattat haof. o bechattat behema shel ishsha sheenah bat semicha kemo shebbearnu. aval asham vadday shemmetu bealav. veshekkipperu bealav. yire ad sheyyippol bo mum veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava. shekkol shebbechattat tamut beasham yire ad sheyyippol bo mum veyippelu damav lindava:
Kol asham shennittak liriyya. im hikrivo ola kasher. velamma lo yikkarev beatzmo ola lechattechilla. gezera leachar kappara mishshum lifne kappara:
Hammafrish nekeva laashamo tire ad sheyyippol bah mum vetimmacher veyavi bedameha asham. im hikriv ashamo yippelu dameha lindava. vechen veladah:
Hifrish nekeva leolato veyalda zachar yire ad sheyyippol bo mum veyavi bedamav ola:
Aval hedyot shehifrish zachar lechattat venasi shehifrish seira lechattat. vechohen mashiach shehifrish para lechattat hare ellu en mitkaddeshin lo kedushshat hagguf velo kedushshat damim. lefichach yimmachru shello bemum:
Hevi asham taluy venoda lo shello chata o shechata vadday. im ad shello nishchat yire ad sheyyippol bo mum veyippelu damav lindava mippene shellibbo shel adam dave al avonotav vehoil veal safek hifrisho gamar belibbo lehakedish. hifrish afillu al pi edim vehuzammu yippelu damav lindava. veim achar shennishchat noda lo. haddam yishshafech vehabbasar yissaref kishar pesule hammukdashin. noda lo achar shennizrak haddam. habbasar yeachel lakkohanim kechol haashamot:
Asham vadday eno ken. im ad shello nishchat noda lo shello chata yetze veyire baeder kishar hachullin veen bo kedushsha kelal. veim mishshennishchat hare ze yikkaver. veim mishshennizrak haddam. habbasar yetze levet hasserefa kishar pesule hammukdashin:
Mi shennitchayyev beasham taluy vehifrish shenayim leacharayut. mitkapper beechad vehashsheni yire ad sheyyippol bo mum veyippelu damav lindava. veen tzarich lomar beasham vadday shehu ken:
Kol haashamot shebbattora bain bene shetayim uvaim bechesef shekalim. chutz measham metzora vaasham nazir shehem bene shana veen lidmehem kitzva. asham taluy ba min hakketannim o min haggedolim. umippi hashshemua lamdu sheeno ba ella bechesef shekalim:
Huzelu elim velo yimmatze ayil bishte selaim en lo takkana ella yishhe ad sheyyukeru veyavi bishte selaim shehare hikpida tora al damav venatna lo kitzva:
Hifrish ashamo vehaya bishat haferasha yafe sela uvishat kappara yafe shetayim kasher. shehaddachuy meikkaro eno dachuy vaadayin lo nire ad shennaasa shave shetayim. veaf al pi shehishbiach meelav adam mitkapper beshevach hekdesh. haya bishat haferasha yafe shetayim uvishat kappara yafe sela hare ze pasul. chazar venaasa yafe shetayim yachzor lechashruto sheen baale chayyim nidchin kemo shebbearnu. lema haddavar dome lemum shennafal veavar:
Hifrish shete selaim leasham velakach bahem shene elim leasham. im haya echad mehen yafe shete selaim yikkarev laashamo vehashsheni yire ad sheyyippol bo mum veyippelu damav lindava:
Haya chayyav beasham ben shana vehevi ben shetayim o beven shetayim vehevi ben shana. o sheshshechato mechussar zeman babbealim. pasul uteebbar tzurato veyetze levet hasserefa. ze hakkelal kol happasul bechattat pasul beasham. chutz min haasham sheshshechato shello lishmo shehu kasher kemo sheyyitbaer:
Olat nazir. olat yoledet. olat metzora. sheshshechatan bene shenem asar chodesh veyom echad. o mechussere zeman bivalim. kesherim uteunin nesachim. ze hakkelal kol sheeno posel beolat nedava eno posel beolat chova. ben alta labbealim ben shello alta lahem:

Hammafrish maot lechattato umet yelchu hammaot leyam hammelach. vechen hammafrish maot lechattato veavdu vehikriv chattat tachtehen venimtzeu hammaot achar kappara yelchu leyam hammelach:
Hifrish maot lechattato veavdu vehifrish maot acherot tachtehen. velo hispik likkach bahen chattat ad shennimtzeu maot harishonot. yavi meellu veellu lechattat vehashshear yippelu lindava:
Hifrish maot lechattato veavdu vehifrish chattat tachtehen velo hispik lehakerivah ad shennimtzeu hammaot vahare hachattat baalat mum. timmacher veyavi meellu veellu chattat vehashshear yippelu lindava:
Hifrish chattato veavda vehifrish maot tachteha velo hispik likkach bahem ad shennimtzet chattato vahare hi baalat mum. timmacher veyavi meellu veellu chattat vehashshear yippelu lindava:
Hifrish shene tzibbure maot leacharayut. mitkapper beechad mehem vehashsheni yippol lindava:
Hammafrish chattato o deme chattato vechassavur shehu chayyav venimtza sheeno chayyav. hare ellu chullin velo nitkaddeshu. hifrish shetayim o deme shetayim vechassavur shehu chayyav shetayim venimtza sheeno chayyav ella achat. yavi achat vehashshear yippelu lindava:
Hallokeach maot beyado o shehaya melakket veamar ellu avi mehem chattati. hammotar chullin. vechen yerae li shehaddavar kal vachomer bishar hakkarbanot shehammotar chullin:
Hammafrish maot leminchat chote vehevi mehem minchato. o shehifrish minchat chote vehotira. hammotar yavi minchat nedava. aval motar asirit haefa shel kohen gadol shehi hachavitin yerakev. vechen motar lachme toda umotar lachmo shel nazir yerakvu. umotar deme nesachav yippelu lindava. kevar bearnu bishkalim shemmotar hashshekalim chullin:
Motar kinne zavim. kinne zavot. kinne yoldot. chattaot vaashamot. motrehem yippelu lindava veyikkarvu olot kemo shebbearnu. motar ola leola. motar shelamim lishlamim. motar mincha lemincha. motar pesach lishlamim. motar nezirim linzirim. motar nazir leoto nazir. bamme devarim amurim shemmotar chattat lindava. bechattat kevua. aval mi shehu chayyav bekarban ole veyored shehifrish maot lechattat behema veheeni. mevi tachtehem of umechallelan al haof veyehane mehem. vechen im hifrish deme haof veheeni. mevi tachtehem asirit haefa vichallel hammaot aleha veyehane bahem:
Hifrish behema venafal bah mum. timmacher veyavi bedameha of. aval im hifrish of venifsal. lo yavi bedamav asirit haefa. sheen laof pidyon kemo shebbearnu beissure hammizbeach:
Kol chayyave kinnin shebbattora shehifrishu maot lekinnehen. ratza lehavi bechol hammaot chattat haof levaddah yavi. ratza lehavi bahen olat haof levaddah yavi. afillu amar ellu deme chattati veellu deme olati. yesh lo learev hammaot velikkach bahen keechad chattato veolato. o likkach bakkol chattat o ola. sheen hakkinnin mitparshot ella bilkichat habbealim o baasiyyat kohen:
Lefichach im hifrish maot lekinnin setam umet. yippelu kol otan hammaot hassetumin lindava. shehare kullan reuyin lavo ola:
Mi shehaya mechuyyav chattat veamar hare alay ola vehifrish maot veamar ellu lechovati. ratza lehavi bahen chattat behema yavi. olat behema yavi. met vehinniach hammaot yelchu leyam hammelach:

Kol hazzevachim shennitarev bahen achat mechattaot hammetot. o shor hanniskal. afillu echad beribbo kullan yamutu lefi shebbaale chayyim chashuvin hen veenam betelin. veim hikriv hurtza sheen baale chayyin nidchin:
Nitarev bahen echad meissure hammizbeach. yiru kullam ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyimmachru veyavi bidme hayyafe shebbahen meoto hammin shel kadashim shennitarev:
Nitarvu kadashim bechullin temimim yimmachru hachullin shebbattaarovet letzarche oto hammin veyikkarvu kullan. ketzad. arba behemot shelamim shennitarvu bearba behemot chullin temimim. yimmachru haarba shel chullin lemi shehu tzarich lehavi shelamim veyikkarvu hakkol shelamim. vechen beola o beasham. vehaddamim chullin lechol davar shehare deme chullin hen:
Nitarev shor hekdesh bishvarim shel chol. gadol shebbechullan hekdesh veyimmachru hashshear letzarche oto hammin. nitarvu kadashim bekadashim min bemino. ze yikrav leshem bealav veze yikrav leshem bealav af al pi sheen kol echad mehen makkir karbano. bamme devarim amurim bekarbenot nashim sheen bahem semicha. aval karbenot anashim hoil vechol echad tzarich lismoch al rosh karbano hare ellu lo yikkarvu ad sheyyitten haechad chelko lachavero. o ad sheyyippol mum bakkol veyimmachru veyaviu kol echad bidme hayyafe shebbahen meoto hammin:
Nitarvu min besheeno mino kegon ola bishlamim. lo yikkarvu afillu kachamura shebbahen. sheen meviin kadashim levet happasul:
Ucheshem sheen memaatin bizman achilatan kach en memaatin beochlehen velo bimkom achilatan. ella ketzad yaase. yiru hakkol ad sheyyippol bahem mum veyimmacher kol echad mehen levaddo veyavi bidme hayyafe shebbahen mimmin ze uvidme hayyafe shebbahen mimmin haacher veyafsid hammotar mibbeto:
Af al pi shekkevar hikriv ola shechayyav bah o shelamim shehaya chayyav lehakerivan. hare ze makriv middeme hattaarovet ola acheret ushelamim acherim:
Chattat shennitarva bishlamim yiru hakkol ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyavi bidme hayyafe shebbahen shelamim uvidme hayyafe shebbahen chattat. veim kadam vehikriv chattat acheret al chattat shehifrishah lo kullan yamutu:
Vechen im nitarvu meot chattat bimot asham. lokeach shete behemot umechallel deme chattat bechol makom shehu al chattat udeme asham al asham. veim kevar karva chattato yolich kol hammaot leyam hammelach. veim kevar karva ashamo yippelu hakkol lindava:
Toda shennitarva bitmuratah shetehen tikkaravna veyanif hallechem immahen. vechach im nitarva toda bishar zevachim af al pi shekkarva todato yiru hakkol ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyavi bidme hayyafe toda acheret. uvidme hayyafe zevach acher:
Nitarva beel nazir shetehem tikkaravna veyanif hallechem immahen:
Bechor shennitarev befesach shenehem yiru ad sheyyippol bahem mum veyeachlu kivchor. velamma lo yikkarvu. lefi shehappesach neechol lechol adam ad chatzot vehabbechor lishne yamim veeno neechol ella lakkohanim. veen meviin kadashim levet happesul veen memaatin baachilatan:
Vechen maaser shennitarev befesach kesheyyippol bahen mum yeachlu kemaaser. habbechor vehammaaser shennitarvu yeachlu bemuman:
Vechen shear kadashim shennitarvu bivchor uvemaaser yiru ad sheyyippol bahem mum veyeachlu kivchor shennafal bo mum o kemaaser shennafal bo mum:
Asham shennitarev bishlamim. af al pi sheen makrivin mishshenehen ella haemurin aval habbasar neechol. lo yikkarvu ella yiru ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyavi bidme hayyafe asham uvidme hayyafe shelamim vehammotar yafsid mibbeto. veim kadam vehikriv ashamo shenehen yippelu lindava:
Kol hakkadashim efshar sheyyitarvu min bemino. chutz min hachattat im haasham sheen haasham ella mizzichre kevasim. veen lecha chattat min hakkevasim ella nekeva:
Vechol ellu hammitarvin bachayyim im hikriv hurtza sheen baale chayyim nidchin:
Behema shennimtzet mirushalayim vead migdal eder uchemiddata lechol ruach. im nekeva bat shenatah hi konsah lechippa ad shettamut shemma chattat hi. hayta bat shetayim yevienna shelamim veyavi immah lechem shemma toda hi. matza zachar ben shete shanim en lo takkana. shemma asham hu vaadayin lo kipperu bealav. matza zachar ben shana mannicho ad sheyyippol bo mum. umevi shete behemot tachtav umatne veomer im ola haya ze ola tachtav veim shelamim haya ze shelamim tachtav. umakriv haechad ola unesachav mishshel tzibbur. vehaacher shelamim im hallechem shemma toda haya. uma yaase baze hannimtza yeachel bemumo sheafillu haya bechor o maaser bemumo hu neechol. veim pesach achar zemanno hu hare ze shelamim uvizmanno hakkol nizharin bo. veim tomar shemma asham nazir o asham metzora hu. enan metzuyin tamid. lefichach lo chashu lahen:
Nitarvu kadashim bekadashim achar shennishchatu yeachlu kechamur shebbahen. nitarvu bifsule hammukdashin o bechullin shennishchatu baazara teubbar tzuratan veyetzu levet hasserefa:
Evre chattat shennitarvu beevre ola. mannichin hakkol ad sheyyippasdu uteubbar tzuratan. vesorfin otan baazara bemakom shessorfin pesule hammukdashin:
Evar shel baale mumin shennitarev beevre kadashim afillu evar beelef evarim. yetzu hakkol levet hasserefa. vaafillu karvu kullan chutz meechad min hattaarovet. hare ze yissaref baazara bemakom shessorfin pesule hammukdashin:
Chatichot kadshe kadashim shennitarvu bachatichot kadashim kallim. o hanneechalin leyom echad beneechalin lishne yamim. yeachlu kechamur shebbahen:
Chaticha shel chattat temea shennitarva bemea chatichot shel chattat tehora. vechen perusa shel lechem happanim shennitma shennitarva bemea perusot shel lechem happanim hattahor. hare zo taale kemo shebbearnu bitrumot:
Aval chaticha shel chattat shennitarva bemea chatichot shel chullin. vechen perusa shel lechem happanim hattahor shennitarva bemea perusot shel chullin. hare ellu lo yaalu ella yeachel hakkol lakkohanim kechol hamedummaot:

Kol happesulin laavoda shemmalku melikatan pesula. veaf al pi sheoto haof pasul eno kenivlat haof hattahor letuma. vechen im malak ballayla o sheshshachat chullin bifnim vekadashim bachutz. enah kinvela:
Malak torim shello higgia zemannan uvene yona sheavar zemannam vesheyyavash gappah veshennismet enah veshenniktea raglah hare zo nevela lechol davar. ze hakkelal kol shehaya pesulah bakkodesh pesula veenah nevela. lo haya pesulah bakkodesh hare zo nevela lechol davar:
Lefichach hammolek venimtzet terefa. o shemmalak besakkin o shemmalak chullin bifnim vekadashim bachutz. hare zo nevela lechol davar. sheen hammelika matteret umetaheret ella davar shehu kasher lammizbeach:
Aval hannirba vehammuktze vehanneevad vehaetnan vehammechir vehattumtum vehaanderoginus shennimleku. hare ellu nevela lechol davar umetammein begadim bevet habbelia. sheen hakkedushsha chala alehen vahare en pesulan bekodesh:
Kevar bearnu bemaase hakkarbanot shechattat haof naaset lematta veolat haof lemala. chattat haof sheasaah lemala pesula. ben sheasa hazzayatah kemaase chattat. ben sheasaah kemaase ola. ben sheasaah leshem ola. ben sheasaah leshem chattat:
Vechen olat haof sheasaah lematta afillu malak siman echad lematta vesiman echad lemala pesula ben shemmelako kimlikat ola ben sheasaah kemaase chattat. ben sheasaah leshem chattat ben sheasaah leshem ola:
Chattat haof shemmelakah lematta kimlikat ola leshem chattat o kemaase chattat leshem ola o kemaase ola leshem ola pesula:
Vechen olat haof sheasaah lemala kemaase chattat leshem ola o kemaase chattat leshem chattat pesula. kemaase ola leshem chattat keshera. uvilvad shello alta labbealim leshem chova:
Kol ellu haofot shennifselu mippene mekom asiyyatan o mippene shinnuy maasehen o shinnuy shemam. enan kenivlat haof letuma. vechen chattat haof o olat haof shennitpaggela o nitmea o naaset notar enah metammea bevet habbelia kenivlat haof. shekkol ellu pesulan bekodesh:
Chattat haof habbaa al hassafek naaset kemitzvatah veenah neechelet ella tissaref kechol pesule hammukdashin. vechetzad tavo al hassafek. kegon shehayta haishsha sefek zava o sefek yoledet vechol kayyotze baze. veen lanu chattat behema al safek. sheim nistappek lo im chata im lo chata yavi asham taluy kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot shegagot:
Chattat haof habbaa al hassafek venoda shehi chayyevet bah vadday. im ad shello nimleka noda lah tease vaddait veteachel. veim achar shennimleka noda lah hare ze gomer hazzayat damah vetamtzito vetissaref kede shello yomru chattat haof habbaa al hassafek teachel shehare battechilla al safek baa:
Noda lah sheenah chayyevet bah meachar shennimleka hare zo tikkaver:

Chatat haof shennitarva beolat haof. o olat haof shennitarva bechattat haof. afillu achat beribbo kullan yamutu. bamme devarim amurim keshehayu meforashot bishat lekichat habbealim zo chattat vezo ola. aval im hevi ofot lechovato mehen chattat umehen ola velo peresh ella kullan setumot venitarva chattat o ola bechova zo hassetuma yesh lahen dinim acherim:
Vechetzad dinehen. im nitarva chattat bechova zo hassetuma en kasher ella minyan chattaot shebbechova bilvad. aval minyan haolot shebbechova im hachattat shennitarva bahen pesulin shehare nitarva chattat veolot:
Lefichach im hayta hachova shetayim bechattat. chatzi hachova kasher vechetzyah pasul. veyerae li shehu ose kullan lemattan kemaase chattat:
Vechen im nitarva ola bechova zo hassetuma. en kasher ella minyan olot shebbechova. aval minyan hachattaot shebbechova im haola shennitarva bahen pesulin. shehare nitarva ola bechattat. ben shehayta hachova hassetuma merubba al haolot shennitarev bah. ben shehayu haolot merubbin al hachova hassetuma. ben shehayu shetehen shavot. en kasher ella minyan olot shebbechova. lefichach im hayta hachova shetayim baolot chatzi hachova kasher vechetzyah pasul. veyerae li shehu ose kullan lemala kemaase ola:
Chova setuma vechova acheret setuma shennitarvu. ben shehayu shetehen mishshem echad. kegon kinne zavim im kinne zavim. o mishshene shemot kegon kinne zavim im kinne yoldot. ben shehayu shetehem leadam echad. ben shehayu lishnayim. im hayu shetehen shavot mechetza kasher umechetza pasul. ben sheasa hakkol lemala o hakkol lematta o asa chetzyan lemala vechetzyan lematta leolam mechetza kasher umechetza pasul. mippene shehakkol chetzyan ola vechetzyan chattat. vehachattat lematta vehaola lemala. im asa hakkol lemala chetzyan kesherot vehen olot. veim asa kullan lematta chetzyan kesherot vehen chattaot. asa chetzyan lematta vechetzyan lemala chatzi hachetzi shennaasa lemala kasher mippene hattaarovet vehu olot vachatzi hachetzi shel matta kasher vehu chattaot:
Hayu shete hachovot hassetumot shennitarvu zo gedola mizzo. kegon shehayta achat arba ofot vehashsheniyya shesh. im asa hakkol lemala o asa hakkol lematta mechetza pasul umechetza kasher umittaam shebbearnu. asa chetzyan lematta vechetzyan lemala. im achar sheshshaal asa chen hammuat kasher. veim middato asa hamerubbe kasher:
Ze hakkelal kol sheasa hakkohen middato chetzyan lemala vechetzyan lematta. vei efshar shello yihye mishshel echad lemala ulematta. hare ze hamerubbe kasher hoil vedavar yadua shemmiktzat karbenotav lemala umiktzatam lematta yihyu kol karbenotav kesherim:
Shenayim shellakchu kinnehen beeruv o shennatnu deme kinnehen lakkohen leeze sheyyirtze hakkohen yakriv chattat uleeze sheyyirtze yakriv ola. sheen hakkinin mitparshin ella bilkichat habbealim o baasiyyat hakkohen kemo shebbearnu:
Hayu lifne hakkohen chattaot veolot. asa shetehen lemala o shetehen lematta mechetza kasher umechetza pasul. asa chetzyan lemala vechetzyan lematta velo yada im hachattaot hem sheasa lematta o haolot. hare hakkol pasul. sheani omer haolot hem sheasa lematta vehachattaot lemala:
Hayu lefanav shelosha tzibbure ofot echad chattaot veechad olot vehaechad satum chetzyo olot vechetzyo chattaot velo peresh. im asa kullan lemala o lematta. mechetza kasher umechetza pasul:
Asa chetzyan lemala vechetzyan lematta. en hakkasher ella hassatum bilvad sheasa chetzyo lemala vechetzyo lematta. vehu mitchallek ben habbealim veole lishnehen. shehare hakkohen eno yodea lee ze mehen peresh ulee ze mehen haya hassatum. ushene hatztzibburin hameforashin pesulin shehare lo yada e ze asa lemala vee ze asa lematta veshemma haola naaset lematta vehachattat lemala:

Ken setuma shepparach mimmenna gozal laavir. o shepparach leven haofot sheyyamutu kullan. o shemmet gozal echad. yikkach zug lashsheni:
Parach leven hakkerevot. pasul ufosel echad kenegdo. shehaggozal happoreach mikken satum leven hakkerevot pasul ufosel echad kenegdo. ketzad. parach gozal min hassatum laasara ofot setumot. im asa chamishsha lematta veshishsha lemala. hare chamesh olot kesherot mehashshishsha shel mala vearba chattaot kesherot mehachamishsha ofot shennaasu lematta. sheani omer shemma haggozal happoreach hu echad mechamishsha shel matta. vechen im asa mehem shishsha lematta vachamishsha lemala nimtzet hakkasher chamesh chattaot vearba olot. sheani omer shemma haggozal mechamishsha shel mala. nimtzet hakkasher mehaasara tisha hare pasal echad:
Arbaa ofot setumot vearbaa ofot sheniyyot setumot. parach echad min harishonot lashsheniyyot pasal echad min hashsheniyyot. achar shennitarvu chazar echad min hashsheniyyot ufarach larishonot pasal echad min harishonot. venimtza hakkasher min harishonot shetayim bilvad:
Chazar echad ufarach min harishonot lashsheniyyot afillu kol hayyom eno mosif lehafesid yeter al ze sheafillu hen meoravot kullan zo bazo mechetza kasher umechetza pasul kemo shebbearnu:
Tzibbur echad yesh bo shene ofot. uvashsheni arbaa. uvashshelishi shishsha. uvarvii shemona. uvachamishi asara. uvashshishshi shenem asar. uvashshevii arbaa asar. ufarach gozal min harishona lashsheniyya. veechad min hashsheniyya lashshelishit. umishshelishit lirviit. merviit lachamishit. umechamishit lashshishshit. umishshishit lishviit. vechazar echad ufarach mitztzibbur letzibbur ad shechazar larishona shepparach mimmenna rishona. posel echad bahalichato veechad bachazirato. harishona vehashsheniyya en lahem kelum. vehashshelishit yesh lah shene ofot. veharviit yesh lah arbaa. vehachamishit yesh lah shishsha. vehashshishshit yesh lah shemona. vehashsheviit yesh lah shenem asar. chazar echad ufarach paam sheniyya mizzo lazo vechazar echad ufarach min haacharona leshellemala mimmenna ad shechazar larishona. posel echad bahalichato veechad bachazirato. hashshelishit veharviit en lahem kelum. vehachamishit yesh lah shene ofot kesherim. vehashshishshit yesh lah arbaa. hashsheviit yesh lah asara. parach paam shelishit gozal mizzo lazo. vechazar paam reviit mizzo lazo. posel echad bahalichato veechad bachazirato. vehachamishit vehashshishshit nifselu kullan. vehashsheviit nisharu lah shemona ofot kesherin. kesheyyaase arbaa asar sheva lemala vesheva lematta yihyu shemona mehen kesherin vehashshishsha pesulin mippene taarovet gozalot ellu shepparchu bahalicha uvachazara:
Ken setuma veken meforeshet. parach min hassetuma lammeforeshet. yikkach zug lesheni. chazar o shepparach echad min hameforeshet lassetuma. velo yada ze shepparach im haya ola o chattat. yamutu kol haofot shebbassetuma. sheim nitarva bahen ola kol hachattaot shebbah pesulot. veim chattat nitarva kol haolot shebbah pesulot lefichach yamutu kullan:
Chattat mikkan veola mikkan usetuma baemtza. parach min haemtza latztzedadin elach echad veelach echad. lo hifsid kelum. ella yomar ze shehalach etzel hachattaot chattat veze shehalach etzel haolot ola. chazar achar shennitarvu ufarach echad mikkan veechad mikkan laemtza. hashshenayim haemtzaiyyim yamutu shehare hen chattat veola meoravin. vehatztzedadin ellu yikkarvu chattat veellu yikkarvu ola keshehayu. parach min haemtzait latztzedadin kullan yamutu. shemma ola nitarva bachattaot vechattat baolot:

Haisha sheamra hare alay ken kesheeled zachar. yalda zachar mevia arbaa ofot. shenayim lenidrah vehen ola kemo shebbearnu. ushenayim lechovatah mishshum leda vehen echad ola veechad chattat. nimtzeta lamed shehakkohen tzarich laasot shalosh peredin lemala. ufereda achat lematta. taa veasa shetayim lemala ushetayim lematta velo nimlach tzericha lehavi od pereda achat veyakrivenna lemala. bamme devarim amurim keshehevia haarbaa mimmin echad kegon shehayu kullan torin o bene yona. aval im hayu shete torin im shene bene yona veasa shenayim lemala ushenayim lematta. tzericha lehavi od tor uven yona veyaase shetehen lemala kede latzet yede chovatah. sheim asa battechilla shete hattorin lematta tzericha tor lemala lehashelim chovatah. veim asa shene bene hayyona lematta tzericha ben yona lemala lehashelim chovatah. sheen adam mevi chovato gozal echad tor achat o ben yona ella o shenehen torin o shenehen bene yona:
Persha nidrah veamra lakkohen ellu lenidri veellu lechovati. vaasaam hakkohen shetayim lemala ushetayim lematta velo yada e ze mehen asa lemala vee ze mehen asa lematta. tzericha lehavi shelosha ofot. shenayim lenidrah veechad lehashelim chovatah. veyeasu hashshenayim lemala shehare persha nidrah veshemma shenayim shel nidrah naasa lematta shehem pesulot. bamme devarim amurim beshehevia haarbaa sheppersha nidrah bishnayim mehen mimmin echad. aval im hayu shene minin tavi arbaa acherim. shenayim mimmin sheppersha bo nidrah yeasu lenidrah ushenayim mee ze min shettirtze yihyu lechovatah veyeasu echad lemala veechad lematta:
Kava nidrah veamra im eled zachar hare alay shete torim. veyalda vehevia arbaa ofot. shenayim lenidrah ushenayim lechovatah. veasa shenayim lemala ushenayim lematta velo yada e ze naasa lemala vee ze naasa lematta. vegam hi shachcha velo yada bee ze min kava nidrah im betorim o bivne hayyona. hare zo tzericha lehavi shete torim im shene bene yona lenidrah veyeasu arbatan lemala. vetavi gozal echad lehashelim chovatah veyease lemala. (shekkevar asa shenayim lematta shehem chattat). bamme devarim amurim keshehevia haarbaa techilla mimmin echad. aval im hayu shene minin tzericha lehavi shishsha ofot. shete torim im shene bene yona lenidrah. vetavi lechovatah shete torim o shene bene yona veyease echad lemala veechad lematta. vechen im netanatam lakkohen veshachcha ma natna lo. vehalach hakkohen veasa veeno yodea hechan asa im hakkol lemala o hakkol lematta o mechetza lemala umechetza lematta. hare zo tavi shete torim im shene bene yona lenidrah. vetavi shete torim o shene bene yona lechovatah:
Kava chovatah vekava nidrah veshachcha bamme kava. veefshar shechovatah keves leola ufereda achat tor o ben yona lechattat. lefichach tavi shishsha peredin. arbaa lenidrah ushenayim lechovatah. veod tavi chattat echad ben yona o tor im keves. nimtzet shehevia shiva ofot [vecheves]:
Vechol hachattaot haellu enan neechalot mippene shehem safek:
Kol hammenachot shekkematzan echad min happesulin laavoda hare hem pesulot. vechen im likket hallevona pasal af al pi shello kamatz:
Kamatz hakkasher venatan lappasul. kamatz bimino venatan lismolo veachar kach netano lichli. kamatz mikkeli kodesh venatan lichli chol. pasal:
Kamatz veala beyado tzeror o gargir melach o koret levona pasul:
Kamatz ad shehu bachutz venichnas lefanim. yachzor veyikmotz bifnim vechasher:
Nitpazzer hakkometz al gabbe haritzpa. yachzor veyaasfennu:

Hayta hammincha shello bichli sharet. o shehayta kumtzah shello bichli sharet. o sheheelahu lammizbeach shello bichli sharet. o shebbelalah beshamnah chutz laazara. pesula ad shettihye belilatah bifnim:

Kol hammenachot sheyyatzak alehen hashshemen pasul laavoda kegon hazzar vechayyotze bo o shebbelalan o petatam o melachan kesherot. higgishan o henifan chozer hakkohen umaggish o menif. veim lo higgish velo henif hakkohen kesherot. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 2 2)</small> "veheviah el bene aharon" <small>(Vayikra 2 2)</small> "vekamatz". mikkemitza veelach mitzvat kehunna limmed al yetzika uvelila shekkeshera bezar:

Mincha shennafal letochah shemen mincha acheret o shemen chullin kol shehu nifsela. chisser shamnah pesula. chisser levonatah keshera. vehu sheyyihyu aleha sheni korte levona aval koret echad pesula shenneemar et kol levonatah:
Ribba shamnah ulevonatah ad shene login lechol issaron ushene kumtze levona lechol mincha keshera. shene login o shene kematzin o yeter al ze pesula:
Minchat chote shennatan aleha shemen o al hakkometz shellah nifsela. natan aleha levona yilketenna. hayta shechuka hare zo pesula missafek. shehare i efshar lelakket:
Natan shemen al sheyareha achar shekkamatz. eno loke velo pesalah shehare hakkometz kasher:
Natan mashshehu shemen al gabbe kezayit min hammincha pesalah missafek. aval im natan hashshemen al pachot mikkezayit lo pesalah. veeno posel hallevona ad sheyyitten kezayit levona:
Afillu natan hallevona al kol shehu min hammincha pasal ad sheyyelakket:
Gibbelah bemayim vekamatz keshera. lo neemar <small>(Vayikra 7 10)</small> "chareva" ella mishshemen:
Mincha shekkematzah paamayim keshera, afillu peamim rabbot. vehu sheyyaktir kezayit bevat achat. sheen haketara pechuta mikkezayit:

Hikriv hakkometz belo melach pesula. shehammelach meakkev bammincha kemo shebbearnu. mincha shechasra kodem kemitza. yavi mittoch beto vimalleenna. shehakkemitza hi hakkovaat lo netinatah bichli sharet:
Hitnaddev kometz levona bifne atzmo. im chasar kol shehu pasul. vechen shene beziche levona sheim hallechem im chasar echad mehen kol shehu pesulin. ad sheyyihyu shene kematzin mittechilla vead sof:

Hifrish shene kematzin lemincha achat veavad echad mehen kodem kemitza lo hukba. leachar kemitza hukba ufesula mippene sheribba levonatah. vechen im hifrish arbaa kematzim lishne beziche lechem veavdu shenayim mehem kodem silluk habbezichim lo hukbeu uchesherim. leachar silluk habbezichin hukbeu ufesulin mippene haribbuy:

Kometz mincha shennitma vehiktiro. hatztzitz meratztze shenneemar <small>(Shemot 28 38)</small> "venasa aharon". yatza hakkometz chutz laazara vehichniso vehiktiro en hatztzitz meratztze. shehatztzitz meratztze al hattame veeno meratztze al hayyotze:

Kamatz et hammincha veachar kach nitmeu sheyareha kullan o nisrefu o yatzu chutz laazara o avdu. lo yaktir hakkometz veim hiktir hurtza. nishar meat min hashsheyarim bechashrutan. yaktir hakkometz veotan hashsheyarim shennisharu asurin baachila:
Hayta mechitztza millematta bichli sheyyesh bo issaron shel mincha. af al pi shehu meorav milmala lo yikmotz. veim kamatz pesula:
Haya hakkeli chaluk bimchitztza milmala umeorav millematta. kometz mimmennu:

Chalak haissaron bichli echad veen chalakav nogin ze baze veen benehen mechitztza. hare ze safek im metzaref hakkeli lakkemitza o eno metzaref. lefichach lo yikmotz. veim kamatz lo yaktir. veim hiktir hurtza. velo yeachlu hashsheyarim:

Kamatz venatan hakkometz lemala al hashshulchan keneged gova maarechet lechem happanim kiddesho hashshulchan lehippasel. aval eno mekaddesho likkarev. veeno karev ad sheyyitkaddesh bichli sharet harauy lekometz:
Hidbik hakkometz ledofen hakkeli vekamatz. o shehafach hakkeli al yado vekamatz mittocho ufiv lematta. lo yaktir veim hiktir hurtza:

Issaron shechilleko veavad echad mechalakav vehifrish chelek acher tachtav venimtza haavud vahare shelashtan munnachin bichli echad veen nogin ze baze. nitma ze sheavad hare hu mitztaref im chelek rishon venifselu. veze shehifrish eno mitztaref ella yashlim alav. nitma hammufrash. mufrash verishon mitztarfin venifselu. veze shennimtza eno mitztaref immahen. nitma hachelek harishon hare haavud vehammufrash tachtav mitztarfin:

Vechen leinyan kemitza. kamatz min hannimtza. sheyarav im hachelek harishon neechalin. vehammufrash eno neechol. kamatz min hammufrash. sheyarav neechalin vehannimtza eno neechol. kamatz min harishon. shenehen en neechalin. lefi sheshshenehen sheyarim yeterim shehare hen issaron shalem vedomin lemincha shello nikmetza shehi asura. veheach karev hakkometz hazze vahare lefanav issaron umechetza. mippene shehakkemitza teluya bedaat hakkohen uveet shekkometz en dato ella al haissaron bilvad. vahare hachalakim enan nogin ze baze:

Kometz mincha shennitarev bekometz mincha acheret. maktir shenehen keachat vehen kesherot. vechen im nitarev hakkometz beminchat kohanim o beminchat hannesachim o bachavite kohen gadol. hare ellu kesherot veyaktir hakkol keechad shehakkol laishshim:
Shete menachot shello nikmetzu shennitarvu zo bazo im yachol likmotz mizzo bifne atzmah umizzo bifne atzmah kesherot veim lav pesulot:
Kometz shennitarev bemincha shello nikmetza lo yaktir. veim hiktir hakkol. zo shennikmetza alta labbealim. vezo shello nikmetza lo alta labbealim:
Nitarev kumtzah bishyareha. o shennitarvu sheyareha bishyare chavertah. lo yaktir. veim hiktir alta labbealim:
Shete hallechem velechem happanim veomer hattenufa shehosif bemiddatan o chisser kol shehu pesulot:
Challot toda urekike nazir shechasru ad shello nizrak dam hazzevach pesulin. mishshennizrak dam hazzevach kesherin:
Vechen shete hallechem shechasru ad shello nizrak daman shel kevasim pesulin. mishshennizrak daman kesherim:
Vechen shene sedarim shechasru ad shello hukteru habbezichin pesulin. mishshehukteru kesherim:
Aval hannesachim shechasru ben mishshekkarav hazzevach ben ad shello karav kesherim. veyavi nesachim acherim lemalleotan:

Nesachim shekkadshu bichle sharet venifsal hazzevach. im nifsal bishchita lo kadshu hannesachim likkarev. nifsal mikkabbala veelach kadshu hannesachim likkarev. sheen hannesachim mitkaddeshim likkarev ella bishchitat hazzevach. uma yaase bahen. im haya sham zevach achar zavuach beotah shaa yikkarvu immo. veim lo haya sham zevach achar zavuach beotah shaa naasu kemi shennifselu belina veyissarfu. bamme devarim amurim bekarban tzibbur mippene shellev bet din matne alehen. aval bekarban yachid hare ellu lo yikkarvu im zevach acher veaf al pi shehu zavuach beotah shaa ella mannichan ad sheyyippaslu belina veyissarfu:
Vechol hazzevachim shennizbechu shello lishman yikkarvu niskehem:

Velad toda utemuratah. vehammafrish todato veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha. im hevian leachar shekkipper betoda rishona enan teunin lechem. veim adayin lo kipper bah vahare hi vachalifatah o hi uveladah o hi utemuratah. omedet. hare shenehen tzerichin lechem. bamme devarim amurim benoder toda. aval todat nedava chalifatah utemuratah teunin lechem. uveladah eno taun lechem. ben lifne kappara ben leachar kappara:

Hifrish todato veavda. vehifrish acheret tachteha veavda. vehifrish acheret tachteha venimtzeu harishonot vahare shelashtan omdot. nitkapper barishona. sheniyya enah teuna lechem. shelishit teuna lechem. nitkapper bashshelishit. sheniyya enah teuna lechem. rishona teuna lechem. nitkapper baemtzait shetehen enan teunot lechem:

Hammafrish maot letodato veavdu vehifrish maot acherot tachtehen velo hispik likkach bahen toda ad shennimtzeu maot harishonot. yavi meellu umeellu toda belachmah. vehashshear yavi bahen toda. veenah teuna lechem aval teuna nesachim. vechen hammafrish todato veavda vehifrish maot tachteha veachar kach nimtzet. yavi bammaot toda belo lechem. vechen hammafrish maot letodato veavdu vehifrish toda tachtehen veachar kach nimtzeu hammaot. yavi min hammaot toda velachmah. vezo hattoda haacharona tikkarev belo lechem:
Haomer hare zo toda vahare ze lachmah. avad hallechem mevi lechem acher. avda hattoda eno mevi toda acheret. mippene shehallechem ba biglal hattoda veen hattoda baa biglal hallechem:
Hifrish maot letodato venotru mevi bahen lechem. hifrish lallechem vehotir eno mevi bahen toda:

Haomer hare zo toda venitarva bitmuratah umeta achat mehen veen yadua e zo hi. hare zo hannisheret en lah takkana sheim yavi immah lechem shemma hattemura hi. veim heviah belo lechem shemma hattoda hi. lefichach lo tikkarev zo leola ella tire ad sheyyippol bah mum:

Toda shennifresa challa mechalloteha kullan pesulot. yatzat hachalla o nitmea. shear hachallot kesherot. nifras lachmah o nitma o yatza ad shello nishchata hattoda. mevi lechem acher veshochet. veim achar shennishchat nifras o nitma o yatza. haddam yizzarek vehabbasar yeachel. vehallechem kullo pasul vide nidro lo yatza. nizrak haddam veachar kach nifras miktzat hallechem o nitma o yatza. torem min hashshalem al happarus umin hattahor al hattame umimma shebbifnim al shebbachutz:

Toda shennishchata al shemonim challot. lo kadshu arbaim mittoch shemonim. veim amar yikkadshu arbaim mittoch shemonim moshech arbaim mittoch shemonim umerim mehem achat mikkol karban. vehaarbaim hashsheniyyot yippadu veyetzu lechullin:
Hashshochet et hattoda vehaya lachmah chutz lechomat bet pagi lo kadash hallechem. aval im haya chutz laazara kadash hallechem af al pi sheeno lefanim:
Shechatah ad shello karmu pene hallechem battannur vaafillu karmu kullan chutz meachat mehen. lo kadash hallechem:

Shechatah venifsela bishchitatah bemachshevet zeman o bemachshevet makom kadash hallechem. nimtzet baalat mum o terefa o sheshshechatah shello lishmah lo kadash hallechem. vechen haddin beel nazir im hallechem shello:

Shalosh machshavot hen shepposlin et hakkarbanot. veellu hen. machashivet shinnuy hashshem. umachshevet hammakom. umachshevet hazzeman. machashevet shinnuy hashshem ketzad. ze hashshochet et hazzevach shello lishmo. kegon shehaya ola veyachshov shehu shelamim. o yishchatennu leshem ola ushelamim. o leshem shelamim uleshem ola. o sheshshachat hazzevach shello leshem bealav. zo hi machashevet shinnuy hashshem. machashevet hammakom ketzad. kegon sheshshachat et hazzevach lishmo al menat lizrok damo. o lehaketir mimmennu davar harauy lehaketara chutz laazara. o leechol mimmennu davar harauy laachila chutz limkom achilato. zo hi machashevet hammakom. uzevachim shechashav bahen machashava zo hem hannikraim zevachim sheshshechatan chutz limkoman. machashevet hazzeman ketzad. kegon sheshshachat et hazzevach lishmo al menat lizrok damo meachar shettishka hachamma sheeno zeman zerikato. o lehaketir mimmennu davar harauy lehaketir lemachar meachar sheyyaale ammud hashshachar sheeno zeman haketarato. o leechol mimmennu davar harauy laachila leachar zeman harauy laachilato. zo hi machashevet hazzeman. uzevachim shechishshev bahen machashava zo hem hannikraim zevachim shennishchatu chutz lizmannan vehem hannikraim piggul bechol makom. vezehu <small>(Vayikra 7 18)</small> <small>(Vayikra 19 7)</small> "piggul" heamur battora: 
Mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze shenneemar battora <small>(Vayikra 7 18)</small> "veim heachol yeachel mibbesar zevach shelamav" eno medabber ella bimchashshev bishat hakerava sheyyochal mimmennu bashshelishi. vehu haddin lechol karban shechishshev alav bishat maasav sheyyochal mimmennu leachar zeman harauy laachilat oto karban. vechen im chishshev lehaketir mimmennu bammizbeach davar harauy lehaketara [leachar zeman harauy lehaketara]. kach lamdu mippi hashshemua. echad achilat adam veechad achilat mizbeach. im chishshev alehen achar zemannan hare hakkarban piggul:
Aval karban shello nifseda machshavto ella nizrak damo al hammizbeach kehilchato venishar mimmennu leachar zeman achilato. oto hannishar nikra notar veasur leachlo. vehakkarban kevar nirtza vechipper. hare hu omer baddam <small>(Vayikra 17 11)</small> "vaani netattiv lachem al hammizbeach lechapper" kevan shehiggia dam lammizbeach kehilchato nitkapperu habbealim venirtza hakkarban. lefichach en mitpaggel ella davar sheyyesh lo mattirin ben laadam ben lammizbeach kemo sheyyitbaer. echad zevach shechishshev bo achat mishshalosh machashavot ellu bishat shechita. o shechishshev bishat kabbalat haddam. o bishat holachato lammizbeach. o beet zerikato al hammizbeach:
Nimtzeta lamed shebbearba avodot hazzevach nifsal bemachshava. bashshechita. uvakkabbala. uveholachat haddam. uvizrikato al hammizbeach:
Vehaof bishne devarim. bammelika. uvemitztzuy haddam:
Vehammenachot hannikmatzot bearbaa. bakkemitza. uvintinat hakkometz bichli sharet. uveholachat hakkometz lammizbeach. uvizrikato al haesh:
Aval im chishshev bidvarim acherim chutz meellu. kegon shechishshev bishat hefshet o bishat nittuach o bishat holachat emurin lammizbeach. o bishat belilat hammincha o bishat haggashatah. vechayyotze bidvarim ellu. en otah hammachshava moelet kelum. ben shehayta machashevet shinnuy hashshem ben machashevet hammakom ben machashevet hazzeman:
Vechen hamechashshev beachat mearba avodot ellu o bechullan machashava acheret chutz mishshalosh machashavot ellu en otah hammachshava mafsedet kelum. ketzad. hamechashshev bishat shechita vekabbala veholacha uzerika lehaniach dam hazzevach o emurav lemachar. o lehotzian chutz laazara. o shechishshev lizrok haddam al hakkevesh shello keneged hayesod. o litten et hannittanin lemala lematta veet hannittanin lematta lemala. o litten damim hannittanin bammizbeach hachitzon bammizbeach happenimi. o et hannittanin bappenimi lachitzon. o lehachenis dam hachattat lifnim. o shechishshev sheyyochlu hazzevach temeim o shear happesulin laachila. o sheyyakrivum temeim o shear happesulin laavoda. o learev dam hazzevach bedam happesulin. o shechishshev lishbor atzmot happesach vleechol mimmennu na. o shechishshev lisrof chattat hannisrefet chutz lizmannan. o chutz limkoman. bechol ellu hammachshavot vechayyotze bahen hazzevach kasher. vechen im chishshev bishat kemitzat hammincha uvishat netinato lakkeli uvishat holachato uvishat zerikato al haesh lehaniach kumtzah o levonato lemachar o lehotzio lachutz hare zo keshera:
Kevar bearnu sheholacha shello baregel enah holacha. lefichach en hammachshava poselet bah. vehamehallech bemakom sheeno tzarich hare zo holacha vehammachshava poselet bah. ketzad. kibbel haddam vehu omed bimkomo ufashat yado lezarko al hammizbeach. vechishshev beet sheppashat yado baddam en hammachshava poselet bah. aval im kibbel haddam bifnim velo hillech bo legabbe hammizbeach ella hillech bo vehotzio lachutz. vechishshev bishat hillucho lachutz bemachshevet hazzeman vechayyotze bah. hare zo poselet:

En hammachashava holechet ella achar haoved. aval machashevet baal hakkarban enah moelet kelum. afillu shamanu habbealim sheppiggelu vehayta machashevet haoved nechona hare ze kasher:
Veen hammachshava moelet ella mimmi shehu rauy laavoda. uvaddavar harauy laavoda. uvemakom rauy laavoda. mimmi shehu rauy ketzad. echad min happesulin laavoda shekkibbel haddam. o holich. o zarak. vechishshev bishat haavoda machashevet makom o machashevet hazzeman. lo pasal bemachashavto. lefi sheeno rauy laavoda. veoto haddam shekkibbel o shezzarak miktzato yishshafech laamma. veim nishar dam hannefesh yachzor harauy laavoda vikabbel bemachshava nechona. aval im chashav happasul bishat shechita pasal bemachashavto. shehashshechita keshera bifsulin kemo shebbearnu. yesh karbanot sheim naasu shello lishman kesherin kemo sheyyitbaer. lefichach im kibbel haddam kohen ze sheeno rauy laavoda. o holicho. o zerako. pasal hazzevach keillu asaahu lishmo shehu pasul. veaf al pi sheyyesh dam hannefesh vechazar hakkasher vekibbel vezarak kevar nifsal hazzevach. velo mippene machashevet shinnuy hashshem pasal oto ella mippene shehu pasul laavoda kemo shebbearnu:
Bedavar harauy laavoda ketzad. minchat haomer shekkematzah shello lishmah hare zo kemi shennaaset lishmah usheyareha neechalin. mippene shehi min hasseorim veen hasseorim davar harauy lishar karbanot. vechen hamechashshev beminchat kenaot vehallevona aleha kodem sheyyelakket hallevona en machshavto moelet shehare enah davar harauy laavoda. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Bemakom harauy laavoda ketzad. mizbeach shennifgam vechishshev machashevet zeman o machashevet makom. lo pasal hazzevach bemachshava zo shehare en hammakom atta rauy laavoda. kamatz et hammincha bachutz vechishshev bishat kemitza machashevet zeman o machashevet makom. en machashava zo kelum:
Ellu devarim sheenan reuyin laachila min hakkarbanot ureuyin lehaketara. haddam vehaemurin uvesar haola vehakkometz vehallevona min hammenachot hannikmatzot:
Veellu reuyin laachila veenan reuyin lehaketara. habbasar hanneechol mikkol hazzevachim ben hanneechol lakkohanim ben hanneechol lechol adam. usheyare hammenachot. ushete hallechem velechem happanim:
Veellu devarim sheenan reuyin lo laachila velo lehaketara. besar chattat hannisrefet. vehaor shel behema kullo chutz meor haalya shehu [rauy] laachila. aval hammurea vehu hakkerum haddak haddavek baor umavdil beno uven habbasar eno rauy laachila. vechen haatzamot vehaggidim vehakkarnayim vehattelafayim. vehannotza shel of vehatztzipparnayim vehachartom shello verashe agappayim verosh hazzanav. afillu mekomot harakkim mikkol ellu haddevukim babbasar sheillu yechatchu min hachay yevatzbetz haddam veyetze hoil veenan chashuvin nikraim davar sheeno rauy laachila leinyan hakkarbanot. vechen hammarak vehattavlin vehashshalil vehashshilya uvetzat haof vehabbasar sheppolatto hassakkin bishat hefshet veyishshaer mudbak baor vehu hannikra alal. kol ellu enan chashuvin leinyan machashevet hakkarbanot vahare hen kedavar sheen rauy laachila:
Umechashshevin al davar haomed leibbud o al davar haomed lisrefa. hamechashshev beachat meotan arba haavodot o bechullan. leechol davar sheen darko laachila o lehaketir davar sheen darko lehaketara. ben bemachshevet hammakom ben bemachshevet hazzeman. hazzevach kasher. ketzad. chishshev lishtot middam hazzevach o leechol meemurav o min hakkometz umin hallevona. bachutz o lemachar. o shechishshev lehaketir mibbesar hazzevach o mishsheyare hammincha bachutz o lemachar. hare hazzevach kasher. vechen im chishshev leechol o lehaketir min haor umin haatzamot vehaggidin vehammarak o haalal vechayyotze bahen. ben bemachshevet zeman ben bemachshevet makom. hazzevach kasher. vechen im chishshev leechol mipparim useirim hannisrafin bachutz o lemachar hare hen kesherim. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Chishshev sheyyochlu hattemeim o happesulin middavar harauy laachila o sheyyaktiru hattemeim o happesulin middavar harauy lehaketara chutz lizman achila vehaketara. hazzevach piggul kemo shebbearnu. chutz limkom achila vehaketara hare ze pasul veeno piggul:
En achila pechuta mikkezayit. velo haketara pechuta mikkezayit. lefichach hamechashshev leechol middavar harauy laachila pachot mikkezayit o shechishshev lehaketir middavar harauy lehaketara pachot mikkezayit ben bemachshevet zeman ben bemachshevet makom. hazzevach kasher. chishshev leechol kachatzi zayit bachutz ulehaktir kachatzi zayit bachutz. o shechishshev leechol kachatzi zayit achar zeman achila ulehaktir kachatzi zayit achar zeman haketara. hazzevach kasher sheen achila vehaketara mitztarfin. veim hotzio bilshon achila veamar sheyyochal kachatzi zayit vetochal haesh chatzi zayit. hare ellu mitztarfin leshon achila echad hu. chishshev leechol o lehaketir kachatzi zayit vechazar vechishshev al chatzi zayit acher beotah hammachshava. hare ellu mitztarfin. chishshev leechol kachatzi zayit veshettochal behema o chayya kachatzi zayit. ben bemachshevet makom ben bemachshevet zeman. hare ellu mitztarfin sheshshem achila echad hu. chishshev al kezayit sheyyochluhu shenayim hare ellu mitztarfin. chishshev leechol kezayit beyoter mikkede achilat peras hare ze mitztaref. chishshev bishat zevicha leechol kachatzi zayit uvishat zerika leechol kachatzi zayit hare ellu mitztarfin ben bemachshevet hammakom ben bemachshevet hazzeman. vechen im chishshev al kezayit bishat kabbala veal kezayit bishat holacha. shearba haavodot mitztarfot vahare hen kaavoda achat. chishshev lehaketir kachatzi zayit min hakkometz vechachatzi zayit min hallevona hare ellu mitztarfin. shehallevona im hakkometz lammincha keemurin lezevach. lefichach im chishshev lehaketir kezayit min hallevona chutz lizmanno hare ze piggul kemo shennitbaer. echad hamechashshev lizrok dam hazzevach kullo bachutz o lemachar o shechishshev lizrok miktzat damo bachutz o lemachar. kevan shechishshev al kede hazzaya min haddam pasal:

Kol hazzevachim shennishchatu bemachishevet shinnuy hashshem. ben bekarbenot yachid ben bekarbenot tzibbur. kesherim ella shello alu labbealim leshem chova. chutz min hachattat vehappesach sheim naasu bemachshevet shinnuy hashshem pesulin. veechad hameshanne shem hazzevach bishat shechita o bishat kabbala o bishat holacha o bizrika kemo shebbearnu. ketzad lo alu leshem chova. kegon sheshshachat ola leshem shelamim lo alta labbealim lo mishshum ola shehem chayyavin bah velo mishshum shelamim. ella chayyavin lehavi zevach acher. vechen im shachat olat reuven leshem shimon lo alta lo liruven velo leshimon. bamme devarim amurim kesheakar shem hazzevach bezadon. aval im taa vedimma shezzo haola shelamim hi veasa kol avodoteha leshem shelamim alta labbealim leshem chova. vechen hachattat vehappesach sheasaan bemachshevet shinnuy hashshem betaut kesherim. sheakira betaut enah akira. vechen olat haof shemmelakah o shemmitztza damah bemachshevet shinnuy hashshem keshera velo alta labbealim. vechattat haof pesula:
Vechen kol hammenachot shennaasu bemachshevet shinnuy hashshem kesherot velo alu labbealim chutz mimminchat chote uminchat kenaot sheim chishshev beachat mearba avodot shellahen machashevet shinnuy hashshem pesulot. shinnuy hashshem bemincha ketzad. kegon shekkamatz minchat nedava leshem minchat chote. o marcheshet leshem machavat. o machavat leshem marcheshet. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Asur lechashshev bekadashim machashava sheenah nechona kemo sheyyitbaer. lefichach zevach sheshshechato shello lishmo. o mincha shekkematzah shello lishmah. ben bezadon ben bishgaga. chayyav lehashelim shear avodot lishman. afillu shachat vekibbel veholich bemachshevet shinnuy hashshem chayyav lizrok bemachshava nechona. umippene ma nishtanna din hachattat vehappesach mikkol hazzevachim. vedin minchat chote uminchat kenaot mikkol hammenachot. mippene sheiyyen alehem hakkatuv. hare hu omer bechattat <small>(Vayikra 4 33)</small> "veshachat otah lechattat". shettihye shechita leshem chattat. vechen shear avodoteha lishmah. veneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 la)</small> "al chattato" shettease leshem oto hachet. veneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 la)</small> "vechipper alav" shettihye leshem bealeha. veneemar befesach <small>(Devarim 16 1)</small> "veasita pesach laAdonai elohecha" shettihye kol asiyyato leshem pesach. veneemar <small>(Shemot 12 27)</small> "vaamartem zevach pesach hu laAdonai" shettihye zevichato leshem pesach. ha im shinna shemo o shem bealav pasul. uveminchat chote hu omer mincha hi. uveminchat sota neemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 15)</small> "ki minchat kenaot hi". sheyyihyu kol maaseha lishman: 
Chattat sheshshechatah leshem zevach acher kegon sheshshechatah leshem ola o leshem asham o leshem shelamim. pesula kemo shebbearnu. aval im shechatah leshem chullin. hare zo keshera velo alta labbealim:
Mippi hashshemua lamdu shehakkadashim mechallelin kadashim veen hachullin mechallelin kadashim:
Shechatah leshem chet acher kegon shebbaa al achilat chelev ushechatah al achilat dam pesula:
Shechatah leshem adam acher shehu mechuyyav chattat. afillu chattat sheenah kevua hare zo pesula:
Aval im shechatah leshem echad shehu mechuyyav ola hare zo keshera velo alta labbealim. <small>(Vayikra 4 lo)</small> <small>(Vayikra 4 la)</small> "vechipper alav" velo al chavero shehu mechuyyav chattat kemoto: 
Shechatah leshem met keshera velo alta labbealim sheen kappara lammetim. shechatah leshem mi sheeno mechuyyav karban kelal lo chattat velo ola velo shear karbanot. hare zo pesula. shemma mechuyyav hu veeno yodea:
Shechatah lishmah vechishshev bishat hashshechita lizrok damah shello lishmah hare zo pesula. lefi shemmechashshevin meavoda laavoda. vezot hammachshava shechishshev bishat hashshechita keillu chishshevah bishat zerika ulefichach pesula:
Happesach sheshshechato bemachshevet shinnuy hashshem. ben sheshshinna shemo leshem zevach acher ben sheshshinnahu leshem chullin pasul shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 27)</small> "vaamartem zevach pesach hu laAdonai". bamme devarim amurim sheshshechato bizmanno shehu yom arbaa asar benisan afillu shechato beshacharit bemachshevet shinnuy hashshem pasul. aval im shechato shello bizmanno bemachshava shello lishmo kasher. shello leshem bealav naasa kemi sheen lo bealim bizmanno ufasul:
Pesach sheshshechato lishmo bearbaa asar kodem chatzot pasul lefi sheeno zemanno. avra shenato veshachat bizmanno leshem pesach vechen hashshochet shear zevachim leshem pesach afillu shechatan achar chatzot hare ellu kesherim velo alu labbealim leshem chova:
Toda sheshshechatah leshem shelamim alta labbealim. ushelamim sheshshechatan leshem toda lo alu labbealim. lefi shehattoda nikret shelamim ushelamim lo nikreu toda:
Ola sheshshechatah al mi sheeno mechuyyav karban kelal lo alta labbealim. shehare shechatah shello leshem bealeha. veaf al pi shezze sheshshechatah lishmo eno mechuyyav kelum beinyano. i efshar shello yihye chayyav kappara lashshamayim sheen lecha adam beyisrael shello avar meolam al mitzvat ase:
Ola habbaa leachar mita sheasaah shello leshem bealeha alta labbealim leshem chova. sheen bealim leachar mita:
Shene kivse atzeret sheshshechatan leshem elim lo alu latztzibbur leshem chova. veim dimma shehen elim ushechatan leshem elim alu lahen. mippene shehi akira betaut:
Asham metzora sheshshechato shello lishmo. o shello natan middamo al gabbe behonot. taun nesachim. sheim yikkarev belo nesachim nimtza kemakriv nedava veen haasham ba nedava:
Keves habba im haomer sheshshechato shello lishmo. lo yavi minchat nesachim shello shene esronim ella issaron echad kishar hannedavot. shehare lo ala leshem chovato. vechen tamid sheshshechato shello lishmo lo yaale immo shene gizre etzim kishar hattemidim. shehare lo ala lechovat hattamid ella hare hu kechol hannedavot:
Shene kivse atzeret sheshshechatan shello lishman. o sheshshechatan ben lifne zemannan ben leachar zemannan. haddam yizzarek vehabbasar yeachel af al pi shello alu latztzibbur leshem chova. veim hayta shabbat lo yizrok. veim zarak hurtza lehaketir emurin laerev:
Vechen shalme nazir sheshshechatan shello lishman af al pi shello alu labbealim hare hen neechalin leyom velayla veenan teunin lechem. vechen asham nazir vaasham metzora sheshshechatan shello lishman af al pi shello alu labbealim hare hen neechalim:

Kevar bearnu shehamechashshev beachat mearba haavodot machashevet hmmakom hakkarban pasul veeno piggul. veim chishshev machashevet hazzeman hakkarban piggul. bamme devarim amurim beshello erev im machashevet hazzeman machashava acheret. aval im erev machashevet makom o machashevet shinnuy hashshem befesach uvechattat im machashevet hazzeman hakkarban pasul veeno piggul. ketzad. shachat vekibbel veholich vezarak umachshavto bearba avodot ellu machashevet hazzeman. o shehayta machshavto beachat mearbatan machashevet hazzeman uvishar haavodot hayta machshavto nechona. o lo hayta sham machashava kelal bishar haavodot. hare ze piggul. aval im shachat bemachshevet hazzeman vekibbel o holich o zarak bemachshevet hammakom. o sheshshachat bemachshevet hammakom vekibbel o holich o zarak bemachshevet hazzeman. hare ze eno piggul ella pasul bilvad. vechen happesach vehachattat sheshshechatan bemachshevet shinnuy hashshem vekibbel veholich bemachshevet hazzeman. o sheshshechatan bemachshevet hazzeman vekibbel o holich o zarak bemachshevet shinnuy hashshem. en ze piggul ella pasul. vehu haddin beofot uvimnachot. en sham piggul ella karban shennifsal bemachshevet hazzeman velo erev immah machashevet hammakom lo battechilla velo besof velo erev immah machashevet shinnuy hashshem bekarbanot shennifsalin bemachshevet shinnuy hashshem:

Hamechashshev beachat mearba haavodot o bechullam leechol kezayit middavar harauy laachila bachutz uchezayit lemachar. o kezayit lemachar uchezayit bachutz. o kachatzi zayit bachutz vechachatzi zayit lemachar. o kachatzi zayit lemachar vechachatzi zayit bachutz. hare hakkarban pasul veeno piggul. vechen im erev hammachshava behaketara hare ze pasul veeno piggul:

Chishshev leechol o lehaketir kachatzi zayit bemachshevet hammakom veleechol o lehaketir kezayit bemachshevet hazzeman hare ze piggul. ben shehikdim machashevet kezayit ben sheicher otah. sheen chatzi zayit chashuv etzel kezayit:

Chishshev al chatzi zayit bemachshevet hazzeman veal chatzi zayit bemachshevet hammakom vechazar vechishshev al chatzi zayit acher bemachshevet hazzeman hare ze piggul. vechen im chishshev al chatzi zayit bemachshevet hazzeman vechazar vechishshev al kezayit chetzyo bemachshevet hazzeman vechetzyo bemachshevet hammakom hare ze piggul:

Chishshev al haddamim hannittanin lematta litten otam lemala o al hannittanin lemala letittam lematta vechayyotze bemachshavot ellu sheenan poslin kemo shebbearnu veerev immahen machashevet hazzeman hare ze piggul. veim chishshev immahen machashevet hammakom levaddah hare ze pasul veeno piggul:

Chishshev al haddam hannittan lemala letitto lemachar lematta. o al haddam hannittan lematta letitto lemachar lemala. o shechishshev al haddam hannittan bifnim bahechol letitto lemachar bammizbeach hachitzon. o shechishshev al haddam hannittan bammizbeach hachitzon letitto lemachar bifnim bahechol. eno piggul. af al pi shechishshev machashevet hazzeman hoil veshinna mekom netinat haddam bemachashavto hare ze pasul veeno piggul. umeachar shebbearnu bahalachot ellu shehaddam shennittan shello bimkomo keillu nittan bimkomo lamma lo yihye ze piggul bemachshava zo shechishshev litten haddam shello bimkomo lemachar. mippene shehaddam hannittan shello bimkomo af al pi shehazzevach kasher eno mattir habbasar baachila kemo shebbearnu. vechol zerika sheenah matteret habbasar baachila im chishshev littenah chutz lizmanno lo piggel. lefichach im chazar vechishshev bezevach ze machashevet hazzeman hare ze pasul veeno piggul:

Chishshev machashevet zeman bishat kemitza aval lo bishat likkut hallevona. o shechishshev machashevet hazzeman bishat likkut hallevona aval lo bishat kemitza. hare zo pesula veenah piggul ad sheyyechashshev machashevet hazzeman bechol hammattir shehu hakkometz im hallevona. bishat kemitzat hakkometz velikkut hallevona. o bishat netinat shenehen bichli. o bishat holachatan o bishat zerikatan:

Chishshev bishat haketarat hakkometz sheyyaktir hallevona lemachar enah piggul sheen haketara mefaggelet haketara. vechen im hiktir hallevona levaddah o hakkometz levaddo vehu mechashshev leechol sheyarim lemachar hare zo pesula veenah piggul sheen mefaggelin bachatzi mattir. aval im hiktir et hakkometz levaddo vechishshev sheyyaktir levona lemachar veachar kach hiktir hallevona vechishshev sheyyochal hashsheyarim lemachar hare ze piggul. shehare pashta machashevet zeman bechol hammincha:

Hiktir kede shumshom min hakkometz im hallevona vehu mechashshev sheyyochal kede shumshom min hashsheyarim lemachar. ad shehishlim kol hakkometz im hallevona bemachshevet hazzeman. hare zo pesula veenah piggul. sheaf al pi shedderech achila bechach meat meat en derech haketara bechach ella hare zo kemincha shello huktar kumtzah:

Minchat chote o minchat kenaot shehaya aleha levona vechishshev bah machashevet hazzeman kodem sheyyelakket hallevona hare zo pesula veenah piggul. veim achar shellikket hallevona chishshev aleha machashevet hazzeman hare ze piggul:
Sheyarim shechasru ben kemitza lehaketara vehiktir hakkometz bemachshevet hazzeman hare ze safek im nikbeu lefiggul vahare hen piggul. o lo nikbeu veeno piggul:

Kol haddamim hannittanin al mozibbeach hachitzon shennatan mehem mattana rishona bemachshava nechona. venatan mimmattana sheniyya veelach bemachshevet shinnuy hashshem o bemachshevet hammakom o machashevet hazzeman. hare ze kipper vehurtza hakkarban. veim natan et harishona bemachshevet hazzeman vehishlim hammattanot bemachshevet hammakom hare ze piggul. shemmattana rishona hi haikkar. aval kol haddamim hannittanin al mizbeach happenimi hoil vechullan meakkevin ze et ze kemo shebbearnu. im natan achat mehen shello ketiknah ella hifsid bah hammachshava af al pi shennatan kol hashshear ketiknan hazzevach pasul:

Chishshev barishona machashevet hazzeman veshatak bashshear. o shennatan kullan ketiknan chutz min haacharona shennatan bemachshevet hazzeman. hare ze pasul. veeno piggul ad sheyyazze bemachshevet hazzeman shehare kullam bemattana achat hen:
Tevilat etzba bedam hachattaot happenimiyyot mefaggelet. ketzad. chishshev bishat tevilat etzba bedam machashevet hazzeman hare ze kimchashshev bishat hazzaya:
Haya omed baazara vechishshev machashevet hazzeman bechattaot hannaasot bifnim bedavar hannaase bifnim eno piggul. chishshev bedavar hannaase bachutz hare ze piggul:
Ketzad. haya omed baazara veamar hareni shochet lehazzot damo lemachar. eno piggul. shehahazzaya lefanim bahechol:

Haya omed bahechol veamar hare ani maze lishpoch sheyarim lemachar. eno piggul shehare chishshev bifnim bedavar hannaase bachutz. aval im haya omed baazara veshachat vehu mechashshev lishpoch sheyarim lemachar o lehaketir emurin lemachar. hare ze piggul. shehare chishshev bachutz bedavar hannaase bachutz:

Hattoda mefaggelet et hallechem vehallechem eno mefaggel et hattoda. ketzad. hashshochet et hattoda vehu mechashshev sheyyochal mibbesarah o yizrok damah o sheyyaktir emureha lemachar. hazzevach im hallechem piggul. aval im chishshev leechol min hallechem lemachar hallechem levaddo piggul vezevach hattoda eno piggul:

Vechen haddin bishne kivse atzeret im shete hallechem habbaot immahen sheim chishshev machashevet zeman bakkevasim nitpaggelu shete hallechem. chishshev sheyyochal mishshete hallechem lemachar. shete hallechem piggul vehakkevasim enan piggul. chishshev beachat mearba haavodot leechol kezayit mibbesar hazzevach im hallechem lemachar. hallechem levaddo piggul vehattoda o hakkevasim enan piggul:
Hammaktir shene beziche levona sheim lechem happanim vechishshev bishat haketaratan sheyyochal lechem happanim lemachar. hare hallechem piggul:
Hashshochet shene kivse atzeret vechishshev leechol achat mishshete hachallot lemachar shetehem piggul:
Hiktir shene habbezichim vehu mechashshev leechol echad mishshene hassedarim lemachar. shene hassedarim piggul:
Vechen im chishshev machashevet hazzeman beachat mechallot hattoda o beachat mechallot minchat maafe hattannur. hare kol hachallot piggul:
Aval im nitmet achat mishshete hachallot o echad mishshene hassedarim o achat mechallot hattoda. ben lifne zerika ben leachar zerika. otah hachalla veoto hasseder asur. vehattahor betohorato yeachel:

Chishshev baavodat echad mishshene hakkevasim sheyyochal kezayit mishshete hallechem lemachar. vechen im chishshev behaketarat echad mishshene habbezichin sheyyochal kezayit millechem happanim lemachar. hare hallechem pasul. veeno piggul ad sheyyechashshev bechol hammattir shehu avodat shene hakkevasim vehaketarat shene habbezichin:

Shachat echad vechishshev leechol chatzi zayit mechalla zo lemachar veshachat hashsheni vechishshev leechol chatzi zayit mechalla sheniyya lemachar hare ellu mitztarfin lefiggul. vehu haddin bishne habbezichin im shene hassedarim:
Chishshev beechad mishshene hakkevasim machashevet hazzeman. veasa hashsheni bemachshava nechona. ze sheasaahu bemachshevet hazzeman piggul vehashsheni kasher:
Shachat echad mehen vechishshev bishat shechitato sheyyochal mibbesar hashsheni lemachar shenehen kesherim sheen mechashshevin mizze al ze:

Shene kivse atzeret en mekaddeshin et hallechem ella bishchita. ketzad. shechatam vezarak damam bemachshevet shinnuy hashshem lo kadash hallechem. shechatan lishman vezarak damam shello lishman hallechem kadosh veeno kadosh. shechatan shello lishman af al pi shezzarak lishman lo kadash hallechem:

Shete hallechem sheyyatzu ben shechita lizrika vezarak dam hakkevasim bemachshevet hazzeman. nitpaggelu shete hallechem af al pi shehen bachutz. shehazzerika moelet layyotze af al pi sheadayin hu bachutz:

Kivse atzeret sheshshechatan lishman veavad hallechem. im zarak daman lishman hare ellu pesulin. zarak daman bemachshevet hazzeman achar sheavad hallechem hare ellu safek im hutteru baachila o lo hutteru:

Kol hamechashshev machashava sheeno nachona bekadashim. hare ze over belo taase shehare hu omer <small>(Vayikra 7 18)</small> "lo yechashev":
Mippi hashshemua lamdu shebbichlal din ze shello yafsid hakkadashim bemachshava. shehare ze dome lemattil mum bekadashim. veaf al pi chen eno loke sheen hammachshava maase:
Kol karban shenneemar shehu pasul ben shennifsal bemachshava ben bemaase ben sheera bo davar sheppesalo. kol haochel mimmennu kezayit bemezid loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 3)</small> "lo tochal kol toeva":
Mippi hashshemua lamdu sheen hakkatuv mazhir ella al pesule hammukdashin:
Vechen kadashim shehuttal bahem mum. haochel mehem kezayit loke. hare hem bichlal <small>(Devarim 14 3)</small> "kol toeva" ad sheyyivvaled lahem mum acher veyeachlu bemuman kemo shebbearnu. vechol sheppissulo missafek en lokin alav:
Kol karban shennitpaggel bemachshevet hazzeman kemo shebbearnu kol haochel mimmennu kezayit bemezid chayyav karet shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 18)</small> "vehannefesh haochelet mimmennu avonah tissa". veim achal mimmennu bishgaga mevi chattat kevua:
En chayyavin karet ella al achilat devarim shehutteru ben leadam ben lammizbeach. aval im achal min hammattir atzmo eno chayyav karet ella loke keochel pesule hammukdashin sheen bahem piggul. ketzad. mincha shennitpaggela. haochel kezayit mishsheyareha bemezid chayyav karet. aval im achal min hakkometz shellah o min hallevona eno chayyav karet. lefi shehen hen hammattirim et hashsheyarim leadam. vechen zevach shennitpaggel. haochel kezayit mibbesaro o meemurav o mibbesar haola chayyav karet. aval im achal kezayit min haddam eno chayyav alav mishshum piggul. shehaddam mattir et haemurin likkarev lammizbeach vehaemurin mattirin et habbasar laadam. vedam haola mattir besarah lammizbeach. vedam chattat haof mattir besarah lakkohanim. vedam olat haof mattir besarah lammizbeach. vedam chattaot hannisrafot mattir emurehem lammizbeach. lefichach chayyavin al emurehen mishshum piggul. hakkometz vehallevona mattirin hashsheyarim lakkohanim. shene kivse atzeret mattirin shete hallechem lakkohanim. vechen shene beziche levona mattirin lechem happanim lakkohanim. aval devarim sheen lahem mattirin kegon besar chattaot hannisrafot umenachot hannisrafot enan mitpaggelin leolam:
Veellu devarim sheen chayyavin alehen mishshum piggul leolam. hakkometz. vehallevona. vehakketoret. vehaddam. vehayyayin. ben yayin habba im hannesachim ben yayin habba bifne atzmo. umenachot hannisrafot kullan shehare en lahem kometz lehattiran. kegon minchat kohanim uminchat nesachim uvesar chattaot hannisrafot. velog shemen shel metzora. veim tomar vahalo dam haasham mattiro. eno taluy bo shehare adam mevi ashamo hayyom velog achar kamma yamim kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo:
Asur lehotir mibbesar hakkadashim leachar zeman achilatan shenneemar bekarban toda <small>(Vayikra 22 30)</small> "lo totiru mimmennu ad boker" vehu haddin lishar hakkadashim kullam. vehammotir eno loke shehare nitteko hakkatuv laase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 10)</small> "vehannotar mimmennu ad boker beesh tisrofu":
Haochel kezayit mibbesar kadashim shennotar. bemezid chayyav karet beshogeg mevi chattat kevua shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 8)</small> "veochlav avono yissa ki et kodesh Adonai chillel venichreta". umeematay yitchayyev karet al achilat hannotar. im kadshe kadashim hem chayyav alehen meachar sheyyaale ammud hashshachar. veim kadashim kallim hem chayyav alehen mishshekiat hachamma shel yom sheni shehu techillat hallayla shel yom shelishi. vehechan hizhir hakkatuv al happiggul veal hannotar. bammilluim. shehare neemar sham <small>(Shemot 29 33)</small> "lo yochal ki kodesh hem" lehazehir al kol sheppesulo bekodesh shehu belo taase al achilato:
Vehappiggul vehannotar mitztarfin ze im ze lichzayit. vechol happiggulim vehannotarin mitztarfin:
Asur letamme et hakkadashim o lesabbev lahem tuma shehare poslan. vehametamme et hakkadashim eno loke. aval adam tahor sheachal kezayit mikkadashim shennitmeu loke. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 19)</small> "vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel". vehu haddin lishar hakkarbanot sheim achal kezayit millevonat hammincha shennitmea achar shennitkaddesha bichli loke. echad kadashim shennitmeu lifne kappara o leachar kappara. ben shennitmeu beav hattuma o bivlad hattuma shel divre tora. aval im nitmeu betumot shel divrehem eno loke al achilatan. aval makkin oto makkat mardut. veeno loke ella haochel achar zerikat damim. aval im achal kodem zerika eno loke mishshum ochel kodesh tame. aval makkin oto makkat mardut:
Kol adam shennitma tuma shechayyavin aleha karet al biat hammikdash veachal kezayit min hakkadashim ben bekodesh tahor ben bekodesh tame. bemezid hare ze nitchayyev karet shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 20)</small> "vehannefesh asher tochal mizzevach hashshelamim asher laAdonai vetumato alav venichreta". veim achal bishgaga mevi karban ole veyored. uminnayin sheeno medabber ella betumat hagguf shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 21)</small> "venefesh ki tigga bechol tame betumat adam o bivhema temea o bechol sheketz tame veachal mibbesar zevach hashshelamim asher laAdonai venichreta". vehu haddin lishar kadshe mizbeach. vehechan hizhir al avon ze beyoledet shehare neemar bah <small>(Vayikra 12 4)</small> "bechol kodesh lo tigga": 
Mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo azhara letame shello yochal kodesh kodem sheyyitbol. vehaochel kodesh achar shettaval kodem sheyyeerav shimsho kodem sheyyavi kapparato loke. veeno chayyav karet shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 20)</small> "vetumato alav" ad shettihye kol tumato alav:
Haya tame betumot shel divrehem eno loke. veen tzarich lomar sheeno chayyav karet. aval makkin oto makkat mardut:
Eno chayyav karet al kodesh sheyyesh lo mattirin ad sheyyochal mimmennu achar shekkarvu mattirav. aval im achal et habbasar kodem zerikat haddam eno loke mishshum tame sheachal et hakkodesh. ze hakkelal kol sheyyesh lo mattirin en chayyavin alav mishshum piggul o mishshum notar o mishshum tame ad sheyyukrevu mattirav kehilchatan. vechol sheen lo mattirin kevan shekkadash bichli chayyavin alav mishshum tuma. afillu nitma habbasar kodem sheyyittame haochel hoil vekarvu hammattirin veachar kach achal chayyav karet. vechen im achal mibbesar chattaot hannisrafot vehu tame achar shennizrak damam hare ze chayyav karet:
Kevar nitbaer lecha sheaf devarim sheen chayyavin alehen mishshum piggul chayyavin alehen mishshum notar vetame. ketzad. devarim sheen lahem mattirin en chayyavin alehen mishshum piggul vechayyavin alehem mishshum notar vetame. vechen hammattirin atzman af al pi sheen chayyavin alehem mishshum piggul kemo shebbearnu chayyavin alehen mishshum notar vetame. chutz min haddam sheen chayyavin alav leolam ella mishshum davar echad bilvad:
Tame sheachal emurin chayyav karet:
Achal pesach shello nitzla. velachme toda shello hurema challatan. hare ze chayyav karet mishshum tumat hagguf. af al pi sheenan reuyin lema shehen. i efshar sheyyitchayyev adam al achila achat mishshum piggul umishshum notar. shehappiggul hu hakkarban shennifsal bemachshevet hazzeman veeno ole leshem karban velo nirtza kelal. vehannotar hu hannishar mikkarban shekkarev kemitzvato leachar zeman achilato:
Happiggul vehannotar vehattame shebbelalan ze baze vaachalan chayyav. af al pi sheribba min al chavero eno mevattelo sheen haissurin mevattelin ze et ze:
Ufiggul o notar o tame sheheelan lerosh hammizbeach mishshemmashla haur berubban paka issuran mehen. vehaemurin mitztarfin im habbasar lichzayit ben beola ben bishar kadashim lechayyev alav mishshum piggul o notar o tame:
Zevach shennitpaggel. o shennotar leachar zemanno veachal mimmennu. min haor. o min hammarak. o min hattavlin. o min haalal. o min hammura. min haggidim umin hakkarnayim umin hattelafayim. min hatztzipparnayim min hachartom umin hannotza umibbetze haof. eno chayyav karet. vechen teme hagguf sheachal devarim ellu mikkarban kasher eno chayyav karet. aval makkin oto makkat mardut:
Achal min hashshalil. o min hashshilya. chayyav mishshum piggul venotar vetame keochel mishshear besar hazzevach:
