Kadshe akkum en chayyavin alehem mishshum piggul venotar vetame. vechen dam hakkadashim kemo shebbearnu. vechen hallevona vehakketoret vehaetzim en chayyavin alehen karet lo mishshum piggul velo mishshum notar velo mishshum tumat hagguf:

Mitzvat ase lisrof kol hkkadashim shennitmeu shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 19)</small> "vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel baesh yissaref". vechen hannotar mitzvat ase lesarfo shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 17)</small> "vehannotar mibbesar hazzavach bayyom hashshelishi baesh yissaref". uvichlal hannotar happiggul vechol pesule hammukdashin hakkol nisrafin:
Karban shennitpaggel o nifsal yissaref bammikdash miyyad. vechol sheppissulo missafek teubbar tzurato veachar kach yissaref bammikdash:

Parim useirim hannisrafim yesh bahem safek im hallina vehayetzia kodem sheyyaggia zemannam latzet poselet besaram keemurehen o enah poselet besaran. lefichach poslin otan lehachemir veyissarfu baazara. vechen im yatza chatzi habbehema berov haevar im machazikin otan kayyotze hoil veyatza rov haevar o adayin enan yotzin shehare lo yatza rov habbehema. lefichach nifselu missafek veyissarfu baazara. vechen im nesaum chamishsha lehotzian veyatzu shelosha venisharu shenayim. vehotziu hashshelosha chatzi habbehema hare ellu nifselu missafek veyissarfu baazara. veyerae li sheen ellu tzerichin lehametin ad shetteebbar tzuratan hoil vehen omdin lisrefa leolam afillu lo nifselu:

Basar hannimtza baazara. evarim olot vachatichot chattaot. vehannimtza birushalayim shelamim. hakkol teebbar tzuratan veyetzu levet hasserefa shemma notar hu. im ken ma hoil shettihye chezkato ola o chattat o shelamim. lemi sheavar veachal. en sorfin et hannotar ella bayyom shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 17)</small> "bayyom hashshelishi baesh yissaref":

Af al pi shehashshelamim asurin baachila mittechillat lel shelishi. en sorfin otan ella bayyom. ben bizmanno ben shello bizmanno. vechen happiggul eno nisraf ella bayyom. veen serefat tame venotar ufiggul docha et yom tov veen tzarich lomar et hashshabbat. umuttar lisrof tame venotar ufiggul keechad:

Besar kadshe kadashim shennitma bifnim. sorfin oto bifnim. veim nitma bachutz sorfin oto bachutz. ben shennitma beav hattuma ben shennitma bivlad hattuma. umimehem shel kohanim lo nimneu millisrof et habbasar shennitma beav hattuma shehare hu rishon letuma im habbasar shennitma bivlad hattuma shehare hu shelishi af al pi shemmosifin lo tuma al tumato. shehashshelishi shennaga berishon yachzor sheni kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo. velo od ella afillu shemen shennifsal bitvul yom shehu shelishi muttar lehadeliko bener shel mattechet shennaga bah teme met shehanner av hattuma. af al pi shezze hashshemen naase rishon kesheyyigga bener hoil veyesh sham shum tuma en makpidin al tosefta veen nizharin ella min hattahor shello yippasel:
Notar shel kadashim kallim sorfin oto bealav bevattehen:

Mi sheyyatza mirushalayim venizkar sheyyesh beyado besar kodesh. im avar hatztzofin sorfo bimkomo. veim lav im yesh bo kezayit o yeter chozer vesorfo birushalayim. veim hu oreach sheen lo bayit sorfo lifne habbira meatze hammaaracha:

Kol atzmot hakkadashim sheen bahen moach enan teunin serefa chutz meatzmot happesach. kevar bearnu shehakkarban shennifsal achar shehufshat haor lakkohanim o livalav bekadashim kallim. aval im nifsal kodem hefshet. hare haor kevasar veyissaref hakkol. vechen zevach shehufshat venimtza terefa o shennifsal bemachshevet hazzeman o bemachshevet hammakom. hoil velo nirtza hazzevach yissaref haor ben bekadshe kadashim ben bekadashim kallim. aval im naasa bemachshevet shinnuy hashshem. af al pi shello ala labbealim hoil venirtza hare haor lakkohanim o livalav kemo shebbearnu. vezevach shehufshat kodem zerika eno posel:

Ellu hen hannisrafim. besar kodesh shennitma o notar o nifsal. vechen hammincha shennitmea o nifsela o notra. veasham taluy shennoda lo shello chata kodem shennizrak damo vechattat haof habbaa al hassafek. usear nazir tahor. vehaarla vechile hakkerem. vedavar sheen darko lehissaref kegon mashkin shel arla veshel kile hakkerem hare ellu yikkaveru:

Veellu hem hannikbarim. kadashim shemmetu ben kadshe mizbeach ben kadshe bedek habbayit. vekadashim shehippilu nefel. hippilu shilya tikkaver. veshor hanniskal. veegla arufa. vetzippore metzora. usear nazir tame. ufeter chamor. uvasar bechalav. vechullin shennishchatu baazara:
Haoreg melo hassit missear nazir umippeter chamor besak yiddalek:
Kol hannikbarin efran asur. vechol hannisrafin shel hekdesh efram muttar chutz middeshen hammizbeach hachitzon vehappenimi vedishun hammenora:
Kol hannisrafin lo yikkavru. vechen kol hannikbarim lo yissarfu. sheaf al pi shehu machmir bisrefato hare hekel beefran. sheefer hannikbarim asur:

Haya makriv immo bizvachim veamar lo nitpaggelu. ose immo betohorot veamar lo nitmeu. neeman. lo nechshedu yisrael al kach. aval im amar lo zevachim shehikravti lecha beoto hayyom nitpaggelu. veotan hattohorot nitmeu. im haya neeman lo somech al devarav. veim lav shurat haddin sheeno neeman. veharotze lehachemir al atzmo hare ze meshubbach:
Mishneh Torah, Service on the Day of Ato: Veyom hatztzom makrivin tamid bashshachar vetamid ben haarbayim keseder kol yom veyom. umakrivin musaf hayyom par veayil veshiva kevasim kullam olot. vesair chattat naase bachutz vehu neechol laerev. veod makrivin yeter al musaf ze. par ben bakar lechattat vehu nisraf. veayil leola. ushenehem mishshel kohen gadol. veayil habba mishshel tzibbur haamur befarashat <small>(Vayikra 16 1)</small> "achare mot". vehu haayil haamur bechummash happekudim bichlal hammusaf. vehu hannikra el haam. veod meviin mishshel tzibbur shene seire izzim. echad karev chattat vehu nisraf. vehashsheni sair hammishtalleach. nimtzeu kol habbehemot hakkerevim beyom ze chamesh esre. shene temidin. ufar. ushene elim veshiva kevasim kullam olot. ushene seirim chattat echad naase bachutz veneechal laerev vehashsheni naase bifnim venisraf. ufar kohen gadol lechattat vehu nisraf:

Avodat kol chamesh esre behemot ellu hakkerevin beyom ze enah ella bechohen gadol bilvad. echad kohen hammashuach beshemen hammishcha o hamerubbe bivgadim. veim hayta shabbat af musaf shabbat en makriv oto ella kohen gadol. vechen shear haavodot shel yom ze kegon haketarat hakketoret shel kol yom vahatavat hannerot hakkol asuy bechohen gadol nasuy shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 6)</small> <small>(Vayikra 16 11)</small> <small>(Vayikra 16 17)</small> "vechipper baado uvead beto". beto zo ishto:

Shivat yamim kodem leyom hakkippurim mafrishin kohen gadol mibbeto lelishkato shebbammikdash vedavar ze kabbala mimmoshe rabbenu. umafrishin oto meishto kol shivat yamim ellu shemma timmatze ishto nidda venimtza tame shivat yamim veeno yachol laavod. umatkinin lo kohen gadol acher sheim yeera beze pissul yaavod haacher tachtav. ben sheera bo pissul kodem tamid shel shachar ben sheera bo pissul achar shehikriv karbano ze shennichnas tachtav eno tzarich chinnuch ella avodato mechannachto umatchil meavoda sheppasak bah harishon. avar yom hakkippurim hare harishon chozer laavodato vehashsheni over vechol mitzvot kehunna gedola alav ella sheeno oved kechohen gadol veim avad avodato keshera. veim met harishon ze hashsheni mitmanne tachtav:

Beshivat yamim ellu mazzin alav meefer happara bashshelishi lehaferashato uvashshevii shehu erev yom hakkippurim shemma nitma bemet velo yada. veim chal yom shabbat bashshelishi o bashshevii shello dochin et hahazzaya:

Kol shivat hayyamim margilin oto baavodot. zorek et haddam umaktir et hakketoret umetiv et hannerot umaktir evre tamid al hammizbeach kede sheyyihye ragil baavoda beyom hakkippurim. umosrin lo zekenim mizzikne bet din vekorim lefanav umelammedin oto avodat hayyom vesiddurah veomrin lo ishi kohen gadol kera atta beficha shemma shachachta o shemma lo lamadta davar ze. veerev yom hakkippurim beshacharit hayu maamidin oto beshaare hammizrach umaavirin lefanav parim veelim uchevasim kede sheyyihye makkir veragil baavoda:

Kol shivat hayyamim lo hayu monin mimmennu maachol umashke. erev yom hakkippurim im chashecha lo hayu mannichin oto leechol harebe shehammaachol mevi et hashshena. velo hayu mannichin oto lishon shemma yire keri. velo hayu maachilin oto devarim hammargilin leshichvat zera kegon betzim vechalav cham vechayyotze bahen:

Bime bayit sheni tzatz hamminut beyisrael. veyatzu hatztzedokin mehera yovedu sheenan maaminin battora shebbeal pe. vehayu omrin shekketoret shel yom hakkippurim mannichin otah al haesh bahechol chutz lapparochet uchesheyyaale ashanah machnis otah lefanim lekodesh hakkadashim. hattaam. ze shekkatuv battora <small>(Vayikra 16 2)</small> "ki beanan erae al hakkapporet" amru ki hu anan hakketoret. umippi hashshemua lamdu chachamim sheen noten hakketoret ella bekodesh hakkadashim lifne haaron. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 13)</small> "venatan hakketoret al haesh lifne Adonai". ulefi shehayu choshshin bevayit sheni shemma kohen gadol ze note letzad minut. hayu mashbiin oto erev yom hakkippurim veomrim lo ishi kohen gadol anu sheluche bet din veatta sheluchenu usheliach bet din. mashbiin anu alecha bemi sheshshikken et shemo babbayit hazze shello teshanne davar sheamarnu lecha. vehu poresh uvoche al shechashaduhu beminut. vehen porshin uvochin lefi shechashdu lemi shemmaasav setumin shemma en belibbo kelum:

Kol lele yom hakkippurim kohen gadol yoshev vedoresh im haya chacham. veim haya talmid dorshim lefanav. im haya ragil likro kore veim lav korin lefanav. kede shello yishan. uvamme korin lefanav. bechitve hakkodesh. bikkesh lehitnamnem pirche leviyya makkin lefanav beetzba tzereda. veomrim lo ishi kohen gadol amod vehitztannen meat al haritzpa kede shello tishan. umitassekin immo ad shemmaggia zeman shechita. velo hayu shochatin ad shemmakkirin sheala ammud hashshachar bevadday shemma yishchatu ballayla:

Kol maase hattemidin vehammusafin shel yom ze kohen gadol ose otan vehu lavush bevigde zahav. vaavodot hameyuchadot leyom ze bevigde lavan. vaavoda hameyuchedet leyom ze hi maase happar shel kohen gadol. ushene hasseirim sheechad mehen sair hammishtalleach. vehaketarat hakketoret bekodesh hakkadashim. kol ellu bevigde lavan hem naasim:

Kol et sheyyeshanne habbegadim veyifshot begadim velovesh begadim acherim taun tevila. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 23)</small> "ufashat et bigde habbad" <small>(Vayikra 16 24)</small> "verachatz et besaro vammayim bemakom kadosh velavash et begadav". vechamesh tevilot vaasara kiddushin tovel kohen gadol umekaddesh bo bayyom. ketzad. battechilla poshet bigde chol shealav vetovel veole umistappeg velovesh bigde zahav umekaddesh yadav veraglav. veshochet et hattamid umaktir ketoret shel shachar shel kol yom umetiv et hannerot umaktir evre hattamid im hachavitin vehannesachim umakriv happar veshiva kevasim shel musaf hayyom. veachar kach mekaddesh yadav veraglav ufoshet bigde hazzahav vetovel veole umistappeg velovesh bigde lavan. umekaddesh yadav veraglav veoved avodat hayyom kol havvidduyyim im hahagrala uzerikat haddamim bifnim vehaketarat hakketoret bekodesh hakkadashim. umoser hassair lamshallecho laazazel. umotzi emure happar vehassair hannisrafim umoser sheeran lisrefa. veachar kach mekaddesh yadav veraglav ufoshet bigde lavan vetovel veole umistappeg. velovesh bigde zahav umekaddesh yadav veraglav. umakriv seir chattat shel musaf hayyom veelo veel haam. vehem olot. umaktir emure par vesair hannisrafin. umakriv tamid shel ben haarbayim. veachar kach mekaddesh yadav veraglav ufoshet bigde zahav. vetovel veole umistappeg velovesh bigde lavan. umekaddesh yadav veraglav. venichnas lekodesh hakkadashim. umotzi mishsham et hakkaf veet hammachta. veachar kach mekaddesh yadav veraglav ufoshet bigde lavan. vetovel veole umistappeg. velovesh bigde zahav umekaddesh yadav veraglav. umaktir ketoret shel ben haarbayim shel kol yom umetiv et hannerot ben haarbayim. umekaddesh yadav veraglav. ufoshet bigde zahav velovesh bigde chol veyotze:

Kol hattevilot haellu vehakkiddushin kullan bammikdash shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 24)</small> "verachatz et besaro vammayim bemakom kadosh". chutz mittevila rishona shehu rashshay litbol otah bechol sheenah ella lehosif kavvanato. sheim yizkor tuma yeshana shebbeyado yifrosh mimmenna bitvila zo lishmah. vechol kohen shello taval ben begadim livgadim o shello kiddesh ben beged leveged uven avoda laavoda veavad. avodato keshera:

Haya kohen gadol zaken o chole melabbenin ashashiyyot shel barzel beesh mibbaerev ulemachar metilin otan bemayim kede lehafig tzinnatan sheen shevut bammikdash. o mearvin mayim chammin beme hammikve ad shettafig tzinnatan:

Bechol yom kohen gadol mekaddesh yadav veraglav min hakkiyyor kishar hakkohanim vehayyom mekaddesh mikkiton shel zahav mishshum kevodo. bechol yom hakkohanim olim bemizracho shel kevesh veyordin bemaaravo vehayyom olim baemtza veyordin baemtza lifne kohen gadol kede lehaddero. bechol yom mi shezzacha bammachta chote bemachta shel kesef umeare haesh lemachta shel zahav vehayyom chote kohen gadol bemachta shel zahav uvah nichnas lahechol. shello leyaggeo betosefet avoda. vechen machta shel kol yom machzeket arbaa kabbin veshel hayyom shelosha kabbin uvechol yom hayta keveda vehayyom kalla. uvechol yom yadah ketzara vehayyom arukka kede lehakel al kohen gadol shello yiga. bechol yom veyom hayu al hammizbeach shalosh maarachot shel esh vehayyom hayu sham arba. mosifin maaracha kede lehadder hammizbeach uleattero:

Ze shenneemar battora <small>(Vayikra 16 17)</small> "vechipper baado uvead beto uvead kol kehal yisrael". mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze vidduy devarim. nimtzeta lamed shehu mitvadde beyom ze shelosha vidduyim. echad al yede atzmo techilla. vidduy sheni al yede atzmo im shear hakkohanim. ushenehem al par hachattat asher lo. vehavvidduy shelishi al yede kol yisrael al sair hammishtalleach. umazkir et hashshem bechol vidduy mehen shalosh peamim. ketzad hu omer. anna hashshem chatati aviti ufashati lefanecha anna hashshem kapper na lachataim velaavonot velappeshaim shechatati vesheaviti vesheppashati vechulei shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 30)</small> "ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem letaher etchem mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai titharu". hare shalosh peamim hizkir et hashshem. vechen bechol vidduy mehen. ucheshehu noten et haggoral al seir hachattat omer lahashshem chattat. nimtza mazkir et hashshem bayyom ze eser peamim. uvechullam hu mazkir kichtavo shehu hashshem hameforash. barishona haya magbiah et kolo bashshem. kevan sherabbu perutzin chazru leamro bekol namuch umavlio binimut ad shello yakkiru bo afillu chaverav hakkohanim:

Kol hakkohanim vehaam haomdim baazara keshehem shomim et hashshem hameforash yotze mippi kohen gadol bikdushsha uvetohora. hayu korim umishtachavim venoflim al penehem veomrim baruch shem kavod malchuto leolam vaed shenneemar <small>(Devarim 32 3)</small> "ki shem Adonai ekra havu godel lelohenu". uvishloshet havvidduyyim haya mitkavven ligmor et hashshem keneged hamevarchin veomer lahen titharu. vechol hayyom kasher levidduy yom hakkippurim ulevidduy happarim hannisrafim:

Shenne haggoralot echad katuv alav lahashshem veechad katuv alav laazazel. vehem kesherim mikkol davar ben min haetz ben min haeven ben min hammattechet. aval lo yihye echad gadol veechad katan. echad kesef veechad zahav. ella shenehem shavin. veshel etz hayu. uvevayit sheni asu otam shel zahav. umannichin shene haggoralot bichli echad hammachazik shete hayyadayim kede sheyyachnis shete yadav velo yitkavven. ucheli ze chol hu. veshel etz haya vekalpi shemo:
Hechan magril. bemizrach haazara bitzfon hammizbeach. mannichin sham hakkalpi. umaamidin shene hasseirim penehen lammaarav vaachorehem lammizrach. vechohen gadol ba lesham vehassegan mimino verosh bet av missemolo ushene hasseirim lefanav echad limino veechad lismolo:
Taraf bakkalpi veheela shene haggoralot bishte yadav leshem shene hasseirim ufoteach yadav. im shel shem ala bimino hassegan omer ishi kohen gadol hagebeah yemincha. veim bismol ala rosh bet av omer lo ishi kohen gadol hagebeah semolcha. venoten shene haggoralot al shenehem. shel yamin al yamin veshel semol al shel semol. veim lo natan lo ikkev ella shechisser mitzva. shehahannacha mitzva sheenah meakkevet vehahagrala meakkevet af al pi sheenah avoda. lefichach hahannacha keshera bezar vehaalayat haggoralot min hakkalpi pesula bezar:
Vekosher leshon zehorit mishkal shete selaim berosh sair hammishtalleach umaamido keneged bet shillucho velannishchat keneged bet shechitato. veshochet et par hachattat asher lo veet hassair sheala alav haggoral lashshem:
Umachnis daman lahechol umazze middam shenehen bayyom hazze arbaim veshalosh hazzayot. veellu hen. mazze techilla middam happar shemone hazzayot bekodesh hakkadashim ben badde haaron karov lakkapporet betefach shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 14)</small> "velifne hakkapporet yazze" vegomer. umazze sham achat lemala vesheva lematta. mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 14)</small> "sheva peamim" yazze yeter al hazzaya rishona. vechach haya mone. achat. achat veachat achat ushetayim achat veshalosh achat vearba achat vechamesh achat veshesh achat vesheva. velamma mone kacha shemma yishkach veyimne hazzaya rishona mikkelal hashsheva. veachar kach mazze middam hassair ben badde haaron shemone achat lemala vesheva lematta umone kederech shemmone bedam happar. vechozer umazze bahechol al happarochet middam happar shemone. achat lemala vesheva lematta shekkach neemar bedam happar <small>(Vayikra 16 15)</small> "al hakkapporet velifne hakkapporet". umone kederech shemmone bifnim. vechozer umazze middam hassair ken al happarochet shemone hazzayot achat lemala vesheva lematta. shenneemar bedam hassair <small>(Vayikra 16 15)</small> "veasa et damo kaasher asa ledam happar". umone kederech shemmone bifnim. vechol ellu hahazzayot eno mitkavven bahen lehazzot lo lemala velo lematta ella kematzlif. veachar kach mearev shene haddamim dam happar vedam hassair umazze mishshenehem arba hazzayot al arba karnot mizbach hazzahav shebbahechol vesheva hazzayot al emtzao shel mizbeach ze:
Vechol ellu haarbaim veshalosh hazzayot tovel etzbao bedam tevila al kol hazzaya lo sheyyazze shete hazzayot mittevila achat. usheyare haddam shofech al yesod maaravi shel mizbeach hachitzon:
Veachar kach meshalleach et hassair hachay beyad ish hammuchan leholicho lammidbar. vehakkol kesherim leholicho ella sheasu kohanim gedolim keva velo hayu mannichim et yisrael leholicho. vesukkot hayu osin mirushalayim ad techillat hammidbar. veshovet ish echad o anashim harebe bechol sukka vesukka mehen kede sheyyihyu melavvin oto missukka lesukka. al kol sukka vesukka omrin lo hare mazon vahare mayim. im kashal kocho vetzarich leechol ochel. umeolam lo hutzrach adam lechach. veanshe hassukka haacharona omdin besof hattechum veroin et maasav merachok. ketzad haya ose. cholek lashon shel zehorit shebbekarnav. chetzyo kosher bassela vechetzyo kosher ben shete karnav. vedochafo laachorav vehu mitgalgel veyored. lo haya maggia lachatzi hahar ad shehu naase evarim evarim. uva veyoshev lo tachat sukka haacharona ad shettecheshach. vedarchiyyot hayu osin umenifin besudarin kede sheyyedu shehiggia sair lammidbar. veachar shemmeshalleach et hassair beyad molicho chozer etzel happar vehassair shehizza daman lefanim vekoran umotzi et emurehen venotnam bichli umaktiran al gabbe hammizbeach. umechattech shear besaran chatichot gedolot meorot zo bezo kemin kelia veeno mefarek otan umeshallechan beyad acherim lehotzian levet hasserefa. umenattechin otan sham beoran kemo shebbearnu:
Kevan shehiggia sair lammidbar yatza kohen gadol leezrat hannashim likrot battora. uvizman keriato sorfin happar vehassair bevet haddeshen. lefichach haroe kohen gadol keshehu kore eno roe par vesair hannisrafin. userefatan keshera bezar kemo shebbearnu:
Keria zo enah avoda lefichach im ratza likrot bevigde chol levanim mishshello kore. veim ratza likrot bevigde lavan kore shebbigde kehunna nittenu lehanot bahen shello bishat avoda kemo shebbearnu:
Ketzad hu kore. yoshev beezrat hannashim vechol haam omdin lefanav. vechazzan hakkeneset notel sefer tora venotno lerosh hakkeneset verosh hakkeneset notno lassegan vehassegan notno lechohen gadol. vechohen gadol omed umekabbel omed vekore <small>(Vayikra 16 1)</small> "achare mot" v<small>(Vayikra 23 27)</small> "ach beasor" shebbefarashat moadot ad sof hainyan vegolel et hattora umannichah becheko veomer yoter mimma shekkarati lifnechem katuv kan. uveasor shebbechummash happekudim ad sof hainyan kore oto al pe. velamma kore al pe sheen gollin sefer tora betzibbur. velamma lo yikra besefer acher. lefi sheen echad kore bishne sefarim mishshum pegam rishon: 
Beet shekkore mevarech lefaneha uleachareha kederech shemmevarchin bevet hakkeneset. umosif leachareha sheva berachot veellu hen. retze Adonai elohenu vechulei modim anachnu lach vechulei selach lanu avinu ki chatanu vechulei vechotem bah baruch atta Adonai mochel avonot ammo yisrael berachamim. hare shalosh berachot ketiknan. umevarech al hammikdash beracha bifne atzmah yihye inyanah sheyyaamod hammikdash ushechina betocho vechotem bah baruch atta Adonai shochen betziyyon. umevarech al yisrael beracha bifne atzmah inyanah sheyyoshia Adonai et yisrael velo yasur mehen melech vechotem bah baruch atta Adonai habbocher beyisrael. umevarech al hakkohanim beracha bifne atzmah inyanah sheyyirtze hammakom maasehem vaavodatam vivarchem vechotem bah baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh hakkohanim. veachar kach omer tefilla utechinna verinna uvakkasha kefi ma shehu ragil vechotem hosha Adonai ammecha yisrael sheammecha yisrael tzerichin lehivvasha baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla:

Seder kol hammaasim shebbeyom ze kach hu. kachatzot hallayla mefisin litrumat haddeshen. umesadderin et hammaaracha umedashshenin et hammizbeach kederech sheosin bechol yom al hasseder shebbearnu ad sheyyaggiu lishchitat hattamid. kesheyyaggiu lishchot et hattamid porsin sadin shel butz ben kohen gadol uven haam. velamma shel butz kede sheyyakkir sheavodat hayyom bevigde butz. ufoshet bigde chol vetovel velovesh bigde zahav umekaddesh yadav veraglav. veshochet betamid rov shenayim umanniach acher ligmor hashshechita. umekabbel haddam vezorko al hammizbeach kemitzvato. veachar kach nichnas lahechol umaktir ketoret shel shachar umetiv et hannerot. umaktir evre hattamid vehachavitin vehannesachim kechol seder hattamid shel kol yom shebbearnu. veachar hattamid makriv happar veshivat hakkevasim shel musaf hayyom. veachar kach mekaddesh yadav veraglav ufoshet bigde zahav. vetovel velovesh bigde lavan umekaddesh yadav veraglav. uva lo etzel paro. ufaro haya omed ben haulam velammizbeach rosho laddarom ufanav lammaarav vehakkohen omed bammizrach ufanav lammaarav. vesomech shete yadav al rosh happar umitvadde. vechach haya omer anna hashshem chatati aviti pashati lefanecha ani uveti. anna hashshem kapper na lachataim velaavonot velappeshaim shechatati vesheaviti vesheppashati lefanecha ani uveti kakkatuv betorat moshe avdecha lemor <small>(Vayikra 16 30)</small> "ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem letaher etchem mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai titharu". veachar kach magril al shene hasseirim. vekosher lashon shel zehorit berosh hammishtalleach umaamido keneged bet shillucho velannishchat keneged bet shechitato. uva lo etzel paro sheniyya vesomech shete yadav al rosho umitvadde vidduy sheni. vechach hu omer anna hashshem chatati aviti pashati lefanecha ani uveti uvene aharon am kedoshecha. anna hashshem kapper na lachataim velaavonot velappeshaim shechatati vesheaviti vesheppashati lefanecha ani uveti uvene aharon am kedoshecha kakkatuv betorat moshe avdecha ki vayyom hazze vegomer. veachar kach shochet et happar umekabbel et damo venotno lemi shehu menadnedo shello yikkaresh (umannichah) al haroved harvii shel hechol mibbachutz. venotel et hammachta vechote bah esh meal hammizbeach min hassamuch lammaarav. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 12)</small> "meal hammizbeach millifne Adonai". veyored umannichah al haroved shebbaazara. umotziin lo et hakkaf ucheli male ketoret dakka min haddakka. vechofen mimmenna melo chafnav lo mechukot velo gedushot ella tefufot haggadol lefi gadlo vehakkatan lefi katno venoten letoch hakkaf. kevar bearnu sheholacha bismol poselet bedam hakkadashim ushear haavodot. ulefichach haya min haddin sheyyolich hammachta bismolo vechaf hakketoret bimino. aval mippene koved hammachta veod shehi chamma. eno yachol lesavlah bismolo ad haaron. lefichach notel hammachta bimino vechaf hakketoret bismolo. umehallech bahechol ad shehu maggia lekodesh hakkadashim. matza happarochet perufa nichnas lekodesh hakkadashim ad shehu maggia laaron. higgia laaron noten hammachta ben shene habbaddim uvevayit sheni shello haya aron haya mannichah al even hashshetiyya. veochez sefat hakkaf berashe etzbeotav o beshinnav. umeare hakketoret begudalo letoch chafnav ad shemmachzirah limlo chafnav keshehayta. vezo hi avoda kasha shebbammikdash. vetzover et hakketoret al gabbe haggechalim beyado lefanim bammachta. kede shettihye hakketoret kerova laaron urechoka mippanav shello yikkave. umamtin sham ad sheyyitmalle habbayit ashan veyetze. vehu mehallech achorannit meat meat panav lakkodesh vaachorav lahechol ad sheyyetze min happarochet. umitpallel sham bahechol achar sheyyetze tefilla ketzara shello lehaveit et haam shemma yomru met bahechol. vechach haya mitpallel. yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu sheim tihye shana zo shechuna tihye geshuma. velo yasur shevet mibbet yehuda. velo yihyu ammecha bet yisrael tzerichin lefarnasa [1.] veal tikkanes lefanecha tefillat ovre derachim: 
Bishat haketarat hakketoret bekodesh hakkadashim. kol haam porshim min hahechol bilvad veenan porshim mibben haulam velammizbeach. sheen porshim mibben haulam velammizbeach ella bishat haketara bahechol bechol yom uvishat mattan damim bahechol kemo shebbearnu behilchot temidin. veachar kach notel dam happar mizze shehu menadnedo. venichnas bo lekodesh hakkadashim umazze mimmennu sham shemone hazzayot ben badde haaron. veyotze umannicho bahechol al kan hazzahav shehaya sham. veachar kach yotze min hahechol veshochet et hassair umekabbel et damo venichnas bo lekodesh hakkadashim. umazze mimmennu sham shemone hazzayot ben badde haaron. veyotze umannicho al kan hazzahav sheni shebbahechol. veachar kach notel dam happar meal hakkan umazze mimmennu al happarochet keneged haaron shemone hazzayot umanniach dam happar venotel dam hassair umazze mimmennu al happarochet keneged haaron shemone hazzayot. veachar kach meare dam happar letoch dam hassair umachazir hakkol lammizrak shehaya bo dam happar kede sheyyitarvu yafe yafe. veomed lefanim mimmizbach hazzahav ben hammizbeach vehammenora. umatchil lehazzot middam hattaarovet al karnot mizbach hazzahav. vehu mesabbev veholech umazze al hakkeranot mibbachutz. umatchil mikkeren mizrachit tzefonit. litzfonit maaravit. lemaaravit deromit. lidromit mizrachit. veal kullan hu noten millemattan lemalan. chutz min haacharona shehayta lefanav shehu noten millemalan lemattan. kede shello yitlachlechu kelav. vechote haggechalim vehaefer shebbemizbach hazzahav helach vehelach ad shemmegalle zehavo. umazze middam hattaarovet al tohoro shel mizbeach sheva peamim betzad haddarom bemakom sheshshalmu mattenot karnotav. veyotze veshofech sheyare haddam al yesod maaravi shel mizbeach hachitzon. veachar kach ba etzel sair hammishtalleach vesomech shete yadav al rosho umitvadde. vechach hu omer anna hashshem chatu avu ufashu lefanecha ammecha bet yisrael. anna hashshem kapper na lachataim velaavonot velappeshaim shechatu vesheavu vesheppashu lefanecha ammecha bet yisrael kakkatuv betorat moshe avdecha <small>(Vayikra 16 30)</small> "ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem" vegomer. veachar kach meshalleach et hassair lammidbar. umotzi emure par vesair shehichnis daman lefanim venotnan bichli. umeshalleach hashshear levet haddeshen lisrefa. veyotze leezrat hannashim vekore sham achar sheyyaggia hassair lammidbar. veachar kach mekaddesh ufoshet bigde lavan vetovel velovesh bigde zahav umekaddesh yadav veraglav. veose hassair hannaase bachutz shehu mikkelal karbenot musaf hayyom. umakriv elo veel haam shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 24)</small> "veyatza veasa et olato veet olat haam". umaktir haemurin shel par vesair hannisrafin. umakriv tamid shel ben haarbayim. veachar kach mekaddesh yadav veraglav ufoshet bigde zahav vetovel velovesh bigde lavan umekaddesh venichnas lekodesh hakkadashim umotzi et hakkaf veet hammachta. veachar kach mekaddesh ufoshet bigde lavan vetovel velovesh bigde zahav umekaddesh umaktir ketoret shel ben haarbayim umetiv et hannerot shel ben haarbayim kishar hayyamim. veachar kach mekaddesh yadav veraglav ufoshet bigde zahav velovesh bigde atzmo veyotze leveto vechol haam melavvin oto ad beto. veyom tov haya ose al sheyyatza beshalom min hakkodesh:
Kol avodot sheoved bevigde lavan bifnim bahechol tzarich laasotan al hasseder shebbearnu. veim hikdim bahen maase lachavero lo asa kelum:

Ketoret shechafanah kodem shechitat happar lo asa kelum. af al pi shehachafina baazara tzorech penim kaavodat penim hi. vechen sair sheshshechato kodem mattan damo shel par lo asa kelum. af al pi shehashshechita baazara hare damo nichnas lefanim:
El useir hammusafin sheasa otan kodem avodat hayyom enan kelum:

Hikdim dam hassair ledam happar bekodesh hakkadashim kodem sheyyigmor avodato. yazze middam happar kemitzvato veachar kach yavi sair acher veyishchot oto veyazze middamo bekodesh hakkadashim kemitzvato veyippasel harishon. hikdim dam hassair ledam happar bemattanot shebbahechol al happarochet yachzor veyazze middam hassair paam sheniyya leachar dam happar:
Nishpach haddam ad shello gamar mattanot shebbekodesh hakkadashim. yavi dam acher veyachzor veyazze battechilla bekodesh hakkadashim:
Gamar mattanot shebbekodesh hakkadashim vehitchil bemattanot shebbahechol venishpach haddam ad shello gamar yavi dam acher veyatchil mittechillat hazzayot shebbahechol:
Gamar mattanot shebbahechol vehitchil litten al mizbach hazzahav venishpach haddam ad shello gamar. yavi dam acher umatchil mittechillat mattenot hammizbeach shekkullan kappara bifne atzman hen:

Gamar mattenot hammizbeach veachar kach nishpach haddam eno tzarich lehavi dam acher. sheshshefichat hashsheyarim al mizbeach hachitzon enah meakkevet. veim dam happar hu shennishpach kodem sheyyigmor kol hammattanot hare ze mevi par acher. veyachafon ketoret paam sheniyya kodem shechitat happar. veyaktir hakketoret veachar kach yavi damo veyazze mimmennu:
Veen metamme begadim veen nisraf bevet haddeshen ella happar hazze haacharon shebbo nigmera hakkappara:

Nitarev lo dam happar bedam hassair kodem sheyyigmor hahazzayot. noten achat lemala vesheva lematta leshem par. vechozer venoten achat lemala vesheva lematta leshem sair. nitarvu bemattana acharona. noten achat lematta leshem par vechozer venoten achat lemala vesheva lematta leshem sair:

Nitchallefu hakkosot velo yada e ze hu kos dam happar vee ze hu kos dam hassair noten meechad mehen achat lemala vesheva lematta. venoten min hashsheni achat lemala vesheva lematta. (vechozer venoten min harishon achat lemala vesheva lematta). nimtza mikkol makom shennatan middam happar veacharav middam hassair:

Kibbel dam happar bishte kosot. vekibbel dam hassair bishte kosot. venitarvu miktzat hakkosot. velo noda kos dam happar mikkos dam hassair. hare ze mazze kol hahazzayot kemitzvatan min hakkosot shello nitarvu. veshofach sheyare ellu shehizza mehen al hayesod kammitzva. veotan hakkosot shennitarvu yishshafchu laamma:

Par yom hakkippurim af al pi shekkohen gadol kone mishshello shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 6)</small> <small>(Vayikra 16 11)</small> "par hachattat asher lo". hammakom hifkir mamono bo lechol echav hakkohanim. sheillu lo haya lahen bo shuttafut lo hayu mitkapperin bo. lefichach im met kohen gadol kodem sheyyishshachet happar. hakkohen sheomed tachtav eno mevi par acher ella shochet et shel rishon. veeno chattat shemmetu bealeha shettamut sheen chattat harabbim meta. shachat et happar umet kodem sheyyechapper bedamo. hakkohen haacher nichnas bedam ze umechapper bo:
Shene seire yom hakkippurim mitzvatan sheyyihyu shavin bemare uvekoma uvedamim. ulekichatan keachat. af al pi sheenan shavin kesherin. lakach echad mehen hayyom veechad lemachar kesherim:

Met echad mehen. im ad shello higril met yikkach zug lesheni. veim mishshehigril met yavi shenayim veyagril alehen battechilla veroe e zehu shemmet. im haya shel shem omer ze sheala alav haggoral lashshem yitkayyem tachtav. veim haya hammet shel azazel yomar ze sheala alav haggoral laazazel yitkayyem tachtav. vehashsheni min hashshenayim shehigril alehen bassof yire ad sheyyippol bo mum veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava. sheen chattat hatztzibbur meta:

Par vesair shel yom hakkippurim sheavdu vehifrish acherim tachtehen vekarvu venimtzeu harishonim. yiru ad sheyyistaavu veyimmachru veyippelu demehen lindava. vechen im nimtzeu harishonim kodem sheyyikkarvu ellu yikkarvu harishonim veyiru hashsheniyyim ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyippelu demehen lindava. sheen chattat hatztzibbur meta:
Hammum posel besair hammishtalleach afillu mum over. vechen im naasa mechussar zeman nifsal. kegon shennishchata immo lechole beyom hakkippurim. sheddechiyyato laazazel hi shechitato:
Haya terefa pasul shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 10)</small> "yoomad chay":
Chala hassair veen yachol lehallech markivo al ketefo vaafillu beshabbat:
Chala hameshalleach hare ze meshallecho beyad acher:
Nitma hameshalleach hare ze nichnas lammikdash venotlo veyotze. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 21)</small> "beyad ish itti hammidbara". beyad ze shehuchan afillu nitma:
Dechafo venafal hassair velo met. yered acharav vimitennu bechol davar shemmemito. veevre sair ze muttarin bahanaya:
Nifchata tikra shel hechol lo haya mazze. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 17)</small> "beohel moed":
Mizbeach shello nitchannech bakketoret lo yazze alav. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 7)</small> "mizbach ketoret hassammim":

Chisser min hakketoret echad missammaneha o maale ashan chayyav mita aleha shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 2)</small> "velo yamut ki beanan erae al hakkapporet". vechen chayyav mita al biato belo mitzva. lefichach im shagag bevia vehezid biktoret. o shennichnas biktoret shelema im hachasera chayyav mita:
Hiktir min hakketoret shel kodesh hakkadashim kezayit bahechol chayyav mita:
Chafinat hakketoret avoda. vehammachshava poselet bah. vechen chatiyyat haggechalim lakketoret nifselet bemachshava. shemmachshire karban kekarban:

Chafan berashe etzbeotav o min hatztzedadin o mimmatta lemala o shechafan beyado zo uveyado zo vekarav zo lazo. o shennitpazzera ketoret miyyado al haaretz vaasafah. o shechafan chavero venatan lechafnav. o shechafan umet venichnas sheni bema shechafan rishon. kol ellu safek velo yaktir veim hiktir hurtza:
Mishneh Torah, Trespass 1: Asur lehedyot lehanot mikkadshe hashshem. ben middevarim hakkerevin al gabbe hammizbeach. ben mikkadshe bedek habbayit. vechol hannehene bishve peruta mikkadshe hashshem maal:

Devarim shehutteru baachila min hakkarbanot. kegon besar chattat veasham achar zerikat daman o shete hallechem achar zerikat dam shene hakkevasim en bahen meila. afillu achal hazzar meellu vechayyotze bahen. hoil vehen muttarin lemiktzat bene adam lehanot bahen kol hannehene mehen lo maal. vaafillu nifselu veneesru baachila hoil vehayta lahen sheat hetter en chayyavin alehen meila:

Kol hammoel bezadon loke umeshallem ma sheppagam min hakkodesh berosho. veazhara shel meila mizze shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha" vegomer <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> "unedarecha". mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo azhara laochel mibbesar ola hoil vechullo lashshem. vehu haddin lishar kol kodesh shehu lahashshem levaddo ben mikkadshe hammizbeach ben mikkadshe bedek habbayit im nehene bahen sheve peruta loke. maal bishgaga meshallem ma shennehena vetosefet chomesh. umevi ayil bishne selaim umakrivo asham umitkapper lo vezehu hannikra asham meilot. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 15)</small> "vechata bishgaga mikkadshe Adonai vehevi et ashamo" vegomer <small>(Vayikra 5 16)</small> "veet asher chata min hakkodesh yeshallem veet chamishito" vegomer. veshillum hakkeren betosefet chomesh im havaat hakkarban mitzvat ase:
Tashlum hakkeren vahavaat haasham meakkevin hakkappara. veen hachomesh meakkev. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 16)</small> "beel haasham". ayil veasham meakkevin veen hachomesh meakkev:

Hevi meilato ad shello hevi ashamo lo yatza. nistappek lo im maal o lo maal patur min hattashlumin umin hakkarban. vehachomesh hare hu kitchillat hahekdesh veim nehena bo mosif chomesh al hachomesh. uchevar bearnu kamma peamim shehachomesh echad mearbaa min hakkeren ad sheyyihye hu vechumsho chamishsha:
Yesh devarim sheen chayyavin alehen meila middivre tora aval asur lehanot bahen middivre sofrim vehannehene mehen meshallem keren bilvad veeno mosif chomesh veeno mevi asham:

Kol kadshe mizbeach ben kadshe kadashim ben kadashim kallim asurin begizza vaavoda shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 19)</small> "lo taavod bivchor shorecha velo tagoz bechor tzonecha". vehu haddin lishar kadashim. vehaggozez et hashshor o haoved batztzon loke min hattora. vetolesh eno kegozez. veyerae li sheeno loke ad sheyyigzoz kede rochav hassit kaful. lo yihye ze chamur mishshabbat:
Sefek kadashim kegon behema shehi sefek bechor vechayyotze bah. hare hen asurin begizza vaavoda vehaggozez o haoved bahen eno loke:

Behemat hekdesh shennafal bah mum venifdat kemo shebbearnu enah mutteret begizza vaavoda vahare hi beissurah ad shettishshachet. nishchata achar pidyonah huttera baachila. bamme devarim amurim keshekkadam hekdeshan et muman o kadam mum over lehekdeshan. aval hammakdish baalat mum kavua lammizbeach enah asura begizza vaavoda ella middivrehem. nifdat hare zo kechullin lechol davar vetetze lechullin lehiggazez uleheaved. chutz min habbechor vehammaaser shehakkedushsha chala al gufan af al pi shehen baale mumin kevuin mittechillatan. veenan yotzin lechullin lehiggazez uleheaved leolam. veasur leharebia bivchor o bifsule hammukdashin:

Muttar litlosh et hassear lechattechilla min hakkadashim kede lehareot hammum lemumche. veoto hassear shettalash o shennashar min habbehema o min habbechor vehammaaser hare ze asur bahanaya afillu leachar sheyyishshachatu mippene muman. gezera shemma yashhe otan hoil veenan bain lechappara. aval tzemer hannosher min hachattat vehaasham muttar bahanaya leachar shechitatan mippene muman. hoil ulechappara hen bain eno mashhe otan. veim nitlash min haola hare ze safek. vechol sheyyittalesh mikkol hakkadashim achar shennafal bahen mum hare hu muttar bahanaya shehare lo talash beyado. chutz min habbechor vehammaaser sheaf hannitlash mimmennu achar shennafal bo mum asur bahanaya:
Hashshochet bechor o shear mukdashin. tolesh et hassear mikkan umikkan laasot makom lassakkin. uvilvad shello yezizennu mimmekomo:
Kadshe bedek habbayit asurin begizza vaavoda middivre sofrim aval min hattora enan asurin. lefichach haggozez otan o haoved bahen eno loke aval makkin oto makkat mardut:

Hammakdish ubbar lammizbeach immo asura baavoda middivre sofrim. mippene sheavodatah machcheshet et haubbar gazru bah. vahare hi mutteret begizza sheen baze hefsed lavvalad. hikdish evar echad min habbehema ben levedek habbayit ben lammizbeach hare haddavar safek im asura kullah begizza vaavoda o enah asura lefichach en lokin aleha:
Mishneh Torah, Trespass 2:
Kadashim kallim en moalin bahen ad sheyyizzarek haddam. nizrak haddam moalin beemurehen ad sheyyetzu levet haddeshen shehare hen laishshim veen moalin bedavar hanneechol kemo shebbearnu. afillu heela haemurin shellahen lammizbeach kodem zerika en moalin bahen ad sheyyizzarek haddam. hotzi emurehen lachutz kodem zerika en moalin bahen ad sheyyizzarek haddam. nizrak haddam af al pi sheadayin hen bachutz velo hechziran moalin bahen. shehazzerika moelet layyotze ben lehakel ben lehachemir:
Kol kadshe kadashim moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu ad sheyyizzarek haddam. nizrak haddam moalin bahen bedavar shekkullo laishshim ad sheyyissaref veyetze levet haddeshen veen moalin bedavar hanneechol kemo shebbearnu:
Ketzad haola. echad olat haof veechad olat behema vehakkometz vehallevona uminchat kohanim vehachavitin uminchat nesachim moalin bahen mishsheat hekdeshan ad sheyyetzu achar serefatan al hammizbeach levet haddeshen:
Vechen parim hannisrafin useirim hannisrafin moalin bahen mishsheat hekdeshan ad sheyyissarfu vetiggamer serefatan bevet haddeshen veyitoch habbasar. aval kodem sheyyitoch moalin bo vehu bevet haddeshen:
Vechen para adumma moalin bah mishshehukdesha ad shettease efer. af al pi shehi kekadshe bedek habbayit hare neemar bah <small>(Bamidbar 19 9)</small> "chattat hi". utenay bet din hu shello yimol adam beefer happara:
Chattat behema veasham vezivche shalme tzibbur moalim bechullan mishshehukdeshu ad sheyyizzarek haddam. nizrak haddam moalin beemurehen ad sheyyetzu levet haddeshen. veen moalin babbasar. vechen chattat haof moalin bah mishshehukdeshu ad sheyyazze damah. huzza damah en bah meila. aval asur lehanot bemuratah venotzatah. vehannehene bahen achar hazzaya lo maal:
Hammenachot moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu af al pi sheadayin lo nitkaddeshu bichli sharet ad sheyyaktir hakkometz. karav hakkometz hutteru hashsheyarim baachila. veim nifselu hashsheyarim o chasru veachar kach hiktir hakkometz hoil vehaketara zo enah matteret hashsheyarim baachila hare haddavar safek im yatzu yede meila o lo yatzu:
Lechem happanim moalin bo mishshehukdash af al pi sheadayin lo neefa ad sheyyaktir habbezichin. hiktir habbezichin huttar baachila. vechen shete hallechem moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu kodem sheyyeafu ad sheyyizzarek dam hakkevasim. nizrak dam hakkevasim huttar baachila:
Hannesachim moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu. yardu lashshitin en moalin bahen. mayim shemmenassechim bechag hassukkot kol zeman shehen bechad shel zahav en nehenin bahen vehannehene lo maal. natnu otan bitzlochit moalin bechullan. shehare hen mikkelal hannesachim:
Log shemen shel metzora moalin bo mishshehukdash bichli ad sheyyizzarek dam haasham. nizrak dam haasham lo nehenin velo moalin ad sheyyittenu mimmennu mattenotav. natnu mimmennu hammattanot hutteru hashsheyarim baachila kivsar chattat veasham:
Kol dame shechitat hakkadashim en moalin bo ben lifne kappara ben leachar kappara ad sheyyetze lenachal kidron. yatza lenachal kidron moalin bo mippene shehaya nimkar legannot vedamav hekdesh. aval hammakkiz dam levehemat kadashim hare hu asur bahanaya umoalin bo. hoil veenah yechola lichyot belo dam hare hu kegufah:
Haatzamot vehaggidim vehakkarnayim vehattelafayim sheppershu mikkadshe kadashim lifne zerikat damim moalin bahen. pershu leachar zerikat damim en moalin bahen. atzmot haola sheppershu lifne zerika en moalin bahen leachar zerika shehazzerika matteret otam. veim pershu achar zerika moalin bahen leolam. atzmot haola sheppaku meal hammizbeach kodem chatzot hallayla moalin bahen. leachar chatzot en moalin bahen. af al pi sheppaku kodem chatzot kevan shehiggia chatzot hallayla naasu kol haevarim kemi shennitakkelu venaasu efer:
Gachelet sheppaka meal hammizbeach ben lifne chatzot ben leachar chatzot lo nehenin velo moalin. aval gachelet shel kadshe bedek habbayit moalin bah. vehashshalhevet lo nehenin velo moalin:
Deshen hammizbeach hachitzon ben kodem haramat haddeshen ben achar harama moalin bo:
Dishun hammizbeach happenimi vedishun hammenora lo nehenin velo moalin:
Kol behemat kadshe kadashim shehi baalat mum ben shekkadam mum kavua lehekdeshah ben shekkadam hekdeshah lemum kavua vaafillu hayta mechussar zeman moalin bahem mishshehukdeshu ad sheyyippadu. aval torin shello higgia zemannan uvene yona sheavar zemannan vehen kadshe mizbeach af al pi sheasur lehanot bahen hannehene lo maal. hoil veenan reuyin lefidyon hare hem kachattaot hammetot lefichach en moalin bahen:
Mishneh Torah, Trespass 3:
Kadshe mizbeach shemmetu yatzu mide meila devar tora. aval moalin bahen middivre sofrim. vechen im nifselu bidvarim sheyyippaslu bahen hakkarbanot shekkevar bearnum moalin bahen middivre sofrim. bamme devarim amurim beshello haya lahen sheat hetter laachilat kohanim. aval im haya lekadshe kadashim hanneechalim sheat hetter veachar kach nifselu veneesru baachila hoil vehutteru shaa achat en moalin beoto davar shehaya rauy laachila kemo shebbearnu. ketzad. kadshe kadashim shennifselu kodem sheyyaggia haddam lammizbeach kehilchatan kegon sheshshechatan baddarom af al pi shekkibbel batztzafon o sheshshechatan batztzafon vekibbel baddarom. o sheshshachat bayyom vezarak ballayla o sheshshachat ballayla vezarak bayyom. o sheasaan bemachshevet hazzeman o bemachshevet hammakom. o shekkibbelu happesulin et daman af al pi shezzerakuhu kesherim. o shezzerakuhu pesulin af al pi shekkibbeluhu kesherim. o sheyyatza haddam vehabbasar kullo kodem zerikat haddam. o shellan haddam. bechol ellu moalin bechullan leolam shehare lo haya lahen sheat hetter. aval im higgia haddam lammizbeach kemitzvato veachar kach lan habbasar o haemurin. o shennitma habbasar o haemurin. o sheyyatza habbasar o haemurin lachutz. o sheyyatza miktzat habbasar kodem zerikat damim. bechol ellu vechayyotze bahen en moalin bishar besaran shehare haya lo sheat hetter laachila kemo shebbearnu:
Kibbelu happesulin et haddam uzerakuhu vechazru hakkesherim laavoda vekibbelu shear dam hannefesh uzerakuhu en moalin bivsaran. sheen happesulin osin shear dam hannefesh sheyarim chutz min hattame hoil verauy laavodat tzibbur ose shear dam sheyarim:
Ketzad. kibbel hattame vezarak af al pi shechazar hakkasher vekibbel shear dam hannefesh uzerako hare ellu lo hayta lahen sheat hetter umoalin bechullan shezze haddam sheyarim hu veen zerikat hashsheyarim moelet. kevar bearnu sheen bekadashim kallim meila leolam chutz meemurehen achar zerikat haddam vehu shettihye zerika hammoelet. aval kadashim kallim shennitpaggelu af al pi shennizrak haddam en moalin beemurehen. vechen im yatza haddam af al pi shehechziru vezarku en moalin beemurehen:
Kol chattaot hammetot kegon velad chattat utemuratah vechayyotze bahen asur lehanot bahen veim nehena lo maal:
Vechol chattat shettire ad sheyyippol bah mum moalin bah ad shettippade:
Hammafrish chattato veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha veachar kach nimtzet harishona vahare shetehen omdot veshachat shetehen keachat vezarak dam achat mehen. en moalin lo bivsar zo shennizrak damah velo bivsar chavertah. veaf al pi sheeno rauy laachila hoil veim ratza mizze zorek veim ratza mizze zorek. aval im shachat zo achar zo en damah moil livsar chavertah vaafillu leachar zerika shehare lo hayta lah shaa haruya lehattir besarah:
Kol chattat of o olat of shennifsela beshinnuy asiyyatah o beshinnuy mekom asiyyatah moalin bah chutz meolat haof shennimlak lematta kimlikat chattat lesham chattat sheaf al pi shello alta labbealim leshem chova en moalin bah hoil veshinna shemah umekom asiyyatah veshinna maaseha leshem davar sheen bo meila:
Mincha shennitpaggela o shennaaset bemachshevet hammakom. vechen shete hallechem velechem happanim shennitpaggelu o shennifselu bemachshevet hammakom. moalin bahen shehare lo hayta lahen sheat hetter:
Vechen kometz sheyyatza lachutz o lan vechazar vehiktiro moalin bashsheyarim shehare lo haya sham sheat hetter. aval im nitma hakkometz vehiktiro en moalin bashsheyarim shehatztzitz meratztze al hattame veeno meratztze lo al hallan velo al hayyotze. yatzu hashsheyarim o nitmeu veachar kach hiktir hakkometz af al pi shehen asurin baachila en moalin bahen shehare karav hakkometz kemitzvato:
Hannehene mikkadshe kadashim kullam lifne zerikat damim. o meemure kadashim kallim leachar zerika. o shennehene min haola kullah o min hakkometz vehallevona uminchat kohanim vehachavitin. yippol ma shennehena lindava. maal bekarbenot hatztzibbur yippol ma shennehena lallishka:
Nehena kodem zerika mibbesar kadshe kadashim shennitma o shennehena meemure kadashim kallim af al pi sheheelan lerosh hammizbeach hare ze patur:
Kadshe hammizbeach chalavan uvetzehen asur lehanot mehen vehannehene lo maal lefichach velad hakkadashim vechen velad hammaaser lo yinak meimmo ella mibbehema acheret chullin. veyesh leadam lehitnaddev velomar chalev behema zo hachullin yihye hekdesh levaldot hakkadashim sheyyinkuhu kede shello yamutu:
Hikdish behema veof lammizbeach kedushshat damim kegon sheamar deme behema zo linsachim udeme ben yona ze lishlamim hare hen kekadshe bedek habbayit umoalin bachalavan uvevetzehen kemo sheyyitbaer:
Mishneh Torah, Trespass 4: Hammafrish maot lechattato leolato ulaashamo uletorin uvene yona moalin bahen mishshaa shehifrish. hifrish lishlamim en moalin bahem:
Hikdish evar echad ledamav lammizbeach. hare ze safek im pashta kedushsha bechullan o lo pashta lefichach tikkarev velo yippade. veim nifda en moalin befidyono:

Hammafrish maot linziruto asur lehanot bahen veim nehena lo maal mippene shehen reuyin lavo kullam shelamim veen bishlamim meila ella beemurehen achar zerikat damim. met yippelu lindava. hayu meforashim deme chattat yelchu leyam hammelach velo nehenin velo moalin. deme ola yaviu ola umoalin bahen. amar ellu lechattati vehashshear linziruti im nehena bechol hashshear maal nehena bemiktzato lo maal. vechen im amar ellu leolati vehashshear linziruti venehena bechullan maal nehena bemiktzatan lo maal sheen bidme shelamim meila. hifrish maot veamar ellu leolati veellu lechattati veellu lishlamim venitarvu moalin bechullan umoalin bemiktzatan. vechetzad yaase. yikkach shalosh behemot umechallel deme chattat bechol makom shehu al hachattat. udeme ola al haola. udeme shelamim al shelamim:
Echad mimmechuyyeve kinin shehifrish maot veamar ellu lechovati moalin bechullan umoalin bemiktzatan veim met yippelu lindava kemo shebbearnu binzirut umoalin bahen:

Hammafrish chattat al achilat chelev veheviah al achilat dam hare ze lo kipper lefichach lo maal. hifrish maot lechattat chelev vekanah bahen chattat dam. beshogeg kipper lefichach maal. bemezid lo kipper lefichach lo maal:

Hammafrish shete selaim leasham velakach bahen shene elim lechullin hoil vekanah chullin bidme asham maal. vechayyav leshallem asara dinarim shehen shete selaim vechomesh veyavi bahen asham veyavi karban asham al meilato. lefichach im haya echad mishshene haelim shekkana yafe shete selaim vehashsheni yafe asara dinarin yavi hashshave asara asham tachat hammeila im hachomesh veyavi hashshave shete selaim asham al meilato. lakach echad leasham veechad lechullin im haya shel asham yafe shete selaim yavi oto laashamo harishon. vechen im haya ze hachullin yafe shetayim yavi oto asham meilato shehare maal besela achat middeme haasham vishallem chamishsha dinarim veyippelu lindava:

Hannehene middeme chattat ad shello karva chattato yosif chomesh al ma shennehena veyavi bedamav chattato veyavi karban asham al meilato. vechen im nehena middeme asham ad shello karav ashamo yosif chomesh veyavi bedamav ashamo veyavi asham acher limilato. shekkarbenot hammizbeach meilatan lekarbenot hammizbeach vekadshe bedek habbayit meilatan levedek habbayit. noda lo shemmaal veachar kach karva chattato vaadayin lo hifrish meilato o shehifrishah velo kelalah bidme chattato yolich hammeila vechumshah leyam hammelach. noda lo shemmaal achar shekkarva chattato yippelu meot hammeila vechumshah lindava sheen mafrishin battechilla leibbud. uven kach uven kach yavi asham meilato. uveasham ben shennoda lo shemmaal kodem shekkarav ashamo o achar shekkarav tippol meilato vechumshah lindava mippene shehu kemotar asham veyavi asham meilato:

Hammocher olato ushelamav lo asa kelum. vedin tora sheyyachzeru hammaot chullin kemo shehayu. vekansu oto chachamim sheyyippelu hammaot lindava afillu hayta habbehema shava arbaa umecharah bachamishsha hachamishsha kullan yippelu lindava veen kan meila lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim:

Yesh meila bindarim. ketzad. haomer kikkar zo alay karban o hekdesh vaachalah maal af al pi shehi mutteret laacherim. lefichach en lah pidyon shehare enah kodesh ella laze bilvad. amar kikkar zo kodesh o karban vaachalah ben hu ben acher maal lefichach yesh lah pidyon. hayta lefanav kikkar shel hefker veamar kikkar zo hekdesh netalah al menat leachlah maal lefi kullah. al menat lehorishah maal lefi tovat hanaya shebbah:

Haomer lachavero kikkari alecha hekdesh vechazar unetanah lo. hamekabbel mattana zo maal lichsheyyotzi. shehare hannoten enah asura alav. vechen kol kayyotze baze mishshear hakkonamot yesh bahen meila lanneesar bahen. vechol devarim hanneesarin alav minneder kaze mitztarfin veim nehena mikkullam bishve peruta maal:

Haomer hannetiot haellu karban im enan niktzatzot hayyom vetallit ze karban im lo tissaref hayyom. veavar hayyom velo niktzetzu velo nisrefa hattallit. hare hem hekdesh veyippadu kishar hahekdeshot veachar kach yehane bahen. aval im amar hare hannetiot haellu karban ad sheyyikkatztzu eno yachol lifdotan. shebbechol et sheyyippadu yachzeru hekdesh ad sheyyikkatztzu vechevan shenniktzetzu enan tzerichin pidyon ella nehenin bahen miyyad. bamme devarim amurim besheppedaan hammakdish. aval im pedaan acher hare ellu yotzin lechullin af al pi sheadayin lo niktzetzu veyihyu muttarin af lammakdish:
